Application close date:

10/3/2026

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

The Sr. Director of Operations Program Management for TeraWave will own the operational execution and program management infrastructure that keeps one of the most ambitious satellite manufacturing programs in history running at pace and on schedule.

Reporting directly to TeraWave Operations senior leadership, you will lead and scale the Subassembly Operations Program Management, Operations Scheduling, Configuration Management, and Customer Terminals Operations functions, while driving enterprise-wide operational strategy across build execution, BOM and material management, schedule integrity, configuration control, and operational performance - from new product introduction through high-rate volume production.

**The Challenge**

The TeraWave architecture consists of 5,408 optically interconnected satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO) and medium Earth orbit (MEO). This multi-orbit design enables ultra-high-throughput links between global hubs and distributed, multigigabit user connections, particularly in remote, rural, and suburban areas where fiber paths are costly, technically infeasible, or slow to deploy. TeraWave enterprise-grade user and gateway terminals can be rapidly deployed worldwide and interface with existing high-capacity infrastructure, providing additional route strengthening overall network resilience.

TeraWave addresses the unmet needs of customers who are seeking higher throughput, symmetrical upload/download speeds, more redundancy, and rapid scalability. Globally distributed customers can each access speeds of up to 144 Gbps delivered using Q/V-band links from a constellation of 5,280 LEO satellites, while up to 6 Tbps can be accessed via optical links from 128 MEO satellites. Delivering this network on time and at scale requires flawless operations program execution - and that's where you come in.

*Own & Shape Operations Program Execution Strategy*

* Define and own program health visibility across subassembly operations - tracking build quantities, schedule progress, identifying risks early, and driving timely resolution of blockers at the leadership level
* Develop and maintain realistic production program schedules that reflect ground truth across subassembly operations and manufacturing execution

* Define and execute long-lead component risk strategies, including proactive supplier engagement and pipeline management to protect continuity and avoid schedule gaps
* Own cost targets across subassembly operations, driving structural cost reduction per unit as production matures and scales toward high-rate manufacturing
* Ensure subassembly operations are aligned with overall production program requirements, build plans, and configuration baselines
* Partner with engineering and operations leaders to ensure subassembly processes are optimized, resourced, and executing to plan
* Drive accountability across subassembly operations through clear metrics, structured reviews, and escalation processes

*Lead & Elevate the Production Scheduling Function*

* Directly lead the Operations Scheduling team, owning the production scheduling function and ensuring the master production schedule reflects current operational realities and program priorities at a senior director level
* Proactively identify schedule conflicts and communicate impacts to senior stakeholders in a timely and clear manner
* Ensure scheduling plans are executable and grounded in capacity, headcount, and material availability
* Drive schedule adherence metrics and lead structured schedule review processes with cross-functional partners and senior leadership

*Own Configuration Management*

* Identify components with viable multi-source opportunities and drive qualification strategies that reduce unit cost while protecting performance and schedule — translating high-cost single-source dependencies into qualified, competitive supply options

jobs.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
AppFolio is more than a company. We’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. At every opportunity, we set the pace while delivering innovation built to carry real estate into the future. One in which every experience feels effortless, yet meaningful. Where customers are empowered to take on any opportunity. We show up as one team, connected by our values to be a force for good. Because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves.

The Lead Technical Program Manager, Risk & Security will drive the cross-functional execution and operational alignment of critical security initiatives across stakeholder groups, including Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), IT, Business Systems, Marketing Operations, and more. By unifying application security, infrastructure security, vulnerability management, and adversarial testing under a single roadmap, this role ensures our security posture scales cleanly with AppFolio’s growth. Reporting within the Information Security organization, you will serve as the primary bridge between technical security functions and partner engineering teams, empowering our business to build safely, mitigate risks early, and maintain customer trust.

**Your Impact**

* Establish, maintain, and execute strategic roadmaps for core internal security initiatives across application security, infrastructure security, vulnerability management, and threat operations.
* Partner directly with Engineering, SRE, IT, and Business Systems teams to scope requirements, track critical project milestones, and ensure operational deliverables remain on schedule.
* Implement structured intake and prioritization processes to make security project handoffs transparent, well-resourced, and aligned with overall business goals.
* Proactively identify cross-departmental blockers, resource gaps, and dependency conflicts, escalating issues with actionable options and strategic trade-offs.
* Serve as the single point of contact and primary cross-functional liaison for security-driven initiatives, streamlining communications with internal engineering partners and external third-party vendors.
* Deliver clear, executive-ready reporting on program health, project progress, resource needs, and technical outcomes framed around business risk reduction and resilience.

**Qualifications**

* Able to translate complex, multi-domain security initiatives (application security, infrastructure security, vulnerability management) into structured project roadmaps and clear operational deliverables.
* Skilled at facilitating cross-functional alignment between security, software engineering, site reliability, and IT operations teams.
* Strong ability to evaluate technical dependencies, surface emerging risks early, and present clear options and trade-offs to senior leadership.
* Demonstrated competency in managing technical project workflows within tools like Jira to maintain clear accountability and visible tracking.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the versatility to tailor messages effectively for software engineers, security practitioners, and executive leadership.

**Must Have**

* Proven track record in technical program or project management within an information security or engineering organization.
* Experience managing cross-functional technical projects that intersect with software development lifecycles, CI/CD pipelines, or SRE/IT operational workflows.
* Hands-on experience utilizing project management and issue-tracking platforms (such as Jira) to manage complex backlogs, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
* Experience coordinating deliverables across multiple security disciplines or managing vendor engagements aligned with internal project schedules.
* Strong communication skills, including executive-level reporting capabilities.

**Compensation & Benefits**

The compensation that we reasonably expect to pay for this role is: $152,000 - $190,000 base pay. The actual compensation for this role will be determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s skills, education, experience, and internal equity.

Please note that compensation is just one aspect of a comprehensive Total Rewards package. The compensation range listed here does not include additional benefits or any discretionary bonuses you may be eligible for based on your role and/or employment type.  
  
Regular full-time employees are eligible for benefits - see here.

jobs.title: Senior Deputy Program Manager, Engineering
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

Iridium is an award-winning satellite communications company operating the world's only truly global voice and data network, delivering reliable connectivity anywhere on Earth. For more than 20 years, Iridium has powered mission-critical communications for governments, businesses, aviation, maritime, and the rapidly expanding Internet of Things.

  

Now part of Iridium, Aireon is the world’s only space-based air traffic surveillance system, providing real-time visibility of aircraft over oceans, the poles, and remote regions. Together, Iridium and Aireon are helping build a safer, more connected, and more efficient future for global aviation.

  

Join our team and help shape how the world stays connected. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture where employees are empowered to innovate, grow professionally, and make a meaningful impact.

**What We’re Looking For:**
---------------------------

If you are intrigued by space and satellites and love managing technical programs in a fast-paced and customer-focused environment, then you will be excited about the Senior Deputy Program Manager, Engineering opening with Iridium on a Space Development Agency (SDA) project. In this position, you’ll be responsible for working with senior management to establish strategic plans and objectives as it relates to a high-impact program with a multi-million dollar impact to the company. In this role, you’ll be responsible for managing multiple activities and projects, including those with cross-functional teams, on developing end-to-end system solutions, new product development, or network elements within the Iridium architecture. You will succeed in this role if you have exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to successfully work with customers, build relationships, and lead the technical team to deliver solutions that meet our customer’s needs and expectations.

  

This position requires an active/current Secret Security Clearance or the ability to obtain a Secret Security Clearance (A U.S. Security Clearance that has been active in the past 24 months is considered active.)

**What You’ll Do:**
-------------------

* Work with senior management to develop strategic plans associated with the development and execution of the program’s technical vision, including managing delivery of high-quality results and complex solutions and providing ideas and suggestions for continuous improvement cross-functionally
* Manage the coordination and delivery of multiple or complex assignments designed with end goals in mind, within identified timeline and budget
* Work independently to ensure that projects meet financial performance targets as established in project pipeline budgets and Estimates to Complete
* Collaborate with Program Managers to ensure projects deliver quality results, activities are well-designed, and funds are expended to meet overall project objectives, contract deliverables, and indicator targets
* Serve as a sounding board on strategic program decisions and provide thought leadership in program design and delivery
* Manage the requirements and planning basis in a methodical and organized manner, including use of configuration management practices (CM)
* Support proposal development and execution for future contracts and amendments
* Provide clear briefings to senior leadership, managing significant risks and issue resolution

**What You’ll Need to Succeed:**
--------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in engineering, mathematics, or science
* 10+ years of relevant experience in U.S. Government (USG) development and/or operational program/project management experience, preferably in a large, global organization
* 5+ years’ experience in management of complex technical projects, preferably on Department of Defense (DoD) and/or Intelligence Community (IC) satellite or satellite ground programs
* 5-7 years of classical engineering experience
* Experience leading Scaled Agile projects
* Experience managing cross-functional issues where analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of intangibles
* The ability to foster cross-functional team building to deliver complex projects/individual goals
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey products, deliverables, analyses, and/or issues clearly and confidently, and recognize and adapt to different communication techniques
* Can easily build meaningful relationships with others, including senior leadership outside of your own department, and is comfortable providing constructive feedback to your team members and management
* Be able to analyze a situation or problem, generate effective solutions, and see those solutions through to completion
* Must possess the creativity and resourcefulness needed to make reliable decisions and determine methods on new assignments
* Can thrive in a dynamic environment by handling multiple tasks and managing shifting priorities
* Be proactive in sharing knowledge you’ve learned with others

**Things That Would be Great if You Brought to the Table:**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Project Management Accreditation (APMP, PMI or equivalent)

**We’ll also need you to:**
---------------------------

* Be able to travel up to 20%
* Be a U.S. citizen

---------------------

This position primarily works in an office setting and is largely sedentary with the majority of the position working with a computer. The role typically requires the use of basic office equipment such as a phone, video, computer, keyboard, mouse, and printer.

  

We believe in-person connection drives innovation, strengthens mentorship, and builds culture, while flexibility enables employees to do their best work. jobs.title: Senior Manager, People Technology & Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description

Cityblock is looking for a Senior Manager, People Technology & Operations to own and evolve that ecosystem, with Workday at its core. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role for someone who is equally comfortable in the weeds of business process design and security configuration as they are shaping a roadmap with senior leaders. You'll turn People strategy into working systems, automate the manual work that slows our teams down, and bring a curious, responsible approach to AI across everything we do.

You'll lead the People Technology & Operations team, partner closely with People Team Leadership, IT, Security, and business stakeholders, to ensure the tools behind the employee lifecycle are optimized, compliant, and built to scale. If you love making complex systems simple, and you're excited about what automation and AI can do for the employee experience, we'd love to meet you.

About The Role

The Senior Manager, People Technology & Operations is responsible for managing and evolving the organization's People technology ecosystem, with Workday as the core platform. This role owns the day-to-day execution of the People technology roadmap, drives automation and AI-enabled solutions across People Operations, and ensures People systems are reliable, secure, and optimized to support the employee lifecycle. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role reporting into People leadership, balancing technical systems expertise with team leadership.

Key Responsibilities

People Technology Strategy & Execution

Manage and execute the People technology roadmap in partnership with senior People and business leaders, translating strategic priorities into actionable project plans.
Own Workday administration and configuration, including module optimization, business process design, security groups, and release management.
Lead evaluation and implementation of new People technology modules and third-party integrations, ensuring alignment with existing architecture.
Oversee data integrity, integration, and flow across Workday and connected People systems (e.g., recruiting, payroll, benefits, performance).
Serve as a key point of contact for Workday-related escalations, troubleshooting, and vendor management.

People Operations Strategy & Execution

Manage the People Operations function, setting clear processes, procedures, and SLAs.
Drive automation of manual People Operations workflows to reduce administrative burden and improve turnaround time.
Champion self-service tools and resources to improve the employee and manager experience.

AI & Innovation

Identify and pilot AI and automation opportunities across People Technology & Operations to improve efficiency, decision-making, and employee experience.
Evaluate emerging AI tools (e.g., Workday AI/ML capabilities, generative AI for People use cases) and lead responsible adoption, including risk and compliance considerations.
Champion a culture of continuous innovation within the People Technology & Operations function, staying current on People tech and AI trends and proactively bringing recommendations to leadership.

Data, Reporting & Governance

Maintain and enhance People analytics and reporting capabilities to support data-driven decision-making.
Establish and enforce data governance standards, system configuration protocols, and user access controls to protect data integrity and security.
Ensure compliance with data privacy and security regulations across all People systems.

People Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Manage the day-to-day work of the People Technology & Operations team, setting clear roles and responsibilities across the function.
Proactively identify growth opportunities and provide coaching and guidance to support the development of each team member.
Partner across the People team, as well as with IT, Security, Finance, Payroll, and business stakeholders, to ensure technology solutions meet business needs and compliance requirements.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology, or related field; relevant certifications a plus.
7+ years of experience with Workday, including hands-on configuration, module selection/expansion, and third-party system integrations. Workday certification(s) strongly preferred.
5+ years in a leadership role managing HRIS, People Operations, or HR Shared Services teams.
Demonstrated experience leading HR technology projects, system implementations, and process improvements.
Familiarity with AI/automation tools applied to HR technology or People Operations, with genuine enthusiasm for evaluating and piloting new solutions.
Strong understanding of HR business processes, data management, and compliance/data privacy requirements.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
Detail-oriented with a strategic mindset, comfortable both setting direction and executing hands-on work.

We take into account an individual’s qualifications, skillset, and experience in determining final salary. This role is eligible for health insurance, life insurance, retirement benefits, participation in the company’s equity program, paid time off, including vacation and sick leave. The actual offer will be at the company’s sole discretion and determined by relevant business considerations, including the final candidate’s qualifications, years of experience, skillset, and geographic location. The expected salary range for this position is:

$130,000 - $150,000

jobs.description:

Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues.

The Technology organization enables and accelerates the company’s growth strategies, delivering global capabilities and services in support of Amex’s customers and colleagues, while maintaining 24/7 servicing and availability to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality customer experience. Technology provides the foundation for everything we do in the company while driving differentiation through building and leveraging innovative technology and data insights.

The U.S. Consumer Services and Membership Digital Experiences Technology team (USCDT) brings together foundational strategic technology capabilities in digital experience engineering (Mobile and Web), marketing and advertising technology, enterprise communications, travel and lifestyle, and dining technology. It employs a ground-breaking focus with development responsibilities for customer-facing capabilities that deepen and expand digital engagement, as well as core technical capabilities that cut across business lines and customer segments.

The Personalization, Brand, and Communications Technology (PBCT)team, within USCDT, brings together many of our targeting efforts and stitch together multiple connections that customers have with you. 

The Role

As a Director, Software Engineering, you will develop and deploy complex software solutions, with a strong focus on Cloud based engineering, various Java technologies, API design and user experience. You should be able to define innovative solutions, have a pragmatic approach to application architecture, and be excited to work on a varied tech stack. You will be expected to have a deep understanding of the functional platforms, but also plan, manage, and execute the technology roadmap, while being an exemplary leader who attracts, hires, and develops the best talent. You are required to have a futuristic mindset, ability to question status quo and technologically advance the platforms, while exhibiting collaboration with other enterprise teams.

This is an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, Scaled Agile environment with a team of engineers, product owners and several technology stakeholders. You should be familiar with modern software development methodologies and be able to dive deep and rapidly iterate ideas despite ambiguity.

Responsibilities

Performs assessments of 3rd party technology solutions to determine suitability for use in the emerging platform.
Collaborate successfully with product owners, designers, and a broad set of internal tech partners (across multiple internal groups).
Ensure product releases are high quality, deliver excellent user experiences, perform seamlessly at scale, and comply with regulatory requirements.
Partner with peers in technologies to identify opportunities for code sharing, common services, joint development.
Keep up with the latest industry research and emerging technologies to ensure we are appropriately leveraging new techniques and capabilities.
Demonstrate accountability while leading a team of 10+ engineers with passion, enthusiasm, loyalty and integrity.
Own and lead HR processes such as performance reviews, talent development.
Recruit top talent with technical skills and non-technical skills and ability to build a high-performing, self-managing team of software engineers.
Lead teams in interactive product and software development using lean principles.
Drive strategic change in tools and process. Consistently question assumptions, challenge the status quo, and strive for improvement.

Qualifications

You will be expected to have hands-on experience and deep understanding of the functional platforms
Bring a hands-on technical foundation; able to engage the team on coding practices, architecture, design, get under the hood of complex integrated architectures, coding systems, and interface design.
Extensive background in Software Engineering, with 10+ years of demonstrable experience building and deploying large scale software products.
Strong experience in design and Agile software development, code reviews for full stack solutions.
Hands-on experience with Java, REST APIs, Cloud engineering, building digital experiences.
Strong understanding and experience in CICD and DevOps, system and platform resiliency.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to non-technical individuals.
Hands on experience with technology planning and road mapping.
Proven track record to lead problem analysis and resolution.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering or Information Systems degree or equivalent work experience; Advanced Degree preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge and experience of working with LLMs and AI agents, with understanding of how to utilize AI workflows to enable and accelerate software development.
Knowledge of American Express Marketing & Data platforms, and software development practices a plus.
Excellent verbal and written communications skills required, with ability to create and deliver effective presentations to executive leadership and technical architects across the organization is a plus.
Proven ability to develop and execute against a platform vision, strategy, and priorities.
Deep appreciation for the importance of elegant solutions to technical challenges.
Flawless interpersonal skills and ability to partner with executive leadership to drive technical solutions forward.
Passion, energy, personal accountability, and a desire to lead others to excellence. Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the U.S. is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

Competitive base salaries

20+ weeks paid parental leave for all parents, regardless of gender, offered for pregnancy, adoption or surrogacy

Career development and training opportunities

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
A leading healthcare technology organization is seeking a Chief Technology Officer
to lead a large, distributed engineering organization responsible for mission-critical enterprise platforms. This is a hands-on technology leadership role for an executive who can establish strategy while remaining close enough to engineering and architecture to influence critical technical decisions, challenge conventional thinking, and drive execution.

The CTO will lead a 100+ person technology organization through the continued modernization of high-volume, data-intensive platforms. Key priorities include increasing software delivery velocity, evolving cloud and microservices architecture, accelerating practical adoption of AI, strengthening engineering practices, and building a technology organization capable of responding quickly to changing customer, market, and regulatory requirements.

Responsibilities:

Lead technology strategy and engineering execution across a large, geographically distributed organization.
Drive modernization of complex, high-volume enterprise platforms and legacy applications.
Increase software delivery velocity while improving platform quality, reliability, scalability, and operational performance.
Establish architecture direction across cloud, microservices, APIs, data, integration, and distributed systems.
Lead transformation across engineering, architecture, DevOps, quality engineering, and release management.
Identify and implement practical AI opportunities across software development, testing, operations, client delivery, and internal workflows.
Translate business, customer, and regulatory requirements into scalable technology strategies and roadmaps.
Develop strong engineering leaders while maintaining the technical depth necessary to challenge architecture and delivery decisions.
Lead globally distributed onshore and offshore engineering teams.
Partner closely with product, operations, client-facing teams, and senior executives.
Communicate technology strategy, investment priorities, delivery progress, and risk to executive stakeholders.
Build a culture centered on curiosity, accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, and speed of execution.

Role Requirements:

Significant technology leadership experience as a CTO, Head of Engineering, SVP/VP Engineering, Chief Architect, or similar senior technology leader.
Experience leading a large or highly complex software engineering organization.
Strong technical foundation with continued credibility across software engineering and architecture.
Demonstrated success modernizing complex legacy platforms into scalable modern architectures.
Experience with high-volume transactional, data-intensive, or mission-critical enterprise systems.
Strong understanding of modern application architecture, including Java or similar enterprise technologies, microservices, APIs, cloud, and distributed systems.
Experience with AWS or comparable public cloud environments.
Proven ability to improve engineering velocity, software quality, and overall delivery performance.
Experience leading geographically distributed and offshore engineering organizations.
Demonstrated understanding of AI and its practical application across engineering and business workflows.
Experience operating in a regulated or highly complex technology environment.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to move between executive strategy and detailed technology discussions.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where leaders are expected to take ownership beyond narrowly defined responsibilities.

Preferred Background:

Healthcare technology, healthtech, pharmacy technology, benefits administration, insurance technology, fintech, payments, or another transaction-intensive regulated industry.
Experience with claims processing, transaction processing, adjudication, eligibility, benefits, payments, or comparable rules-driven platforms.
Experience leading major cloud or platform transformation initiatives.
Familiarity with healthcare technology standards or regulatory-driven platform changes.
Experience managing engineering organizations of 100+ employees or comparable scale and complexity.
Experience with AI development platforms and tools such as Claude or comparable generative AI technologies.
Experience transforming engineering operating models across DevOps, CI/CD, QA, architecture, and release management.
Experience balancing legacy modernization with ongoing production and customer commitments.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
CTO — Imperative AI

Pre-Seed, AI Model Control and AI Performance Improvement Platform

Imperative AI is ready to launch “The Pluginless, Effortless Control Tower for AI Models, Agents, and Systems.”

Imperative is building a platform designed to give enterprises complete AI control, significantly improved AI performance, full maintenance visibility, and measurable business impact across their AI environments.
Give Imperative read-only access to a customer’s cloud environment and the platform automatically discovers AI models, agents, endpoints, and available telemetry. It then begins measuring behavior, analyzing performance, identifying root causes, calculating business impact and trend scores, and delivering actionable solutions for performance improvement and maintenance.
Deploy nothing. Change nothing. See everything.

No agent. No SDK. No code. No plugin. No application changes. No software installation.

Imperative connects to the customer’s cloud environment and can begin delivering visibility, control, and performance improvement with less than 15 minutes of customer effort.
NVIDIA Inception

Imperative is part of the exclusive NVIDIA Inception Program
, providing the company with access to NVIDIA’s broader AI ecosystem and resources as it advances its AI technology platform.

The CTO Opportunity – Initially Paid with Generous Stock Options until Pre-Seed funding has been established (should be shortly).

We are now looking for an exceptional Chief Technology Officer
to lead Imperative through the final stages of product development, technical refinement, AI model and agent training, pre-seed financing support, customer development partnerships, commercialization, and scale.
This is not a traditional corporate CTO position.
We are looking for a deeply experienced, highly technical startup technology leader who thrives in the earliest and most demanding stages of building a technology company — someone who can personally get into the architecture, code, AI systems, models, agents, telemetry, cloud infrastructure, product, and engineering organization and help take Imperative from its current stage to a production-ready, enterprise-grade platform.
The immediate mandate is clear:
Finish it. Fine-tune it. Train it. Validate it. Deploy it. Scale it.

The CTO will work closely with the founders to put the finishing touches on the Imperative Performance AI technology and prepare it for enterprise deployment.
What the CTO Will Lead

The CTO will have primary technical responsibility for:
Completing and fine-tuning the Imperative Performance AI product and Impertive platform.
Reviewing and improving the existing architecture and technical infrastructure.
Completing the Performance AI platform and preparing it for commercialization.
Training, testing, validating, and optimizing Performance AI’s agents.
Leveraging NVIDIA’s AI ecosystem and available NVIDIA technologies and resources.
Training models and AI capabilities using the appropriate NVIDIA AI agent technologies, including the available NVIDIA agent ecosystem.
Improving model performance, accuracy, reliability, responsiveness, and consistency.
Validating Imperative’s AI performance monitoring, drift detection, technology monitoring, resource monitoring, root-cause analysis, business-impact analysis, and actionable recommendations.
Ensuring the platform can operate effectively across enterprise cloud environments.
Execute the pluginless, effortless, agentless, SDK-free, code-free architecture and customer deployment model. Must be really good with Open Telemetry.
Ensuring Imperative can securely obtain and analyze available telemetry through read-only access to customer cloud environments.
Completing the technical integrations and infrastructure required for enterprise customer deployment.
Establishing the technical standards, development processes, testing methodologies, security practices, and deployment processes necessary for commercialization.
Leading technical troubleshooting and resolving remaining product, infrastructure, AI, and engineering issues.
Working directly with prospective customer development partners to understand technical requirements and rapidly incorporate validated requirements into the platform.
Preparing the technology organization for the transition from pre-seed development to commercial scale.

The Development Team

The ideal CTO candidate will already have — or have exceptionally strong relationships with — an experienced development team capable of working closely with the CTO during this critical final development phase. The development team will also work for options during this short sprint until the product is finished and funded.

We are looking for a CTO who can bring technical horsepower to the company
and work directly with a highly capable team to get the product across the finish line.
The CTO and development team should be comfortable operating with speed, urgency, and limited resources.
Who We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate will bring:
Significant CTO, VP Engineering, founding engineer, and experience in a startup environment.
Experience building and launching cloud, AI, enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, observability, AI operations, and related technology platforms.
Demonstrated experience taking a technology platform from development through production and commercialization.
Deep hands-on experience with AI/ML systems, LLMs, AI agents, model training, inference environments, AI infrastructure, and enterprise AI architectures.
Strong experience with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform
.
Working knowledge of GitHub, APIs, OpenTelemetry,
cloud services, inference infrastructure, data pipelines, model monitoring, and enterprise application architectures.
Experience designing systems that operate across complex enterprise technology environments.
Experience with AI model performance, model behavior, model drift, hallucination detection, latency, resource utilization, reliability, and related AI performance measurements.
The ability to personally diagnose technical problems and make architecture and engineering decisions rather than simply delegating them.
Experience with AI agents and multi-agent architectures.
Experience training, fine-tuning, testing, and validating AI models and agents.
Strong technical leadership and the ability to establish high standards for engineering quality, accountability, testing, documentation, and execution.
The ability to communicate effectively with technical founders, engineers, enterprise CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, AI leaders, investors, boards, strategic partners, and customers.
A highly dynamic, hands-on leadership style.
The ability to move extremely quickly from problem identification to technical solution.
A willingness to personally get into the technology when necessary.
Exceptional judgment, creativity, adaptability, persistence, and execution.
High personal standards for integrity, ownership, preparation, accountability, and results.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

This is an opportunity to join Imperative at an unusually important point in its development.
The core concept and Performance AI product are almost done.
The next phase is about finishing, validating, training, commercializing, and scaling the technology.

The CTO will have a significant opportunity to shape:
The final product architecture.
AI model and agent performance.
AI training and optimization.
Technical product strategy.
Engineering culture.
Development methodology.
Cloud architecture.
Enterprise deployment architecture.
Security architecture.
Scalability.
Technical roadmap.
AI agent capabilities.
Product-market fit from a technical perspective.
The company’s long-term technology organization.

This is an opportunity for a CTO who wants to build something rather than simply maintain something that already exists.

Where We Are

Imperative is currently approaching its pre-seed financing round
.
The CTO will work closely with the founders, board, advisors, and business leadership to help convert the existing technology into a production-ready and commercially scalable platform.

The Leadership Profile

The CTO who finishes what others started.

We are looking for an exceptional technical leader who is an unusually effective executor, builder, problem solver, and company builder.
Someone who doesn’t simply manage engineers — they understand the technology deeply enough to lead them.

Someone who is comfortable opening the codebase, reviewing architecture, analyzing AI behavior, debugging difficult problems, making technical decisions, training models, working with developers, talking with customers, and making whatever technical decisions are necessary to move the company forward.
Someone who thrives in an environment where:
Speed matters.

Execution matters.

Technical judgment matters.

Ownership matters.

Results matter.

For the right person, this is an opportunity to join an ambitious AI company at the stage when some of the most important technical decisions are still being shaped — and to have a direct role in building the technology that becomes the foundation of the company.

Compensation

Initially, the position will be compensated primarily through generous stock options
until the next round of financing has been secured.
The goal is to move quickly through the pre-seed financing and transition the organization toward funded, fully compensated technical and engineering roles.

Imperative AI

The Pluginless, Effortless “Control Tower” for AI Models, Agents, and Systems.

Deploy nothing. Change nothing. See everything.

NVIDIA Inception Program Member

Imperative is building the control layer for the rapidly expanding enterprise AI ecosystem — providing visibility, performance intelligence, behavioral monitoring, root-cause analysis, business-impact analysis, and actionable solutions without requiring customers to significantly modify their existing AI applications.
This is an opportunity to help finish building it.

Location: Woodward

JOB SUMMARY:

The Director, IT Infrastructure Operations provides strategic leadership for infrastructure, end-user technology, and IT support services. The position leads System Engineering, Network Engineering, IT System Administration, Desktop Support, and IT Service Desk Support Technician functions through two managers. This role translates enterprise priorities into functional strategy, operating plans, governance, investment recommendations, service expectations, and risk management practices for TriCore's infrastructure environment. The Director is accountable for infrastructure strategy, enterprise Configuration Management Database (CMDB) governance, architecture and lifecycle management, resilience and disaster recovery, major incident governance, service performance, financial stewardship, vendor performance, and organizational capability. The Director leads through managers, establishes functional outcomes and decision rights, evaluates performance and risk, and holds leaders accountable for execution. The role presents material risks, tradeoffs, and investment recommendations to executive leadership and directs remediation within the assigned portfolio.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

1. Develop and execute infrastructure and operations strategies aligned with enterprise priorities, business needs, risk direction, and available resources.

2. Lead through direct-report managers with accountability for System Engineering, Network Engineering, IT System Administration, Desktop Support, and IT Service Desk Support Technician functions.

3. Establish governance, service expectations, performance measures, and accountability for infrastructure operations and related technology services.

4. Direct infrastructure architecture, modernization, capacity, lifecycle, and technical debt planning across compute, storage, virtualization, network, backup, endpoint, cloud, and related platforms.

5. Govern architecture and investment decisions involving availability, resilience, scalability, supportability, security, recoverability, unsupported technology, and residual risk.

6. Own enterprise CMDB strategy and governance, including standards for configuration data, service mapping, ownership, lifecycle status, business criticality, recovery priority, and data quality.

7. Govern integration of CMDB and asset management with acquisition, change, incident, problem, disaster recovery, audit, and decommissioning processes.

8. Develop infrastructure resilience, backup, recovery, replication, immutability, and disaster recovery strategies aligned with business continuity priorities and enterprise risk direction

9. Sponsor recovery validation and readiness reviews, hold managers accountable for remediation, and elevate material capability, risk, or funding gaps.

10. Lead infrastructure decision-making during major incidents and govern post-incident reviews, corrective actions, and escalation of unresolved risk.

11. Lead operating and capital planning, investment prioritization, financial performance, and vendor strategy for the assigned portfolio.

12. Build business and executive partnerships, communicate infrastructure performance and risks, support compliance and continuous improvement, and align infrastructure priorities with organizational objectives.

MINIMUM EDUCATION:

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and progressively responsible experience.

MINIMUM EXPERIENCE:

* Eight (8) years of progressively responsible information technology experience, including leadership of infrastructure, operations, engineering, end-user support, or related functions.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (US Federal Civilian) - CTJ - Secret
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Microsoft is seeking a **Chief Technology Officer** for the US Federal Civilian business, including US Tribal Nations. The Chief Technology Officer serves as the senior technology executive for the business, translating emerging technologies, customer priorities, market dynamics, and Microsoft capabilities into actionable strategy for the business and its most strategic accounts.

Working across Microsoft leadership, account teams, product and engineering groups, partners, and senior government executives, the Chief Technology Officer shapes Microsoft's most strategic Civilian engagements, guides use of the product portfolio, develops the Federal partner ecosystem, leads complex escalations and creates a framework of technical adoption that can be scaled by account aligned technical resources.

The successful candidate will be a technologist, strategist, customer advocate, partner leader, and business executive, equally at ease discussing enterprise architecture with engineers, mission priorities with a government CIO, account strategy with sales leadership, partner solutions with a systems integrator, and product requirements with Microsoft engineering. Above all, the Chief Technology Officer will connect what Federal Civilian customers need, what Microsoft and its partners can deliver today, what Microsoft should build next, and how technical differentiation becomes customer outcomes, platform adoption, and sustainable growth.

 **Responsibilities**  

**Business, Market, and Technology Strategy**
---------------------------------------------

* Provide strategic technology leadership for the Civilian and Tribal Nations business, ensuring customer mission priorities, competitive dynamics, and emerging technologies inform business, investment, and go-to-market decisions.
* Represent the Civilian business in Federal and USPSI strategy development, and translate broader Microsoft priorities into actionable Civilian strategies
* Partner with account teams and customer executives to shape account-level technology and business strategy for Microsoft's most strategic Civilian customers and pursuits measured by growth and wins across the business.
* Provide Civilian leadership with a clear point of view on technology shifts on new and emerging technology, customer adoption signals, competitive developments, product risks, and areas where Microsoft should invest or change direction.

**Customer and Executive Engagement**
-------------------------------------

* Serve as a trusted technology advisor to senior Federal leaders, including CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, CDOs, CAIOs, acquisition executives, and mission leaders.
* Guide customers in translating mission and modernization objectives into practical technology strategies, architectures, and transformation initiatives, particularly where the challenge spans multiple Microsoft technologies, engineering organizations, or partners.
* Serve as Technology Lead for major pursuits, enterprise transformations, strategic renewals, and significant escalations, balancing mission requirements, engineering realities, compliance obligations, and business considerations while preserving long-term customer trust.
* Represent Microsoft as an external technology voice at customer forums, government technology events, industry conferences, and executive briefings.

**Technology Portfolio and Government Cloud Leadership**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Maintain an integrated view of the Microsoft portfolio as it applies to Federal Civilian missions, spanning cloud and hybrid infrastructure, cybersecurity and identity, AI, data, application modernization, contact center, business applications, and collaboration.
* Guide customers and account teams through architectural tradeoffs, product dependencies, service limitations, and emerging capabilities across commercial and government cloud environments.
* Apply Federal cybersecurity, compliance, and authorization requirements, including NIST SP 800-53 and 800-171, CUI protection, Authority to Operate, and data sovereignty, to strategy, architecture, and product adoption, engaging specialized expertise where required.
* Identify repeatable technology patterns, solutions, and engagement models for application across Civilian accounts.

**Product and Engineering Influence**
-------------------------------------

* Serve as the principal connection between the Federal Civilian market and Microsoft product and engineering organizations.
* Aggregate customer, partner, and field feedback into systemic product gaps, roadmap priorities, and adoption barriers, prioritized by mission impact, growth potential, and competitive significance.
* Ensure clear, credible, and consistent communication regarding product capabilities, roadmap direction, limitations, and dependencies.

**Federal Partner and Ecosystem Strategy**
------------------------------------------

* Develop and execute an end-to-end Civilian partner engagement strategy aligned to the business's technology priorities and growth objectives.
* Build executive and technical relationships with Federal systems integrators, solution providers, independent software vendors, and small businesses that influence customer technology decisions and mission outcomes.
* Ensure priority partners incorporate Microsoft's latest cloud, AI, security, data, and application capabilities into their solutions, reference architectures, managed services, and go-to-market strategies.
* Bring partner requirements, technical barriers, and competitive intelligence back to the business and to product and engineering, and evaluate partner engagement by technical capability, platform adoption, and contribution to growth.

Eko builds AI and digital tools to enable every healthcare provider to more accurately detect heart and lung disease – the leading causes of death globally. jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About The Role:

We’re looking for a VP-level AI Architect to define and drive a consistent, modern AI- and agentic-first architecture across CrowdStrike. This company-wide role spans business units, customer-facing products, shared platforms, and internal AI capabilities.

You’ll connect AI applications with the software and infrastructure that make them work at scale. Working with business unit and engineering leaders, you’ll translate business priorities into practical designs, establish common technical foundations, and guide implementation across teams. The architecture must support distinct product needs while making shared capabilities easier to build, integrate, and operate.

Your work will range from company-wide architectural decisions to building reference implementations and resolving difficult engineering problems. You’ll bring deep systems expertise, sound judgment about emerging AI technologies, and a record of turning architectural direction into working products.

What You’ll Do:

Define and drive the company-wide AI architecture and roadmap. Establish shared interfaces and design patterns, resolve cross-business-unit tradeoffs, and work with product and engineering leaders to put architectural decisions into practice. Determine which capabilities should be common and where teams need flexibility.
Design and build full-stack AI and agentic systems. Connect models and retrieval to agent runtimes, memory, tools, and execution environments. Develop prototypes and production reference implementations that give teams a tested foundation for new capabilities.
Architect production AI systems for performance, resilience, and scale. Benchmark model and serving options, investigate bottlenecks across software and infrastructure, and improve latency, throughput, and compute efficiency. Guide deployment choices across cloud and edge environments.
Create a consistent developer experience across products through reusable components, common APIs, and shared tooling. Simplify integration and establish engineering practices that teams adopt. Contribute to critical implementations, review designs and code, and mentor engineers and technical leaders.
Design the AI lifecycle architecture, from data ingestion and model adaptation through evaluation, deployment, and operational feedback. Establish reproducible workflows, automated quality gates, and observability for model quality, agent task success, reliability, and cost. Build safe rollout, rollback, and recovery into production systems.
Embed security, governance, and auditability into AI architectures. Define permissions and execution boundaries for agents, address prompt injection and data exposure, and make system actions traceable. Partner with Security and Legal to translate requirements into practical engineering controls.

What You’ll Need:

BS, MS, or PhD in computer science, computer engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years of experience in software architecture, systems engineering, or AI engineering, including senior technical leadership across multiple products or business units.
A record of personally designing and delivering production AI systems, including generative or agentic applications and the infrastructure that supports them.
Strong foundations in distributed systems, software design, APIs, and performance engineering, with the ability to work across application and infrastructure layers.
Practical experience with model integration, inference serving, retrieval, and evaluation, including the tradeoffs involved in deploying and operating AI systems at scale.
Experience establishing shared platforms and engineering standards across independent teams. Ability to align senior stakeholders, explain architectural tradeoffs, and mentor engineers through implementation.
Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

Significant contributions to open-source projects or industry standards, with experience shaping technical direction across external engineering communities and partners.
Depth in Linux systems software, networking, accelerated computing, or AI deployment across cloud and edge environments.

**Position Title: Manager/Director of IT Operations**  
**Location:** Huntsville, AL / Onsite  
**Reports To:** Chief Information and Digital Officer

**Position Summary**

The Manager/Director of IT Operations is Rural Metro Fire's designated Information Security Officer and owns cybersecurity, enterprise infrastructure (network, server, cloud, and endpoint), identity and access management, business continuity and disaster recovery, and IT service management for a distributed, 24/7 public safety organization. The role governs the managed service provider (MSP) that delivers the security operations center (SOC), IT Helpdesk, and project-level engineering support, retaining ownership of strategy, standards, risk, and outcomes while holding the MSP accountable for contracted services.

This role does not administer business or public safety applications (e.g., CAD, RMS, ERP, and SaaS business systems); those remain with their designated application owners and administrators. As Security Officer, it sets and enforces the security requirements those systems must meet and provides the secure infrastructure, oversight, and escalation support they depend on.

Title and level (Manager or Director) will be determined by the selected candidate's experience and scope of prior leadership.

**Essential Functions**

* **MSP Oversight, Service Management, and Team Leadership**
  + Own the MSP relationship for SOC, Helpdesk, and project support: govern scope, SLAs, escalation paths, and performance against the master services agreement; lead operational and quarterly business reviews.
  + Own IT service management processes (incident, problem, change, request, asset) across internal and MSP-delivered services; establish KPIs and reporting; ensure Helpdesk quality for a distributed, 24/7 workforce.
  + Define and maintain the MSP/internal division of responsibilities (RACI), escalation paths, and after-hours coverage.
  + Lead and develop internal IT operations staff assigned to the role; partner with, but do not administer on behalf of, business and public safety application owners
* **Cybersecurity and Risk Management**
  + Serve as the company's Information Security Officer: accountable to executive leadership for security posture, with authority to set security requirements for all systems and data, and primary point of contact for auditors, regulators, cyber insurance carriers, and law enforcement.
  + Own the cybersecurity program—strategy, policies, standards, and risk decisions aligned to NIST CSF/CIS Controls—and direct the MSP-provided SOC that executes monitoring, detection, vulnerability and patch management, and endpoint and email security; set requirements and SLAs and hold the MSP accountable for results.
  + Own identity and access governance (Entra ID/Active Directory, MFA, conditional access, privileged access, access reviews) and serve as incident commander for security events, coordinating response with the MSP SOC, cyber insurance carrier, and legal partners.
  + Understand and apply CMMC and NIST standards and lead assessment readiness; ensure compliance with HIPAA (where applicable), PCI DSS, and cyber insurance requirements, and manage security awareness training and vendor security risk.
* **Infrastructure, Cloud, and Network Operations**
  + Own the architecture, lifecycle, and operation of networks (LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, firewalls), servers and virtualization, storage, backup, and cloud platforms (Microsoft 365, Azure).
  + Ensure high availability, redundancy, and performance for mission-critical systems at headquarters, fire stations, dispatch, and remote sites.
  + Lead backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning and testing with defined recovery time and recovery point objectives.
  + Standardize the endpoint lifecycle (Intune/MDM) for office, station, and field devices; drive modernization, automation, and cost optimization.
* **Field Operations Technology Modernization (Station Alerting, Radio, and CAD Infrastructure)**
  + Support modernizing field operations technology, including station alerting systems, radio and dispatch communications, mobile data/MDT connectivity, and the network, server, and integration platforms that CAD and related systems run on.

  + Lead evaluation, selection, and implementation of station alerting platforms and radio system upgrades (e.g., IP-based alerting, radio-over-IP, console and gateway integrations) in partnership with operations leadership, dispatch, and vendors.
  + Coordinate maintenance windows, change control, and disaster recovery testing for dispatch-critical infrastructure with operations leadership and vendors.

* **Vendor, Budget, Projects, and Governance**
  + Develop and manage the IT operations budget, procurement, licensing, and contracts; negotiate MSP agreements, statements of work, and renewals.
  + Lead infrastructure and security projects, directing MSP project resources and ensuring scope, quality, security, and documentation standards are met.
  + Develop and enforce IT policies (acceptable use, access control, data protection, retention, change management); report security posture, risk, and project status to executive leadership.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The NYC Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) enriches the environment and protects public health for all New Yorkers by providing 1.1 billion gallons of high-quality drinking water, managing wastewater and stormwater, and reducing air, noise, and hazardous materials pollution. DEP is the largest combined municipal and wastewater utility in the country, with nearly 6,000 employees. DEP's water supply system is comprised of 19 reservoirs and 3 controlled lakes throughout the system’s 2,000 square mile watershed that extends 125 miles north and west of the city.
  
  
The New York City Department of Environmental Protection (NYC DEP) Business Information Technology (BIT) division is responsible for providing quality business, technical, and information technology system support to agency users. This commitment is achieved through collaboration, strong relationships, and a unified vision with DEP partners to deliver technology solutions that support the agency’s operational needs. Providing these services ensures that DEP continues its tradition of delivering excellent service to the residents of New York City.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief Information Officer (CIO), the Business Information Technology team seeks to hire a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). Responsibilities include cybersecurity strategy, architecture, solutions design, program coordination and execution, awareness and outreach, business management, and reporting on the effectiveness of the information security program. This position requires a seasoned leader with strong business acumen and a detailed working knowledge of information security technologies, practices, and policies and their application in a business environment. The CISO will research and recommend innovative solutions and improvements to existing procedures. The CISO is an implementer who possesses the poise and ability to act calmly and competently in high-pressure situations. This role is responsible for developing and managing strong strategic relationships within Information Technology (IT) and ensuring that projects, initiatives, and security platforms meet all required security standards.
  
  
Under varying levels of executive direction, with latitude for independent initiative, judgment, and decision making, the selected candidate will develop and implement the organization’s information security strategy to protect data and systems from cyber threats. The CISO will safeguard information system assets by identifying security risks, threats, and vulnerabilities affecting networks, systems, and applications across new and existing technology initiatives, the selected candidate will evaluate high-level information technology initiatives and provide technical guidance to ensure compliance with security policies, standards, and guidelines. Responsibilities include developing, implementing, enforcing, and communicating security policies and plans covering data, software applications, hardware, and telecommunications systems.
  
  
The role requires in-depth knowledge of Internet Protocol (IP) networking and networking protocols, along with security technologies including encryption, Internet Protocol Security (IPsec), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Virtual Private Networks (VPNs), firewalls, proxy services, Domain Name System (DNS), electronic mail systems, privileged access management, and access lists. Experience with Operational Technology (OT) networks and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) environments is also required.
  
  
The candidate will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in internet, web, application, and network security engineering, including vulnerability assessments, network scanning, and threat surface analysis. The role also requires advanced knowledge of cloud service security models and enterprise data protection strategies, including backup architecture, disaster recovery planning, and business continuity frameworks.
  
  
The candidate will oversee the system’s cybersecurity program and also support the new NYS Cybersecurity requirements for water and wastewater.
  
The candidate must have:
  

* Proven knowledge of core cybersecurity principles, including the ability to understand, interpret, and apply cybersecurity policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Practical, hands-on experience in system protection or risk management, demonstrating the ability to identify security risks, evaluate vulnerabilities, and support incident response activities.
* Experience implementing or supporting cybersecurity programs in environments involving critical infrastructure, public utilities, operational technology (OT), or similar high-risk systems.
* The capability to serve as the responsible authority for developing, maintaining, and ensuring compliance with the system’s cybersecurity program.

  
  
Essential Job Functions:
  
  

* Lead the development, coordination, and submission of materials required to maintain compliance with the New York State Cybersecurity Regulations for Public Water Systems.
* Manage and direct a team of information technology security professionals, providing leadership, guidance, and support.
* Manage cybersecurity incidents and attacks in coordination with the team and oversight agencies such as New York City Cyber Command (NYC Cyber Command).
* Track cyber security incidents and vulnerability reports, direct teams for remediation of issues.
* Design a critical response process for cyber security incidents.
* Continuously monitor threats to DEP’s information technology (IT) and operational technology (OT) environments.
* Develop cybersecurity Key Risk Indicators

jobs.title: Program Manager, Executive Development
jobs.description:
People Development accelerates the performance of every Metamate, team, and leader — building the capabilities, culture, and human-AI partnerships that power Meta's future. We help people thrive through continuous change, grow more valuable over time, and choose to stay. We do this through coaching, team development, leadership experiences, performance systems, and skills at scale — all working as an integrated system, not a set of disconnected programs.This individual contributor role sits on the Executive Development team, which delivers best-in-class development to Meta's senior most leaders as they forge the future at a transformational moment in the company's history. You will focus on the strategy, planning, and operational systems of Executive Development and its learning experiences, ensuring the work we do addresses real needs, is targeted, and makes a real difference to our leaders and the business.  
  
  

### **Program Manager, Executive Development Responsibilities:**

* Own the portfolio and prioritization system. Design and run the system and recurring reviews that keep all Executive Development work visible, scoped, and prioritized — including which design ideas are queued, committed, or parked, so the agenda is deliberate rather than reactive.
* Serve as strategic thought partner to the VP, Executive Development. Bring evidence, options, and a recommendation, and guide annual and quarterly planning.
* Protect team and senior leader capacity. Sequence high-value design and delivery work, make overcommitment visible before it affects delivery, flag when timelines are at risk of collapsing, and escalate with ranked options rather than problems.
* Own everything that happens before a cohort starts: curation and selection, the invitation list and cohort timing, the design cycle and its decision gates, and the faculty partnership — setting the experience standard the program is held to.
* Develop the faculty, coach, and vendor bench. Build bench depth, define how facilitators are matched to programs, and run the quality evaluation that informs future assignments.
* Partner with the VP and design partners on the design and modernization of learning experiences. Bring delivery, participant, and measurement evidence, pressure-test feasibility, and translate design intent into work the team can build and run.
* Build new offerings end to end — the build plan, coordination with designers, decision gates, and the launch and communications strategy for an executive audience, including leading socialization with senior stakeholders directly.
* Build and ship AI-enabled learning experiences that modernize how senior leaders learn, reflect, and are coached — judging what should be AI-enabled versus left human, and holding the bar on participant experience and privacy.
* Own measurement and the insight narrative. Define what we measure and why, synthesize themes across programs, and answer "is this working?" with evidence that shapes investment and retirement decisions.
* Build relationships and influence cross-functional partners early. Work with recruiting and HR partners while new initiatives are still being shaped, securing early line of sight into changes that affect the portfolio.
* Jump in and manage evolving priorities, including planning and executing special projects as needed.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years experience developing and executing business and/or learning solutions
* Entrepreneurial multi-tasker who can be highly efficient with ambiguity and complexity
* Demonstrated track record of leading strategy and planning work in complex environments
* Demonstrated track record of owning a portfolio or system of programs — not only individual programs — including prioritization and capacity trade-off decisions
* Demonstrated track record of thinking strategically and acting operationally while managing ambiguity, risk, and changing direction
* Demonstrated track record of developing and delivering communications for an executive audience, including change management and go-to-market plans
* Demonstrated track record of background in working directly with VP-level or equivalent senior leaders
* Experience as a strategic thought partner to senior executives, with demonstrated influence on what an organization chooses to work on
* Experience defining measurement strategy and translating data into recommendations
* Experience building and launching new programs or offerings, including the socialization required to land them with senior stakeholders
* Experience applying AI tools to design or improve how work gets done

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience in executive development, leadership development, or executive coaching
* Experience building AI-enabled learning or coaching experiences

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  

Meta is proud to be an E
