**Job Details for Director of Information Technology**
======================================================


Court Name/Organization Illinois Northern Bankruptcy Court
  

Overview of the Position This full\-time position is in the Clerk’s Office of the U.S. Bankruptcy Court, Northern District of Illinois and reports to the Clerk of Court. The Director of Information Technology is responsible for managing and overseeing automated systems within the court, including the operation, coordination, and integration of all Judiciary and local applications. The incumbent is responsible for managing the Information Technology Department and primarily directs supervisors and oversees the coordination, training and integration of office automation equipment, telecommunications, and courtroom technology. The Director of Information Technology is a forward\-thinker who explores development opportunities regularly to expand and enhance IT staff skill sets, keeping the department on the cutting edge of new and improved technologies. The court’s applications are housed on a variety of LINUX/UNIX systems and Windows systems, both physical and virtual. The Director of Information Technology ensures compliance with the appropriate guidelines, policies, and approved internal controls. The incumbent must possess excellent leadership, project management, analytical, and communication skills; successfully direct the planning, acquisition, and deployment of all automation systems; and coordinate and oversee operations and delivery of IT services. A successful incumbent will be an innovative leader who values the development of employees, proactively improves processes, and leverages emerging technologies—including responsible and ethical use of AI—to enhance efficiency, security, and service delivery. Travel to the divisional office will be required as needed.
  

Location Chicago, IL
  

Opening and Closing Dates 10/01/2026 \- Open Until Filled
  

Appointment Type Permanent
  

Classification Level/Grade CL
  

Salary $95,178 \- $197,200

  

Announcement Number 26\-6

  

**Position Description**
------------------------

Oversee the daily operation of the department to include analyzing workflow, establishing priorities, and setting deadlines. Conduct regularly scheduled staff meetings and communicate operational status and relevant information to staff. Through leadership of technology vendors and internal technology resources, the VP of IT translates organizational priorities into practical execution, strengthens infrastructure and cybersecurity, improves collaboration and knowledge sharing, and guides responsible use of Microsoft 365, automation, and AI to improve operational performance and team\-member experience. This role is responsible for service delivery, vendor accountability, enterprise applications, business continuity, and the operational performance of business\-critical technology platforms.
  
  

Success in this role is evidenced by reliable and secure technology, strong vendor performance, effective execution of technology initiatives, and sound technology investment that protects organizational value, reduces risk, and enables the business to serve customers and communities well.
  
  

Starting at $140,000/year and more depending on experience
  
  

This is an in\-office role based in Fargo, North Dakota.
  
  

Key Areas of Impact
  
  

This role contributes to the success of the team and organization through the following key areas of impact:

Customer \& Stakeholder Experience Excellence

As a Manager on the IKC Clinical Programs team, you will play a pivotal role in driving the operational design, launch, and scaling of innovative care delivery models along with supporting the migration of our electronic medical record (EMR) in 2027\. High 5 Games is hiring a Director of Technology who is first and foremost a hands\-on chief architect. You will shape the technical vision and grow into owning the architecture of a cloud platform built on hundreds of Java microservices that process millions of real\-time transactions every day.  

  

You will join a mature, high\-volume platform that is already running in production. You'll spend your first 90 days learning it deeply, embedded with the teams that built it, and take ownership of its architecture domain by domain: starting with the data and transaction layer, then service architecture and the cloud platform. By the end of your first year, you'll own the platform's architecture end to end and set its direction for the years ahead.  

  

This is not a slide\-deck architect role. You will design systems, review code and schemas, set engineering standards, and lead the engineering and technology teams that build and run the platform. You must be comfortable explaining technology strategy and trade\-offs to executives, business partners, and regulators.  

  

**The platform you will own**


* **Hundreds of microservices**, primarily Java, running in the cloud.
* **Millions of real\-time transactions per day**, where latency, consistency, and auditability matter on every one.

* **24x7 availability** for players across web and mobile.

**Cloud, reliability, and operations**

* Communicate technology strategy and risk clearly to the CEO, executives, and partners.

* 12\+ years in software engineering, including 5\+ years as an architect of large distributed systems.
* Expert\-level Java (Java 17\+), with deep knowledge of Spring Boot / Spring Cloud, concurrency, and JVM performance tuning and garbage collection.
* Proven track record designing and operating a microservices estate of 100\+ services in production.
* Hands\-on experience with systems handling millions of real\-time transactions per day, with measurable latency and uptime targets.
* Deep database expertise: relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle) including query tuning, indexing, sharding, and replication, plus NoSQL and caching (e.g., Cassandra, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis).
* Event\-driven architecture with Kafka or a comparable streaming platform.
* Production experience on AWS or GCP, with Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar).

* Experience with API design (REST, gRPC), API gateways, and service mesh concepts.

* Experience leading and growing engineering teams, and evaluating and interviewing technical candidates.

**Preferred qualifications**

This is not a traditional project coordination role — we are looking for a highly assertive program executive with strong presence who can operate effectively in a complex, fast\-moving environment. The right candidate drives execution, challenges weak plans, surfaces uncomfortable truths early, and ensures risks and issues are addressed before they impact delivery.  



  

The role sits within the Cybersecurity COO organization and carries dual accountability: owning the day\-to\-day delivery of the Information Security portfolio while simultaneously building and maturing the program management operating model that the function runs on. This leader will inherit a function in active transformation — navigating an organizational redesign, a Global Capability Center build, a vendor optimization program, and the stand\-up of Data Security and AI Security capabilities.

jobs.title: Director of IT (Remote, US)
jobs.description:
**About Mosaic Consulting Group**



Built for innovation and driven by people, Mosaic Consulting Group helps organizations modernize operations, empower teams, and accelerate growth through strategic advisory, enterprise technology, AI, and transformation services.



We work across UKG, SAP, and a growing set of technology partners, serving more than 500 clients with a 90% retention rate. We partner with clients to deliver measurable business outcomes while empowering our team to grow, lead, and create meaningful impact.


**The Opportunity**



Due to our rapid growth, we are looking for a remote Director of IT to lead the next stage of our technology and security strategy. As our global team grows, we need someone who can strengthen the foundation we have, improve what needs to scale, and keep technology easy for people to use.



This is a hands\-on leadership role with a strong focus on security, SOC compliance, and practical IT operations. You’ll set direction, lead the work, and grow the function over time. We’re looking for someone who can bring structure where it helps without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.


**What you’ll do:**


* Own the IT strategy, roadmap, and budget, working closely with the COO and business leaders to prioritize investments as Mosaic grows.
* Lead our security program, including risk management, access controls, incident response, employee awareness, and oversight of vendors and systems.
* Manage SOC compliance and audits, keeping controls, evidence, and remediation work organized throughout the year.
* Oversee reliable, responsive IT support for employees across our global workforce, with a consistent experience across locations and time zones.
* Improve the processes and systems behind onboarding, offboarding, device management, identity and access, and day\-to\-day support.
* Assess our technology environment and make thoughtful improvements to scalability, integration, documentation, and resilience.
* Build and develop the IT function, deciding where to add internal capacity, where to use partners, and how to maintain clear ownership.
* Partner with teams exploring AI tools and automation, helping Mosaic adopt them in ways that are useful, secure, and appropriate for our data and clients.
* Translate technical risks and recommendations into clear choices for leaders.


**What makes you successful:**


**Need to haves:**


* 8\+ years of progressive IT experience, including experience leading an IT function, team, or significant area of responsibility.
* Experience supporting a global workforce and managing IT needs across countries and time zones.
* A strong security background, with experience assessing risk, putting effective controls in place, and responding to security issues.
* Experience overseeing cloud applications, identity and access management, endpoint management, IT support, and technology vendors.
* A track record of improving IT systems and processes as an organization grows.
* The ability to set a strategy, stay close to the work, and communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical colleagues.


 **N****ice to haves:**


* Experience managing SOC compliance, audit preparation, or a comparable security assurance program.
* Experience building or expanding an IT team and deciding when to use external partners.
* Experience supporting a consulting or other professional services organization.
* Experience evaluating AI tools and developing practical guidance for their secure use.


Equal Opportunity Employer  

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
Southern Tier Library System is accepting applications for the position of Director of Information Technology. The library system seeks an energetic candidate with a robust understanding and vision for 21st century technologies in the field of public libraries, and a passion for providing meaningful services to 48\-member libraries within a team\-based, cooperative library system environment.

**GENERAL STATEMENT OF DUTIES** 

This is an administrative, full time, exempt, professional position charged with overall management of the Division of Information Technology. Under the general direction of the Executive Director, the Director of IT oversees successful implementation of all operations within the Division of Information Technology. Additionally, this position provides support to member libraries relative to all aspects and approaches of technology services, requiring a sound technical background including knowledge in computer systems, networking, storage systems, databases, applications, security and protecting sensitive data from external threats.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE POSITION** 

Staff Leadership \& Service Delivery

* Direct and supervise IT department staff, including the PC Deployment Technician, Systems Specialist, and Network Specialist.
* Assign projects, establish priorities, and monitor completion.
* Provide technical guidance and escalation support to staff.
* Coordinate IT services delivered to member libraries.
* Approve timesheets, benefit time, and staff scheduling.
* Identify staff training and professional development needs.
* Develop cross\-training and succession coverage for critical systems.

Technology Planning \& Infrastructure Management

* Establish the organization's technology strategy and infrastructure direction.
* Oversee servers, virtualization, networking, cloud services, storage, backup systems, and data\-center infrastructure.
* Plan infrastructure upgrades and replacement cycles.
* Ensure appropriate system capacity, availability, performance, and reliability.
* Design and maintain disaster\-recovery and business\-continuity capabilities.
* Ensure critical systems can be restored following equipment failure, cyber incidents, or disasters.

Cybersecurity \& Risk Management

* Establish and oversee organizational cybersecurity practices.
* Manage cybersecurity initiatives and grant\-funded security programs.
* Coordinate penetration testing and vulnerability assessments.
* Coordinate cybersecurity requirements with the organization's cyber insurance provider.
* Ensure identified vulnerabilities are evaluated and remediated.
* Maintain appropriate security controls for servers, networks, endpoints, cloud systems, and identities.
* Oversee physical electronic access control systems.

Budget, Procurement, Contracts \& Vendors

* Review and approve technology purchases.
* Establish technology standards for organizational purchases.
* Evaluate technology products and services.
* Manage vendor relationships.
* Manage maintenance agreements, subscriptions, licensing, and renewals.
* Coordinate vendor support and escalation when required.
* Plan for technology lifecycle and replacement costs.

Compliance, Audit \& Funding

* Serve as an organizational subject matter expert for E\-rate.
* Manage/coordinate E\-rate filing and supporting documentation.
* Provide technology and security documentation for the annual financial audit.
* Support cyber\-insurance documentation and compliance requirements.
* Maintain appropriate documentation demonstrating IT controls and security practices.
* Manage technology\-related grant programs and reporting requirements.

Application \& Library Technology Oversight

* Ensure reliable operation of the Integrated Library System.
* Coordinate ILS maintenance, upgrades, vendor support, integrations, and infrastructure.
* Oversee web hosting systems and applications.
* Ensure appropriate administration of Microsoft 365 and other organizational cloud services.
* Identify opportunities for automation and systems integration.

**REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**

IT Leadership \& Management

* Manage technical employees with different skill sets.
* Translate organizational needs into technology projects.
* Prioritize competing operational and project requirements.
* Delegate appropriately while maintaining accountability.
* Mentor technical staff and develop their capabilities.
* Manage vendors and technical support relationships.
* Evaluate technology purchases and contracts.
* Communicate technical issues to executive leadership, staff, libraries, auditors, vendors, and other nontechnical audiences.

Enterprise Infrastructure

* Server virtualization.
* VMware environments.
* Enterprise server and storage infrastructure.
* Windows Server.
* Linux/Ubuntu.
* Active Directory.
* DNS, DHCP, authentication, and other core infrastructure services.
* LAN/WAN networking.
* Enterprise Wi\-Fi and network management.
* Data\-center operations.
* Power, environmental monitoring, UPS, and generator systems.

Microsoft Cloud Services

* Microsoft 365
* Entra ID
* Exchange Online
* Azure
* Identity and access management
* Multifactor authentication
* User and group administration
* Cloud security and permissions

Cybersecurity

* Endpoint protection/XDR.
* Vulnerability management.
* Patch management.
* Penetration testing.
* Network security.
* Server hardening.
* Identity security.
* MFA and access controls.
* Cybersecurity incident response.
* Backup protection and ransomware recovery.
* Cyber\-insurance requirements.
* Security risk assessment.

* Recovery documentation.

Integrated Library Systems \& Library Technology

**We Are Teva**
---------------


We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world\-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high\-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. * AWS and Heroku
* GA4 (web analytics)
* Enterprise data lakes

* Comfort working across time zones with EU/IM markets

Concord Academy, a boarding and day school for grades 9 through 12, is located in historic Concord, Massachusetts, less than 20 miles from Boston. Known for its intellectually curious students, accomplished faculty, and deeply relational approach to education, CA is creating a new director of technology position to provide dedicated internal leadership for a technology program long supported by school employees, department leaders, and external partners. For an accomplished technology leader, this is an opportunity to join a distinctive school at an important moment, build from a dependable foundation, and help to connect different technology initiatives at the school under one roof.  

For more than a decade, two internal technology professionals and a team of professionals from OunceIT, CA’s longtime managed\-service provider, have worked together to maintain daily service, advance infrastructure, guide systems work, and develop substantial institutional knowledge. jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Sr. Staff Technical Program Manager, ESS


**Location:** San Francisco Bay area, CA


**Department:** ESS Engineering


**Reports to:** CTO


**Position Type:** Full\-time

  


**About the Company**



Peak Energy is the first American venture to advance globally proven Sodium\-Ion battery systems as the storage standard for the new era of renewable energy on a resilient grid.



Sodium\-Ion is cheap, readily available and safe, making it the leading contender in a rapidly evolving market.



Our leadership team is powered by decades of expertise in scaling gigawatt\-level innovation at world\-class companies such as Tesla, Northvolt, SunPower, Fluence, and Enovix. We are backed by strategic investment and product partners such as TDK Ventures and Eclipse Ventures.



We are a team of engineers, operators, entrepreneurs, and partners driven by a shared ambition to set the new performance standard for renewable energy and grid resilience.

  


**About the Role** **– Sr. Staff Technical Program Manager**



Peak Energy is looking for a Sr. Staff Technical Program Manager to lead the end\-to\-end development and delivery of our sodium\-ion energy storage systems across hardware and software.



Reporting to the CTO, this leader will serve as a key partner to the technical leadership team, helping translate company and product priorities into clear development plans, driving critical technical decisions, and ensuring risks and dependencies are surfaced and resolved early.



You will build and lead a lean team of Technical Program Managers while remaining close to the work. The right candidate will be comfortable operating at multiple levels: shaping the overall product\-development operating model, coaching TPMs, leading critical programs directly, and engaging deeply enough in technical discussions to improve the quality and speed of decision\-making.

  


**What** **You'll** **Do (****Responsibilities****)**


* Own integrated program execution from architecture and requirements through verification, industrialization, and customer delivery.
* Build, lead, and develop Peak's Technical Program Management team.
* Partner with the CTO and engineering leaders to translate product strategy into clear priorities, plans, milestones, and decisions.
* Drive system\-level integration across ESS hardware, cells, software, firmware, manufacturing, supply chain, and field deployment.
* Lead cross\-functional trade\-offs involving performance, safety, reliability, cost, scope, schedule, and manufacturability.
* Establish clear requirements, interfaces, verification plans, release criteria, and program ownership.
* Identify and resolve technical, organizational, and schedule risks before they become critical.
* Provide clear, decision\-oriented communication to executive leadership.
* Build lightweight, scalable program processes that improve execution without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Step directly into critical or off\-track programs when hands\-on leadership is needed.


**What You'll Bring (****Qualifications****)**


* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field.
* 12\+ years leading complex technical programs or product\-development organizations.
* Experience taking hardware or software\-enabled hardware products from concept through production.
* Experience building and leading teams of Technical Program Managers or equivalent technical leaders.
* Strong technical judgment across system architecture, requirements, integration, verification, and production readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to lead difficult trade\-offs across technical and business constraints.
* Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and drive accountability without direct authority.
* Ability to operate across strategy, organizational leadership, and hands\-on execution in a fast\-paced environment.
* Eligible to work in the United States.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience in battery energy storage, electric vehicles, robotics, aerospace, industrial equipment, or another complex hardware industry.
* Familiarity with battery systems, embedded software, controls, power electronics, energy management systems, or grid integration.
* Experience in safety\-critical, regulated, or reliability\-intensive product development.
* Experience scaling products and organizations from early development through production and commercial deployment.
* Experience partnering closely with a CTO, VP of Engineering, or equivalent technical executive.

  



Peak Energy is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We strongly encourage women, people of color, and individuals from underrepresented groups to apply. We value skills, potential, and perspective over specific credentials. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't look perfect on paper, we still want to hear from you.


**Our Core Values**


* **Speed Through Focus** \- Move fast but understand why. Focus on the goal, don't sacrifice quality.
* **Mission Over Self** \- It's about the greater good; confident humility. Take ownership and accountability.
* **Face the Brutal Truth** \- Transparency, honesty, big picture curiosity. Fearless decision making.
* **Be a Good Person** \- Kindness, collaboration and teamwork.

  


**Compensation \& Benefits**



The salary range for this role is $200,000\-$260,000, with actual pay varying based on work location, experience, and skills. Our competitive benefits package includes:


* Flexible time off
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Strong 401(k) plan
* Equity opportunities
* Many great work perks


Join us to thrive in a supportive environment while making a meaningful impact in the energy sector!

jobs.title: Director of IT - Restaurant Systems
jobs.description:
We’re not just another chicken joint—we’re one of the fastest\-growing brands in the game, built on hand\-made food and bold ambition. At Slim Chickens, every tenderloin gets the royal treatment: brined, buttermilk\-soaked, hand\-breaded, and cooked fresh to order. That same care and craft goes into how we grow our people.


If you’ve got hustle, heart, and an entrepreneurial spark, this is the place to prove yourself and shape your career. Our team thrives on real connection—working fast, thinking big, and building something that makes an impact every day. Here, you’ll be trusted to make decisions, empowered to own your work, and part of a crew that’s taking this brand to the next level.


Slim Chickens is growing fast. The only question is—are you ready to grow with us?

**PURPOSE OF THE POSITION**


As the Director, IT Restaurant Systems at Slim Chickens, you're responsible for establishing the company's IT strategy and roadmap for restaurant technology, leading and project managing core restaurant technology projects, and overseeing day\-to\-day support, implementation, and management of the company's technology infrastructure at both the restaurant and corporate levels, including but not limited to Point of Sale, Back Office, and related systems.




**ESSENTIAL POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Technology/Software Implementation**

* Leads the IT strategy and roadmap for all restaurant technology (POS, BOH, Digital Menu Boards, Mobile App, etc.) to comprehensively plan and lead future technology initiatives and projects that meet company objectives.
* Leads execution and project management of all core IT projects end to end, from initial concept and strategy through development, testing, pilot, deployment, and post\-deployment support, including internal resources, contractors, and vendors.
* Leads the implementation of the company's POS and Back Office technology solutions with minimal disruption to operations.
* Leads and manages an IT Support Analyst team (2 FTEs) overseeing all POS and Back Office database management, including but not limited to menu items (core and LTOs), inventory, and labor management.

jobs.description:
**Hope Mission Statement**


The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long\-term solutions.

**Position Purpose and Summary**


Our interim housing sites are a connection point for participants, staff, community partners; and funders who set expectations for excellence. The Program Manager is responsible for all of it.


Reporting to the Director of Interim Housing or Senior Director of Programs, the Program Manager is the main leader at the site level. They are responsible for day\-to\-day operations, supervising staff, keeping participants safe, and making sure the site meets all contract requirements. This role sets the standard for how services are delivered, how staff show up, and how the site runs — not just during regular hours, but across every shift, in every interaction, and under the close watch of every funder. When something goes wrong, the Program Manager responds. When paperwork falls short, the Program Manager fixes it. When a participant's path to permanent housing slows down, the Program Manager makes sure the team has what it needs to move things forward.


This role covers a lot of ground. It includes managing people, monitoring compliance, responding to incidents, coordinating across departments, representing the organization in the community, and overseeing services that keep participants at the center. All of this happens in programs that run around the clock and serve people dealing with serious instability. That is not by accident. Interim housing is complex, and the Program Manager is the person Hope the Mission trusts to lead it well. The quality of leadership at this level determines whether HTM's sites are places where people feel safe, supported, and moving toward something better — or just places where people stay.

Company Description

Deen Capital is a quantitative investment manager specializing in U.S. public equities, combining data-driven research with an ethics lens informed by Islamic investing principles. The firm uses systematic, rules-based multi-factor models—such as quality, value, momentum, and profitability—to guide stock selection and risk management. Deen Capital applies Islamic-principled screens to avoid businesses that conflict with Islamic ethics and to limit exposure to excessive leverage and interest-centric activities. Its investment process emphasizes risk-aware portfolio construction, diversification, liquidity considerations, and disciplined drawdown management, supported by transparent and continuously tested research. Deen Capital serves investors and advisors seeking U.S. equity exposure managed with quantitative rigor and faith-aligned values.

The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) is a full-time, remote role responsible for setting and executing the firm’s technology vision in support of quantitative investment and operations. Day-to-day responsibilities include overseeing technical architecture, guiding product development roadmaps, and ensuring robust, secure, and scalable systems across the firm’s technology stack. The CTO will manage technology projects end-to-end, collaborate closely with investment, operations, and compliance teams, and establish best practices for documentation, testing, and deployment. jobs.description:
About Concord Technologies

Our fax-delivery suite of products allows our clients to exchange millions of patient information, insurance and other documents safely, swiftly and securely every business day. Concord’s use of Artificial Intelligence, analytics, and other cutting-edge technology also analyzes the data being transferred within a fax, then delivers it into the right inboxes and workflows, fundamentally changing how data moves.

More than 2,300 healthcare organizations, financial providers, and companies in other equally document-intensive industries trust Concord to deliver their confidential and sensitive information. We care about our customers, and with a retention rate of more than 98%, it’s clear they love the service and value we provide.

We have been in business since 1996 and growing faster than ever. Our products are getting smarter, our customers are getting bigger, and our user community is exploding. To continue meeting market demand and anticipating our customers’ needs, we are expanding our offerings. That means assembling a world-class team to take us through this next phase of growth. We hope you’d like to join us!

About The Role

Concord is seeking a Senior Security Program Manager to bring structure, visibility , and

disciplined execution to our enterprise security program. Reporting to the CISO, this role

serves as the CISO's operational partner and leads Concord's security program

management office (PMO) function, acting as the connective tissue between security

strategy and execution across Concord's distributed security functions. In this role, you

will serve as Concord's: 1) Security Program & Portfolio Lead- responsible for the

planning, coordination, and delivery of enterprise security , compliance, and customer

trust initiatives across the enterprise, and 2) Security Governance & Operations Lead-

establishing the governance forums, processes, metrics, and financial management

practices that give leadership clear , credible, and timely insight into security program

performance, risk posture, and investment. This role requires strong program

management, facilitation, and communication skills, working knowledge of security and

compliance frameworks, and the ability to influence without direct authority in a

regulated healthcare technology environment.

Essential Functions

Security Program & Cross-Functional Execution

Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of enterprise security initiatives across Concord's distributed security functions, spanning strategic security , compliance, and customer trust priorities
Own the integrated security roadmap and project portfolio, translating strategic objectives into sequenced milestones, workstreams, decision points, and measurable outcomes
Manage project intake, prioritization, and scheduling for security initiatives, as well as IT and business-owned projects with security interests
Coordinate dependencies, handoffs, and critical path activities related to security initiatives across the enterprise, working with partner functions such as Technology, Product, Engineering, Legal, Privacy , Compliance, Operations, and Finance
Identify, track, and manage risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies, and proactively escalate critical obstacles associated with all security-related projects and initiatives
Drive accountability and execution discipline across initiative owners and delivery partners without becoming the project manager for every individual effort

Security Governance, Change Management & Cross-Functional Visibility

Implement and lead a Security Change Advisory Board (CAB) to review , assess, and approve security-relevant changes across Concord's environments
Establish and facilitate security governance committees and leadership reviews, with clearly defined decision rights, escalation paths, and operating rhythms
Maintain disciplined tracking of decisions and action items to ensure security priorities are effectively assessed, communicated, and managed
Develop and maintain security metrics, KPIs/KRIs, and executive dashboards that provide actionable insight into security program performance, risk posture, compliance status, and progress against strategic initiatives
Prepare EL T reporting, executive updates, and decision materials that synthesize complex program information into clear , concise narratives

Security Process, Documentation & Program Enablement

Lead the development, standardization, and maintenance of security processes, procedures, standards, playbooks, RACI matrices, operating models, and program documentation across Concord's distributed security functions
Establish consistent program management methodologies, reporting practices, and delivery expectations across security functions
Identify process gaps and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance consistency , accountability , scalability , operational efficiency , and overall security program maturity

Cross-Functional Security Planning, Budget & Operational Management

Support the CISO in the planning, coordination, and management of the security operating plan, vendor portfolio (including contracts, licensing, and renewals), resource allocation and capacity , and operational priorities
Manage the security budget lifecycle in partnership with Finance, including annual planning, forecasting, variance analysis, and spend reporting, to provide financial visibility and accountability
Coordinate annual and quarterly planning activities and help prioritize security investments and resources based on business objectives, risk, compliance requirements, and strategic priorities
Develop business cases and ROI analyses to support security investment decisions and ensure spending remains aligned with approved budgets, program objectives, and organizational priorities

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information T echnology , Cybersecurity , Business Administration, Project Management, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
7+ years of program or project management experience, including at least 4 years supporting Information Security , IT , or technology risk initiatives
Experience building or leading PMO, governance, or portfolio management functions, including steering committees, change advisory boards, or executive governance forums
Working knowledge of cybersecurity and regulatory frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, HIP AA, HITRUST , SOC 2, and PCI-DSS
Familiarity with core security domains (identity and access management, vulnerability management, detection and response, cloud security , data loss prevention) and IT infrastructure concepts sufficient to engage credibly with technical teams
Experience managing budgets, forecasting, variance analysis, vendor portfolios, and purchase order processes, including developing business cases and ROI analyses
Demonstrated experience developing KPIs/KRIs, dashboards, and executive reporting that leaders can act on
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create crisp executive updates, one-pagers, and decision materials for EL T audiences
Excellent f acilitation skills and a proven ability to influence without direct authority and align stakeholders across a matrixed, distributed organization
Strong understanding of Agile, W aterf all, and hybrid delivery methodologies, with hands-on experience using tools such as Jira, Power BI, or Microsoft Project
Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing structure, sequencing, and clarity to complex work
Experience in healthcare IT or another highly regulated industry preferred
At least one relevant certification (PMP , P gMP , CISSP , CISM, or equivalent) required; both project management and security certifications preferred

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

The opportunity

EY-Parthenon’s unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity.

With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, Boards, Private Equity and Governments every step of the way – enabling you to shape your future with confidence.

Within EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution sub service line, the Deal Technology practice works on the most complex and high-profile global transactions, across a broad portfolio of clients and industry sectors. We are a group of experienced industry professionals with a background in IT who are serial transaction advisers, which enables us to bring a wealth of deep sector and functional knowledge to our clients. This role is focused on advising the Private Equity sector. As a team, we prepare and execute separation and integration plans, identify ideas and sources of value enhancement, as well as advise on risk mitigation and the successful change of operations, functions, and people.

Significant management consulting experience.
Excellent analytical skills and the confidence to translate complex data into meaningful insights.

Experience in business integrations, divestitures, and/or carve-outs with a demonstrated aptitude for quantitative and qualitative analysis.
Experience leading and managing in complex business environments.
The ability to synthesize approaches to complex integration/divestiture conflicts.
Excellent negotiation and influencing skills, and the ability to develop long-lasting relationships both internally and externally.
Expertise in a minimum of 4 of the following IT skillsets:

IT strategy
Enterprise architecture
Infrastructure and cloud architecture
Cyber and IAM architecture
Digital Technology Strategy
Digital IT operating model transformation
IT cost reduction
IT security / cyber
IT shared services
IT organization transformation
ERP implementation
Digital business enablement using digital technology enablers (i.e., advanced analytics, robotic process automation, virtual reality)
Cloud SaaS or PaaS (including Collaboration) strategy and delivery
Cloud IaaS or Data Center migration planning and execution
Identity and Access Management (IAM) / Active Directory services strategy
IT service management
Operations Center (e.g., NOC, SOC) or Managed Service Provider
IT TSA development
IT finance management
IT infrastructure management
IT outsourcing / offshoring
IT contract management
IT or Cyber Diligence
IT synergy identification
Data governance, separation, and transition
Integration and Separation Planning
Experience with and demonstrated success in at least one key business process such as procurement to pay, record to report, order to cash, plan to make, hire to retire.
Certifications in Agile, ITIL, PMP, Six Sigma, CISSP or CISA highly desired.
You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.
The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you will have

A proven record of excellence in an IT transactions role.
Experience gained within another large professional services organization.
Knowledge of how to leverage firm-approved AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot.
Established networking skills in a relevant industry.

What We Look For

We’re interested in talented professionals with the ability to visualize our clients’ goals, “think like an investor,” and think creatively to facilitate them. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, and a genuine passion for taking on new challenges, this role is for you.

What We Offer You

Manage a portfolio of system implementation projects from design through deployment and support, including SAP and non-SAP solutions, integrations with Amazon Corporate systems, third-party solutions, and bespoke development.

jobs.title: Director Superconducting Technology Architect
jobs.description:
The Superconducting Technology Architect is a Director-level technical leadership role within the GF Labs Technology Architecture organization. This role defines and advances foundry platforms for superconducting qubits, Josephson-junction digital logic, cryogenic control and readout, and related integration. The position requires deep technical expertise, platform leadership, and the ability to translate emerging system requirements into scalable, manufacturable technologies.

Job Summary

The Superconducting Technology Architect leads the definition, development, and delivery of superconducting quantum and digital technologies and associated customer programs. The position integrates device, process, design, test, packaging, foundry operations, and program execution; guides internal and external R&D; and serves as a senior technical and customer-facing authority for GF leadership and partners.

Essential Responsibilities

Develop and influence long-term roadmaps for superconducting qubits, SFQ-family digital logic, cryogenic control and readout, parametric amplifiers, interconnect, and packaging.
Translate customer and system requirements into materials, process flows, device structures, design rules, PDK content, test vehicles, and acceptance criteria.
Shape manufacturable qubit technologies spanning Josephson junctions, resonators, couplers, readout, low-loss materials and interfaces, coherence, fidelity, variability, and yield.
Define scalable digital platforms, including RSFQ, ERSFQ/eSFQ, RQL, and AQFP, addressing junction uniformity, timing, wiring, inductance, power, memory, thermal budgets, and cryogenic I/O.
Lead process integration, experiments, simulations, tape-outs, cryogenic characterization, technology transfer, qualification, and new-product introduction across superconducting logic, qubits, cryo-CMOS, multi-chip modules, TSVs, flip-chip, and heterogeneous integration.
Build and govern internal and external development programs with customers, universities, research organizations, government laboratories, suppliers, and startups, including technical scope, proposals and estimates, milestones, schedules, budgets, IP, and transition plans.
Lead multidisciplinary engineering and program teams; recruit and mentor talent; drive quality, schedule, budget, and customer commitments; and communicate architecture choices, execution status, risks, and investment priorities to customers and GF executives.
Drive foundry operational improvement through cycle-time reduction, SPC and control-plan maturity, manufacturing systems, process quality, program reviews, and schedule-risk reduction.
Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.

Required Qualifications

Education: MS or PhD in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, Materials Science, or a related discipline.
Years of Experience: 15+ years in semiconductor technology, superconducting electronics, quantum hardware, or advanced process integration, including leadership of complex technology programs.
Deep expertise in Josephson-junction devices, superconducting qubits and/or digital logic, cryogenic operation, RF/microwave circuits, materials and interface loss, and device-to-system tradeoffs.
Demonstrated success translating architectures into foundry processes and transferring technologies from research into fabrication, qualification, or manufacturing, with ownership of quality, schedule, budget, and customer deliverables.
Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering and program organizations and strategic collaborations across customers, research organizations, suppliers, startups, and matrixed internal functions.
Percentage of travel: 20%.

Preferred Qualifications

PhD with industrial experience in superconducting qubits, superconducting digital electronics, Josephson-junction fabrication, or cryogenic system integration.
Experience with transmon-class qubits, microwave resonators, control/readout, parametric amplifiers, decoherence mechanisms, and cryogenic measurement.
Experience with SFQ-family circuit design, simulation, layout, timing, and 3D electromagnetic modeling; familiarity with RQL is beneficial.
Knowledge of superconducting materials and junction processes, multi-chip modules, thermal or superconducting TSVs, flip-chip interconnect, heterogeneous integration, cryo-CMOS, cryocoolers, wafer-scale integration, and cryogenic packaging.
Experience with proposal development, technical basis-of-estimate, integrated schedules, Agile execution, manufacturing systems, SPC, control plans, and customer or executive program reviews.

jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, IGA is a senior technical and client-facing leadership role focused on driving Identity Governance and Administration engagements from strategy through execution, with SailPoint and Saviynt as core platforms of expertise. This role requires the ability to lead technical architecture design sessions directly with clients – translating complex governance, compliance, and identity lifecycle requirements into scalable IGA target-state architectures. While IGA is the primary focus, the ideal candidate also brings working knowledge of adjacent IAM domains, including Privileged Access Management (PAM) and Access Management (SSO/MFA), to design cohesive, end-to-end identity solutions. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, architect enterprise-grade IGA solutions, and lead cross-functional delivery teams, while also contributing to business development, proposal development, and practice growth.

Key Responsibilities

Lead technical architecture design sessions directly with clients, translating business, security, and compliance requirements into scalable IGA target-state architectures.
Architect and oversee end-to-end implementation of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions using SailPoint and Saviynt as primary platforms.
Design and lead delivery of core IGA capabilities, including identity lifecycle management (Joiner/Mover/Leaver), access certification/attestation campaigns, role-based access control (RBAC) and role mining, Segregation of Duties (SoD) policy design, entitlement management, and access request/approval workflows.
Lead application onboarding strategy for IGA platforms, including source/target connector design, birthright and non-birthright provisioning, and integration with authoritative HR sources
Define and implement IGA governance frameworks, including policy design, audit and compliance reporting, and global configuration/data segmentation best practices.
Working knowledge of adjacent IAM domains – Privileged Access Management (PAM, e.g., CyberArk, Delinea) and Access Management (SSO/MFA via Entra ID, Okta, Ping) – to ensure IGA architectures integrate cleanly across the broader identity ecosystem.
Own end-to-end delivery for engagements, managing scope, timelines, technical quality, and client satisfaction.
Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, running architecture workshops, discovery sessions, and executive-level readouts.
Develop maturity assessments, governance roadmaps, and target operating models tailored to client environments and industry (e.g., healthcare, higher education, financial services).
Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and career development to IAM engineers, architects, and consultants on the delivery team.
Partner with sales and account teams on business development activities, including solution scoping, proposal/SOW development, and technical presentations for prospective clients.
Advise clients on regulatory and compliance considerations (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR) as they relate to identity governance controls, certifications, and audits.
Monitor emerging IGA trends and best practices (including AI-driven governance) and champion their adoption across client engagements.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
10+ years of hands-on IAM experience with a strong concentration in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), including consulting or client-facing delivery, and at least 3-5 years in a technical leadership or architecture role.
Deep, hands-on expertise architecting and implementing SailPoint and Saviynt, including certification campaigns, RBAC/SoD design, connector configuration, and workflow customization.
Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management, entitlement governance, access certification processes, and provisioning/de-provisioning across enterprise applications.
Working knowledge of PAM concepts and platforms (e.g., CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust) and Access Management/SSO technologies (e.g., Entra ID, Okta, Ping) sufficient to architect integrated IAM solutions.
Proven ability to lead technical architecture discussions and design sessions directly with client stakeholders, including CISOs and IT leadership.
Solid understanding of identity protocols and standards, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and LDAP.
Experience managing project resources, timelines, and deliverables across multiple concurrent engagements.
Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing technical teams, with strong people leadership skills.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and executive audiences.
Relevant certifications strongly preferred (e.g., CISSP, CISM, SailPoint Certified, Saviynt Certified Professional).

You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Position Summary

The Human Rights Campaign is a large, national nonprofit civil rights and advocacy organization working to advance equality for LGBTQ+ people. Technology is essential to that work. It enables our staff to organize, advocate, collaborate, and work effectively with partners, volunteers, and communities nationwide.

As Director, IT Operations, you will lead the technology environment that makes that work possible: secure, reliable, well-managed, and easy to use. Reporting to the VP of IT & Data Analytics, who leads enterprise technology strategy and digital transformation, you will serve as HRC’s technical and IT operations leader. You will translate strategy into a practical technology roadmap and lead IT operations, service delivery, enterprise systems, workplace and event technology, operational security, the internal IT team, and our managed service and technology partners.

This is a broad, hands-on operational leadership role in a lean nonprofit setting, not an infrastructure specialty. Success in this role requires balancing strategy, service delivery, vendor management, operational leadership, and technical decision-making. While technical credibility is important, the role is not intended to personally perform all engineering, administration, or support work. Instead, the Director is responsible for ensuring successful outcomes through a combination of internal staff, managed service partners, and other technology vendors.

We are looking for a leader who combines technical credibility with strong people leadership, clear communication, sound judgment, and a commitment to excellent service.

You will build trusted relationships with business owners and internal stakeholders, help teams navigate technology and process changes, simplify and modernize our technology environment, strengthen the IT team and its operating practices, and ensure technology effectively supports HRC’s mission.

Position Responsibilities:

IT Leadership & Modernization
Develop and execute an IT operations and modernization roadmap aligned with organizational priorities, informed by strong partnerships with program owners and internal stakeholders.
Serve as the senior technical advisor for IT operations, evaluating technical options, dependencies, risks, and vendor recommendations.
Lead efforts to simplify legacy and overlapping technologies and advance a secure, cloud-first operating environment.

IT Operations & Service Delivery
Lead day-to-day IT operations across identity and access, endpoints, cloud and infrastructure, productivity and collaboration platforms, and IT-managed enterprise applications.
Ensure effective delivery of technology services through a combination of internal staff, managed service providers, security partners, and technology vendors, establishing clear ownership, accountability, and service expectations.
Establish and mature IT service management practices, including incident, problem, change, knowledge, and asset management, with clear service standards, accountability, and governance. Ensure technology changes are communicated, documented, and managed to reduce operational risk and improve coordination across internal teams and technology partners.
Drive root-cause analysis and durable resolution of recurring technical and service issues.
Lead technical planning and execution for migrations, integrations, upgrades, consolidation, and retirement of legacy technologies.
Ensure technology services are secure, reliable, and operationally ready, including appropriate lifecycle management, patching, backup, and disaster recovery.
Ensure reliable technology and AV support for hybrid meetings, Board meetings, and major organizational events through appropriate planning, resourcing, thorough testing, and coordination of internal and external support resources, providing hands-on support when necessary.

Vendor Management & Cybersecurity

Job Summary

BioCryst is a fast-growing pharmaceutical company seeking an experienced Associate Director, IT Business - Partner Pharmaceutical Development to build and mature strategic partnerships across Development. The role supports Program & Portfolio Management, Clinical Development / Operations, Biometrics, Pharmacology / Non-Clinical, Regulatory, Safety, and Medical Affairs. The IT Business Partner will understand functional strategies and operating needs, translate them into technology roadmaps and prioritized initiatives, and enable compliant, scalable process and system improvements across the development lifecycle. This role serves as a strategic technology advisor and delivery leader, with responsibility for business analysis, program and project leadership, solution design, data and integration strategy, vendor management, adoption, and ongoing application support. The role requires working knowledge of key Development platforms and capabilities, including Veeva RIM, Veeva CTMS, ReadCube, clinical data visualization and analytics solutions, and the Oracle Argus safety system. Please note: this role can be remote working east coast with a strong preference for the Boston, MA area.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Serve as the primary IT Business Partner and trusted technology advisor for Program & Portfolio Management, Clinical Development / Operations, Biometrics, Pharmacology / Non-Clinical, Regulatory, Safety, and Medical Affairs.
Build strong partnerships with functional leaders and subject matter experts to understand strategies, business capabilities, pain points, risks, and priorities.
Translate business priorities into multi-year technology roadmaps, business cases, demand plans, and sequenced delivery portfolios.
Lead demand intake, discovery, requirements definition, solution evaluation, prioritization, implementation, adoption, and value realization for Development technology initiatives.
Provide subject matter expertise for the selection, implementation, enhancement, integration, and support of Development applications and data capabilities.
Partner with business and IT stakeholders to optimize platforms including Veeva RIM, Veeva CTMS, ReadCube, clinical data visualization and analytics solutions, Oracle Argus, and related Development systems.
Develop a working understanding of Development processes and data flows, including clinical study operations, regulatory information and submissions, safety and pharmacovigilance, biometrics, non-clinical activities, processes, and medical information or evidence-generation needs.

Partner with Clinical, Biometrics, and Data and Analytics teams to improve access to trusted study information and strengthen clinical data visualization, reporting, and decision support.
Lead cross-functional programs and projects, managing scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, dependencies, decisions, communications, and executive-level status reporting.
Manage strategic technology vendors and managed service providers, including performance, service levels, delivery quality, contracts, and issue escalation.
Drive user adoption through stakeholder engagement, communications, training, process documentation, and change-management activities.
Monitor emerging technologies, including automation, analytics, and responsible AI, and recommend practical opportunities that support Development priorities and compliance expectations.

Perform other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
jobs.description:
**Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.**
------------------------------------------------------------


Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.  

  

Our AI\-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self\-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.  

  

As an AI\-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.


The Chief Information Security Officer will be responsible for defining, leading, and advancing Spring Health’s enterprise\-wide information security, technology risk, compliance, and IT strategy. This leader will ensure the protection of company assets, customer data, member data, provider data, and critical systems while enabling business growth, innovation, and operational scale.


Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, the CISO will lead the company’s Information Security, Compliance/GRC, and IT functions, including Security Operations, Application/Product Security, cloud and infrastructure security, identity and access management, third\-party risk, incident response, enterprise compliance, corporate IT, and business technology operations. This leader will manage and partner closely with senior security and IT leaders, including the VP, Information Security.


The CISO will serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership and the Board on cybersecurity risk, regulatory readiness, enterprise resilience, customer trust, and technology risk. They will play a critical role in Spring Health’s next phase of scale, including the integration of Alma, enterprise customer growth, AI transformation, international expansion, and readiness for future public\-company expectations.


This leader will be responsible for building a security and IT organization that enables the business, supports product velocity, protects sensitive healthcare data, and earns the trust of customers, members, providers, partners, regulators, and employees.


Please note that this is a **hybrid role based in either New York City or San Francisco**, with an expectation to be in the office 2–3 days per week. Candidates must be based in the NYC or SF metro areas or able to relocate independently within 90 days of their start date. Frequent travel will be required for leadership meetings and to visit various office locations.

**What You'll Do**

* Develop and execute Spring Health’s enterprise\-wide information security, compliance, technology risk, and IT strategy in alignment with company priorities, growth plans, and regulatory obligations.
* Lead the Information Security, Compliance/GRC, and IT organizations, including Security Operations, Application/Product Security, cloud and infrastructure security, enterprise compliance, corporate IT, identity and access management, and business technology operations.
* Partner closely with the CTO, executive leadership team, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, People, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure security and IT enable the business rather than create unnecessary friction.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership and the Board on cybersecurity risks, technology risk, regulatory readiness, incident response, enterprise resilience, customer trust, and security investments.
* Build and scale a high\-performing organization across security, compliance, and IT, including developing leaders, clarifying ownership, improving operating rhythms, and ensuring the team has the right structure, capabilities, and culture for Spring’s next stage of growth.
* Oversee enterprise security operations, including threat detection, vulnerability management, incident response, security monitoring, endpoint security, SIEM strategy, threat intelligence, and resilience exercises.
* Ensure Spring Health’s Application/Product Security and cloud security programs are deeply embedded in the software development lifecycle, including secure architecture, threat modeling, automated testing, vulnerability remediation, and security review processes.
* Own the enterprise compliance and information security risk management program, including risk assessments, risk registers, risk treatment plans, control frameworks, policy governance, and executive reporting.
* Ensure successful compliance outcomes across applicable frameworks and regulations, including HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, CCPA, and other healthcare, privacy, and security requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Privacy on data protection, privacy, regulatory obligations, Business Associate Agreements, customer commitments, breach assessment, notification obligations, and evolving healthcare security requirements.
* Lead security and IT strategy related to the Alma integration, including systems, data flows, access controls, compliance obligations, enterprise risk, provider/member/customer data protection, and long\-term operating model decisions.
* Define and govern Spring Health’s AI security strategy, including enterprise AI guardrails, approved tool usage, data classification, model/tool risk assessment, secure AI adoption, and protection of sensitive healthcare and business data.
* Oversee corporate IT and business technology operations, including employee technology experience, endpoint management, access lifecycle, SaaS

* Develop and execute Spring Health’s enterprise\-wide information security, compliance, technology risk, and IT strategy in alignment with company priorities, growth plans, and regulatory obligations.
* Lead the Information Security, Compliance/GRC, and IT organizations, including Security Operations, Application/Product Security, cloud and infrastructure security, enterprise compliance, corporate IT, identity and access management, and business technology operations.
* Partner closely with the CTO, executive leadership team, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, People, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure security and IT enable the business rather than create unnecessary friction.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership and the Board on cybersecurity risks, technology risk, regulatory readiness, incident response, enterprise resilience, customer trust, and security investments.
* Build and scale a high\-performing organization across security, compliance, and IT, including developing leaders, clarifying ownership, improving operating rhythms, and ensuring the team has the right structure, capabilities, and culture for Spring’s next stage of growth.
* Oversee enterprise security operations, including threat detection, vulnerability management, incident response, security monitoring, endpoint security, SIEM strategy, threat intelligence, and resilience exercises.
* Ensure Spring Health’s Application/Product Security and cloud security programs are deeply embedded in the software development lifecycle, including secure architecture, threat modeling, automated testing, vulnerability remediation, and security review processes.
* Own the enterprise compliance and information security risk management program, including risk assessments, risk registers, risk treatment plans, control frameworks, policy governance, and executive reporting.
* Ensure successful compliance outcomes across applicable frameworks and regulations, including HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, CCPA, and other healthcare, privacy, and security requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Privacy on data protection, privacy, regulatory obligations, Business Associate Agreements, customer commitments, breach assessment, notification obligations, and evolving healthcare security requirements.
* Lead security and IT strategy related to the Alma integration, including systems, data flows, access controls, compliance obligations, enterprise risk, provider/member/customer data protection, and long\-term operating model decisions.
* Define and govern Spring Health’s AI security strategy, including enterprise AI guardrails, approved tool usage, data classification, model/tool risk assessment, secure AI adoption, and protection of sensitive healthcare and business data.
* Oversee corporate IT and business technology operations, including employee technology experience, endpoint management, access lifecycle, SaaS

jobs.title: Senior Director, Information Technology
jobs.description:
Derby City Gaming \& Hotel boasts nearly 1,300 of the latest games, a grab\-n\-go restaurant, Oliver’s Chophouse \& Bourbon Bar, a Kentucky Derby\-themed hotel, and live music! The newly expanded Derby City Gaming \& Hotel was voted one of the “Best Places to Work in Greater Louisville” by Louisville Business First


**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------



The Regional Senior Director of IT is responsible for the strategic direction, implementation and delivery of IT infrastructure, services, and applications for Derby City Gaming. Critical aspects of this role include providing leadership, guidance, structure and employee development to the property IT team, documenting, adopting and implementing new processes, standardizing existing processes, and collaborating with stakeholders to align technology solutions with desired business outcomes.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------


* Maintains all system and application support for property.
* Collaborates with the CDI Corporate team office to implement IT initiatives.
* Work as a member of an internal or organizational project team to implement, deliver and integrate new business systems and processes.
* Manage timelines, expenses, and expectations of IT related projects.
* Maintain Derby City Gaming’s high\-quality guest service standards and represent our core values of Respect and Commitment.
* Adheres to and implements Corporate standards that are subject to audit.
* Monitor and respond to critical incidents, as required.
* Ability to author and maintain documentation for business\-critical IT systems.
* Cultivate and manage relationships with both internal and external partners, including, but not limited to reviewing service contracts, SLAs, and organizational policies.
* Responsible for property IT capital and operating budget planning, forecasting and financial reviews.
* Ability to inspire and develop their team to achieve their individual goals, team goals, and meet desired business outcomes.
* Ability to hold themselves and their team accountable for executing, delivering and implementation of technology services, with a focus on guest service and experience.

---------------------------------


* Strong written and verbal communication, critical thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong vendor management and negotiation skills.
* Ability to adapt to new and changing business environments.
* Excellent time management skills with demonstrated experience in managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, AWS Product Compliance Engineering
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced Sr. Technical Program Manager who will be responsible for providing global product compliance technical program management and leadership to ensure that all electrical, mechanical, material, and other regulated performance specifications are satisfied in all countries where AWS business exists or will expand.
  

  

AWS is at the forefront of providing a broad set of global cloud\-based services including compute, storage, databases, networking, and enterprise applications, to help organizations move faster, lower IT costs, and scale. You will be a part of a dynamic business within Amazon.com, and one of the world’s fastest growing and evolving companies, with a team of exceptionally talented, bright and innovative people. GTPC is responsible for ensuring that the infrastructure equipment necessary to support the AWS services are developed, imported, exported, and operated in a compliant manner across the global countries where AWS operates and will expand, including all product certification/safety regulations.  

  

  

  

Key job responsibilities  

You will be part of the AWS Product Compliance Engineering team within AWS Global Trade and Regulatory Compliance team (GTPC) that collaborates with Datacenter Engineering, Product Engineering, Compliance Engineers, Regulatory Analyst, legal, trade strategy, and supply chain to implement compliance specifications and policies, provide product compliance support during product development, builds compliance programs to support AWS Datacenter Engineering, Design Engineering, Power Generations, Advanced Robotics, Region Service Business, and Health \& Safety businesses including Datacenter Basis of Design (BOD) lifecycle management, hardware technology development and deployment, new region planning and launches. You will develop compliance specification and plan, troubleshoot and resolve compliance issues that arise in the course of AWS’s NPI and other business processes.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

  

* End\-to\-end compliance program ownership for AWS datacenter infrastructure equipment — including compute, storage, networking, security hardware, power and cooling infrastructure, and advanced robotics — ensuring all products meet applicable safety, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), security, energy efficiency, and material compliance requirements and approvals across global jurisdictions.
* Drive compliance specification development and execution for new and existing infrastructure products, defining compliance requirements, test plans, certification timelines, and acceptance criteria.
* Own the compliance critical path and overall strategy for AWS hardware deployments, proactively identifying risks, resolving blockers, and ensuring compliance milestones are met to support on\-time regional launches.
* Provide compliance engineering support during New Product Introduction (NPI), partnering with hardware engineering teams to embed compliance\-by\-design principles early in the product development lifecycle.
* Collaborate across multiple stakeholder organizations including Datacenter Engineering (DCE), Annapurna, Hardware Engineering, AWS Infra Service Supply Chain, Compliance Engineers, Regulatory Analysts, Legal, Trade Strategy, and Health \& Safety (H\&S) to implement compliance specifications and policies.
* Build and manage integrated compliance program plans that align engineering development milestones with certification timelines, supply chain readiness, and regional launch schedules.
* Drive stakeholder alignment and escalation management across VP\-level leadership, ensuring compliance risks and tradeoffs are communicated clearly and resolved decisively.
* Build scalable, sustainable compliance processes that improve operational efficiency, reduce cycle time for certifications, and enhance compliance coverage across the growing AWS infrastructure portfolio.
* Drive continuous improvement in compliance program execution through mechanisms, automation, and tooling enhancements.

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------
