jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our GDSCM team, focusing on the Basis of Design (BOD) and Programmatic Design Change Management (PDCM) programs. This role requires deep technical expertise across multiple engineering disciplines and the ability to evaluate complex design changes across 300+ in-flight projects.

As a Technical Program Manager, you will serve as a technical expert evaluating design change requests across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, architectural, controls, plumbing, fire protection, and thermal systems. You will conduct feasibility analyses, coordinate technical reviews with principal engineers across all disciplines, and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of design changes from initiation through implementation.

You will work closely with Design Engineering, Construction Management, Procurement, Finance, and Product teams to ensure design changes are properly vetted, funded, and executed.

Key job responsibilities

Technical Design Evaluation

Evaluate complex design changes across multiple engineering disciplines including electrical power distribution, mechanical cooling systems, structural loads, civil site work, architectural layouts, controls systems, plumbing infrastructure, and fire protection systems
Analyze technical specifications, construction drawings, equipment datasheets, and system integration requirements to assess design change feasibility and impact
Understand and explain the complexity of data center designs including power distribution from utility to rack level, cooling system architectures, backup power systems, and building infrastructure
Identify technical dependencies and cross-discipline impacts when evaluating proposed design changes
Assess constructability, maintainability, and operational implications of design modifications
Review and validate technical calculations including electrical load calculations, cooling capacity requirements, structural load analysis, and hydraulic calculations

Design Change Management

Manage portfolio of design changes across multiple in-flight projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities and technical requirements
Conduct feasibility analyses and production readiness assessments for proposed design changes, evaluating technical risk, schedule impact, and cost implications
Coordinate technical reviews with principal engineers across mechanical, electrical, structural, civil, architectural, controls, plumbing, and fire protection disciplines
Develop and maintain implementation plans, tracking design change execution from approval through site deployment
Present design change recommendations and cost implications to senior leadership, clearly articulating technical complexity and business impact
Evaluate design improvements and innovations, assessing their applicability across the global portfolio

Cross-Discipline Collaboration

Partner with Electrical Engineers on power distribution design, generator sizing, UPS configurations, switchgear specifications, and high-voltage systems
Collaborate with Mechanical Engineers on cooling system design, HVAC configurations, piping layouts, and thermal management strategies
Work with Structural Engineers on foundation design, seismic requirements, equipment support structures, and building loads
Engage with Civil Engineers on site grading, stormwater management, utility routing, and site infrastructure
Coordinate with Architectural teams on building layouts, space planning, and building envelope design
Interface with Controls Engineers on building management systems, monitoring systems, and automation strategies
Partner with Fire Protection Engineers on fire suppression systems, detection systems, and life safety requirements

Stakeholder Coordination

Partner with Design Management teams to understand project-specific requirements, constraints, and technical challenges
Collaborate with Finance teams on cost validation, funding strategies, and budget tracking for design changes
Work with Construction Management and Procurement teams to assess schedule impacts, supply chain constraints, and constructability
Engage with Product and Solutions teams to evaluate new equipment, emerging technologies, and design approaches
Coordinate with Commissioning teams to ensure design changes support testing and startup requirements

Process Improvement

Identify opportunities to streamline design change workflows and reduce execution timelines while maintaining technical rigor
Develop and maintain technical documentation including standard operating procedures, design standards, technical specifications, and RACI matrices
Contribute to automation initiatives and tooling improvements for design change management
Support integration of cost validation frameworks and bulk funding mechanisms

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon that powers AWS's machine learning infrastructure, including the Trainium and Inferentia chip families. Our next\-generation ML accelerator is a multi\-die chiplet using advanced 2nm and 3nm process nodes with state\-of\-the\-art packaging technology, and it is the most complex hardware program Amazon has undertaken. We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own end\-to\-end program execution for this chip, from RTL freeze through tape\-out and into production readiness.  

  

This is not a status\-reporting role. You will be the person who connects a sprawling set of engineering workstreams into a single coherent schedule, identifies the real critical path week to week, and drives the cross\-functional decisions that keep the program on track. The program spans multiple concurrent silicon development efforts with significant interdependencies across engineering disciplines, external partners, and infrastructure.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Own the integrated schedule and critical path analysis across multiple die tape\-outs through engineering samples and production ramp. Understand dependency chains deeply enough to calculate the impact of any slip or pull\-in, and update the timeline weekly with real data.  

Drive the weekly chip status cadence by synthesizing inputs from RTL/DV, physical design, packaging, power, infrastructure, and post\-silicon teams into a single view that tells leadership where we actually stand, including what is getting worse and what needs action.  

Track verification convergence as a leading indicator by monitoring the progression from feature completion through RTL closure, bug trends, and regression pass rates by block. Recognize when convergence is stalling and drive the engineering response before downstream milestones are affected.  

Manage the external design partner interface, owning the netlist delivery calendar, tracking your partner's physical design timeline, and negotiating schedule trades with a clear understanding of downstream cost.  

Drive infrastructure readiness and external IP delivery by partnering with compute and EDA platform teams on capacity planning, and tracking third\-party PHY, memory interface, and controller IP deliveries against consuming blocks to escalate gaps before they become tape\-out critical.  

  

A day in the life  

You start your morning reviewing verification convergence dashboards and regression results, spotting a block where bug closure rates haven't flattened. You pull the DV lead and RTL owner into a quick sync to agree on a recovery plan before the weekly chip status review. In that review, you walk leadership through an updated critical path that reflects a netlist delivery shift from your external design partner, quantifying the downstream impact on tape\-out timing. After lunch, you join an infrastructure capacity review to confirm that compute clusters can handle the regression load through freeze, then close out the day preparing an executive summary for an upcoming program milestone review.  

  

About the team  

The Annapurna Labs ML Accelerator team builds the Trainium and Inferentia silicon that trains and serves machine learning models across AWS. We work at the intersection of chip architecture, physical design, verification, and infrastructure to deliver products that push the boundaries of performance and efficiency for our customers. Our team values people who bring strong technical judgment, clear communication, and a willingness to get into the details. If you want to shape how Amazon builds its most ambitious hardware and work alongside talented engineers solving real problems at scale, this is the role for you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10\+ years of hands\-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* 10\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* Deep working knowledge of the chip development lifecycle: RTL verification milestones, physical design convergence, DFT, and timing closure.
* Experience managing programs with external design partners and IP vendors where you don't control the resources but own the outcome.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain integrated schedules with real dependency modeling — not just Gantt charts, but an understanding of which paths have float and which don't.
* Strong technical communication skills: ability to present crisp status to VP\-level audiences, distinguishing signal from noise, and framing decisions clearly.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with multi\-die / chiplet / advanced packaging programs (2\.5D/3D integration).
* Familiarity with HBM integration, die\-to\-die interfaces, or high\-speed serial subsystems.
* Experience with leading\-edge foundry nodes and their specific flow and schedule characteristics.
* Background in ML accelerator or high\-performance compute silicon.
* Experience driving infrastructure capacity planning for large\-scale chip development programs.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Annapurna Labs designs the custom silicon that powers AWS's machine learning infrastructure, including the Trainium and Inferentia chip families. Our next\-generation ML accelerator is a multi\-die chiplet using advanced 2nm and 3nm process nodes with state\-of\-the\-art packaging technology, and it is the most complex hardware program Amazon has undertaken. We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own end\-to\-end program execution for this chip, from RTL freeze through tape\-out and into production readiness.  

  

This is not a status\-reporting role. You will be the person who connects a sprawling set of engineering workstreams into a single coherent schedule, identifies the real critical path week to week, and drives the cross\-functional decisions that keep the program on track. The program spans multiple concurrent silicon development efforts with significant interdependencies across engineering disciplines, external partners, and infrastructure.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Own the integrated schedule and critical path analysis across multiple die tape\-outs through engineering samples and production ramp. Understand dependency chains deeply enough to calculate the impact of any slip or pull\-in, and update the timeline weekly with real data.  

Drive the weekly chip status cadence by synthesizing inputs from RTL/DV, physical design, packaging, power, infrastructure, and post\-silicon teams into a single view that tells leadership where we actually stand, including what is getting worse and what needs action.  

Track verification convergence as a leading indicator by monitoring the progression from feature completion through RTL closure, bug trends, and regression pass rates by block. Recognize when convergence is stalling and drive the engineering response before downstream milestones are affected.  

Manage the external design partner interface, owning the netlist delivery calendar, tracking your partner's physical design timeline, and negotiating schedule trades with a clear understanding of downstream cost.  

Drive infrastructure readiness and external IP delivery by partnering with compute and EDA platform teams on capacity planning, and tracking third\-party PHY, memory interface, and controller IP deliveries against consuming blocks to escalate gaps before they become tape\-out critical.  

  

A day in the life  

You start your morning reviewing verification convergence dashboards and regression results, spotting a block where bug closure rates haven't flattened. You pull the DV lead and RTL owner into a quick sync to agree on a recovery plan before the weekly chip status review. In that review, you walk leadership through an updated critical path that reflects a netlist delivery shift from your external design partner, quantifying the downstream impact on tape\-out timing. After lunch, you join an infrastructure capacity review to confirm that compute clusters can handle the regression load through freeze, then close out the day preparing an executive summary for an upcoming program milestone review.  

  

About the team  

The Annapurna Labs ML Accelerator team builds the Trainium and Inferentia silicon that trains and serves machine learning models across AWS. We work at the intersection of chip architecture, physical design, verification, and infrastructure to deliver products that push the boundaries of performance and efficiency for our customers. Our team values people who bring strong technical judgment, clear communication, and a willingness to get into the details. If you want to shape how Amazon builds its most ambitious hardware and work alongside talented engineers solving real problems at scale, this is the role for you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10\+ years of hands\-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* 10\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* Deep working knowledge of the chip development lifecycle: RTL verification milestones, physical design convergence, DFT, and timing closure.
* Experience managing programs with external design partners and IP vendors where you don't control the resources but own the outcome.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain integrated schedules with real dependency modeling — not just Gantt charts, but an understanding of which paths have float and which don't.
* Strong technical communication skills: ability to present crisp status to VP\-level audiences, distinguishing signal from noise, and framing decisions clearly.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with multi\-die / chiplet / advanced packaging programs (2\.5D/3D integration).
* Familiarity with HBM integration, die\-to\-die interfaces, or high\-speed serial subsystems.
* Experience with leading\-edge foundry nodes and their specific flow and schedule characteristics.
* Background in ML accelerator or high\-performance compute silicon.
* Experience driving infrastructure capacity planning for large\-scale chip development programs.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Amazon MGM Studios Financial Systems
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Ready to lead the successful integration of MGM's financial systems into Amazon?  

  

Join Amazon MGM Studios Tech as the single\-threaded owner of a multi\-year program that migrates MGM's financial systems and the significant balance\-sheet exposure and annual P\&L activity they carry, out of multiple legacy platforms and into a single consolidated Amazon architecture. The Principal Technical Program Manager is a leadership role where you'll set strategic technical direction and drive a transformative, cross\-organizational initiative spanning multiple business workstreams, a large portfolio of new deal types, across several engineering organizations, and a broad set of cross\-functional stakeholders, with a firm deadline to fully deprecate MGM's legacy ERP and complete the integration.  

  

What You'll Do:  

* Own and deliver an ambiguous, very large, and complex program that spans multiple organizations and technology domains, serving as the single\-threaded owner for all program\-level milestones across several bespoke business workstreams (including international and domestic theatrical distribution, third\-party content licensing, development and production, streaming, and production facilities).
* Design and own the end\-to\-end data migration and cutover strategy that moves all financial data (master, transactional, and reference data) from legacy systems to the consolidated platform, spanning the full stack across business, middleware, financial automation, downstream financial infrastructure, and legacy systems to deprecate.
* Develop workback plans per workstream, sequence migrations to manage operational risk, and coordinate with the studio's legal entity restructure, owning the sequencing trade\-offs of its circular dependency with the program's builds.
* Own the standardization and graduation framework — define deal\-type primitives, establish system\-of\-record boundaries, enforce standard\-versus\-exception rules, and determine when each workstream is ready to transition from the program to BAU ownership.
* Identify risks and opportunities in technical strategies, system architectures, and engineering organizational structures, resolving cross\-workstream dependencies and engineering capacity gaps.
* Influence and advise VP\-level leadership across multiple Finance Technology and Studios Technology organizations — plus Finance, Accounting, Tax, and FinOps — on technical investment decisions, organizational alignment, and long\-term platform strategy, making priority calls based on business value, partner readiness, and platform reuse.
* Author the program's strategic narratives, define program\-level tenets, and run the operating cadence (monthly and quarterly business reviews with senior leadership, and ad\-hoc executive escalations).
* Drive clarity in a highly ambiguous environment where business strategy, architectural approach, and even the problem definition may not yet exist.

  

What You Bring:  

* 10\+ years of technical program management experience, with a demonstrated track record of delivering very large, cross\-organizational programs.
* Deep expertise in large\-scale systems and platform architecture, and the ability to evaluate and influence architectural strategies across multiple engineering organizations.
* Executive\-level communication and influence skills, with experience advising VP\-level leaders and aligning competing priorities across organizational boundaries — without direct line authority.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technical decisions to business outcomes at scale.
* Experience making irreversible sequencing decisions in complex migrations and managing controllership and operational risk.

  

Why This Role Matters:  

As the Principal TPM for this program, you won't just execute, you'll define how MGM's financial systems are successfully integrated into Amazon and rebuilt for the next decade. You'll make the irreversible calls: which businesses cut over first, when to freeze legacy systems, how to manage the circular dependency between the entity restructure and the program's builds, and which requirements to simplify without impacting customers. This is a role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, drives alignment across senior leaders with competing roadmaps, and delivers outsized, measurable business value and productivity impact.  

  

This role reports to a Senior Manager of Software Development and regularly presents to VP\-level leadership across the program's Steering Committee.  

  

Join us in building the future of entertainment finance!

Prime Video (PV) Financial Systems (FinSys) calculates, pays, receives payments, accounts for and reports all financial activities to operate a digital streaming and studios business. We manage the onboarding of commercial contractual terms and enable seamless monetization of content and assets through mechanisms like PV related purchases, rentals, subscriptions, ads and theatrical releases. jobs.title: Head of Technology - Investment Services
jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever\-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------


U.S. Bank is seeking a strategic and transformational technology Executive to serve as Head of Investment Services Technology. Investment Services is U.S. Bank's institutional trust, custody, and fund servicing franchise. This role will lead technology strategy and delivery supporting business products to enable the growth and evolution of U.S. Bank's Investment Services. Products focus includes ETF servicing, Alternative Investments, Fund Services, Corporate Trust, and Global Custody.

  

The individual in this role serves as the Senior technology leader partnering directly with Head of Global Investment Services executive to develop and execute a technology strategy that enables revenue growth, enhances client experiences, strengthens risk management capabilities, and modernizes critical platforms. The successful candidate will operate as a highly visible Executive leader, influencing Senior business and technology stakeholders while driving large\-scale transformation initiatives across front\-office, middle\-office, and enterprise functions.

  

A key component of this role will be partnering closely with business and technology leaders supporting business strategies, ensuring successful alignment of platforms, operating models, talent, and technology capabilities.

 **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Define and execute the technology vision, strategy, and investment roadmap supporting U.S. Bank's Global Investment Services growth objectives.
* Partner directly with Senior business executives to translate business strategy into scalable technology solutions.
* Lead a large, geographically dispersed global technology organization responsible for application development, platform modernization, technology operations, architecture, and delivery execution.
* Drive transformation initiatives across businesses by reducing legacy complexity, rationalizing applications and infrastructure, and implementing scalable solutions that enable growth, resilience, and operational efficiency.
* Provide Executive leadership for strategic platform decisions, including modernization efforts, third\-party solutions, build\-versus\-buy evaluations, and emerging AI\-enabled capabilities.
* Influence enterprise technology strategy through active participation on Senior technology leadership teams and cross\-functional governance forums.
* Establish strong partnerships across business, risk, compliance, legal, and audit functions to maintain an effective control environment while enabling innovation and speed to market.
* Attract, develop, and retain top technology talent while building a high\-performing, inclusive leadership culture focused on accountability, execution, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee significant technology investments and budgets, ensuring delivery excellence while maximizing business value and return on investment.

 **Preferred Skills/Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
* 15\+ years of experience leading large\-scale technology organizations, including senior executive leadership experience.
* Extensive experience developing and executing technology strategies supporting ETF, Alternative Investments, Fund Services, Corporate Trust, and Escrow products.
* Experience evaluating and deploying emerging technologies, including AI\-enabled solutions, to enhance business outcomes and operational effectiveness
* Demonstrated ability to influence and partner with executive\-level business leaders on strategic priorities and technology investments.
* Experience leading large transformation programs involving platform modernization, organizational change, and delivery at scale.
* Strong understanding of technology risk management, regulatory requirements, information security, and operational resiliency practices within financial services.
* Proven track record integrating acquired organizations, platforms, or technology capabilities.
* Demonstrated success leading complex global technology teams through periods of rapid growth and organizational transformation.
* Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and inspire both technical and non\-technical audiences.

 **Leadership \& Management Behavioral Competencies**

* **Strong Business Acumen** \- A strategic thinker who have deep product knowledge can connect technology investments to business growth and competitive advantage.
* **Influencing and empowering others** \- An influential executive who builds trust and credibility with senior leaders and stakeholders.
* **Change Management Advocate** \- A transformational leader capable of driving large\-scale change in dynamic and complex environments.
* **Outcome Drive** \- A collaborative partner who balances innovation, risk management, and disciplined execution.
* **Talent Management** \- A talent developer committed to building strong teams and future leadership pipelines.

12 month contract

Remote, PST hours

Must be able to work on a W2

Summary

A Life Sciences organization has engaged GForce Life Sciences to provide a Senior Manager, Interactive Response Technology. This position is remote and responsible for owning the design, build, implementation, and lifecycle management of IRT/RTSM systems across Phase I–IV clinical trials, including integrations with adjacent clinical and enterprise platforms. The role supports study-level execution, vendor management, and governance, ensuring the efficient operation of patient randomization and investigational product handling throughout the trial portfolio.

Duties / Expectations of Role

Serve as project manager for IRT on assigned trials, leading study builds from kickoff to close-out, and managing vendor and internal team adherence to timelines and deliverables.
Collaborate with IT and study teams to translate protocols into User Requirement Specifications (URS), ensuring accurate capture of randomization, visit schedules, dosing regimens, stratification, unblinding rules, and drug supply configurations before system build.
Act as primary liaison to external IRT vendors, overseeing build timelines, configuration of study-specific modules, and adherence to specifications.
Develop test plans with IT and coordinate cross-functional UAT, ensuring all requirements are tested and defects are documented and resolved prior to go-live.
Coordinate training and system access for site staff, monitors, and study teams, verifying role assignments before first patient in.
Provide day-to-day oversight during trial conduct, monitoring enrollment, inventory, and troubleshooting issues with vendors and global study operations.
Manage mid-study changes through formal change control processes, assessing impact, updating specifications, retesting, and securing approvals before implementation.
Lead IRT close-out activities, including database lock, reconciliation, final inventory management, data archival, and system decommissioning.
Maintain and improve IRT SOPs, work instructions, standards, test scripts, and training materials, integrating lessons learned from each study.
Partner with Supply Chain Strategy & Excellence to shape the digital roadmap, assessing emerging features like platform integrations, direct-to-patient supply, and adaptive randomization.
Lead vendor sourcing, RFQs/RFPs, assessments, feasibility evaluations, and platform selection, collaborating with Procurement and study teams on commercial terms and change orders.
Act as subject matter expert on IRT, coaching study teams and partnering with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Data Management, IT, and Quality Assurance.
Define and report KPIs such as system uptime, error rates, site stock-out events, and drug wastage; analyze IRT data to inform senior management on performance and trends.
Represent IRT in cross-functional forums for protocol feasibility, risk management, and decentralized trial initiatives.

Mandatory Requirements

Bachelor's degree in life sciences, engineering, supply chain, information systems, or related field.
Five or more years in clinical supply chain, operations, or systems, including at least five years of hands-on IRT or RTSM ownership involving multiple concurrent studies.
Proven experience delivering end-to-end IRT builds, from specification development through study support and close-out.
Working knowledge of randomization, blinding methodologies, clinical demand forecasting, and IRT resupply algorithms.
Experience managing external IRT vendors, including oversight of timeline, quality, and escalation processes.
Familiarity with GCP, 21 CFR Part 11, computer system validation, and inspection readiness for clinical systems.
Ability to work independently across global time zones, exercising judgment on escalation and aligning cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

Experience with multiple commercial IRT or RTSM platforms.
Background in rare disease, gene therapy, or multi-region global trials.
Exposure to direct-to-patient supply, decentralized trials, or adaptive designs.
Experience integrating IRT with EDC, CTMS, ERP, or supply planning systems.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Channel Fusion is accelerating its AI-enabled platform strategy and technical organization during a critical growth window. We are seeking a full-time Chief Technology Officer to lead AI strategy, technical modernization, and architecture direction: establishing a rigorous, real-time operating system and measurement framework for engineering that provides visibility into output, quality, and business impact, and building a comprehensive technical foundation that demonstrates platform scalability, architectural maturity, and operational excellence. This is a full-time, hands-on operating role — not an advisory role.

The CTO owns technology strategy, architecture standards, AI-enabled engineering transformation, cybersecurity and platform-risk direction, technology investment priorities, and enterprise technical readiness. The Head of Engineering reports to the CTO and owns the engineering organization, engineering people leadership, and day-to-day software delivery. The VP, Cloud Security & Client Delivery also reports to the CTO and owns cloud and security operations, compliance execution, service reliability, and client-delivery execution. The CTO aligns these functions and resolves cross-functional technology, roadmap, security, client, and investment tradeoffs with the CEO and executive leadership team.

Core Mandate

Technical Readiness & Operating Baseline
— Build a comprehensive technical foundation that demonstrates platform scalability, architectural maturity, and operational excellence to internal stakeholders and enterprise partners. This includes: stored-procedure inventory, technical debt registry (with owner, business impact, remediation plan for every material item), modernization status evidence (production validation, monitoring, rollback testing, legacy deprecation), and infrastructure/scalability metrics (concurrent users, transactions per minute, multi-tenant support, cost per 1,000 transactions).
Client Onboarding Scalability
— Establish clear metrics and targets for client onboarding efficiency, documentation, and platform-driven configuration to enable faster, more predictable client launches, and build the roadmap to onboard new clients at scale without linear growth in engineering headcount.
AI Strategy & Productivity
— Establish an engineering baseline and launch a controlled AI-assisted delivery pilot within the first 30 days using a live codebase and real delivery workflows. Within the first 90 days, demonstrate measurable improvement in cycle time or throughput without deterioration in quality, security, or production reliability. Define a validated rollout plan for the remaining pods based on pilot results, including projected engineering and AI-tooling economics.
Architecture Direction
— The CTO will initially serve as Channel Fusion's senior architecture authority and assess the technical-leadership model during the first 30 days. The CTO may recommend principal-level architecture capacity where demonstrated workload, technical risk, or delivery leverage justifies it. Any such position will be structured as a hands-on technical role within the engineering organization rather than as an additional management layer.
Operating Framework
— Establish a real-time management system that provides visibility into organizational output: a weekly pod-level scorecard (mission, committed vs. delivered outcomes, revenue/retention supported, team size, work mix, cycle time, quality, loaded cost, and capacity, investment, ownership, and operating recommendations for each pod), and a technology economics model (fully loaded org cost, cost by pod, revenue/retention by pod, AI tooling/token costs, RPE tracking against target, and modeled efficiency, investment, capacity, and operating-leverage scenarios).
Executive & Board Engagement
— Report progress against a monthly operating and readiness dashboard directly to the CEO/ELT; translate technical reality into terms leadership and enterprise partners can act on.

Key Qualifications

15+ years of technology leadership experience within enterprise software, SaaS, MarTech, or channel marketing platforms; prior experience as CTO, SVP, or VP of Engineering/Technology at meaningful scale.
Personally designed and led the implementation of an AI-assisted software delivery system in a live engineering organization —
not simply sponsored, approved, or directed one from a distance. Able to speak specifically to the tools, workflow design, failure modes encountered, and measurable before-and-after results (cycle time, defect rates, throughput, or cost).
Track record modernizing legacy platforms while continuing to ship to live, paying clients
— real modernization under real constraints, not a greenfield build or an unconstrained migration.
Experience leading distributed engineering organizations, including India-based teams
— familiar with the timezone, communication, and career-development dynamics required to build genuine technical ownership and trust across geography.
Able to connect technical investment decisions to business outcomes
— client onboarding speed, release velocity, operational resilience, and enterprise value — not just architectural or code-quality terms.
Deep working knowledge of modern AI technologies: LLMs, tokenization, prompt engineering, RAG, vector databases, GPU/cloud AI infrastructure, and AI software stacks, sufficient to personally design and lead an AI-native engineering organization.
Experience directing enterprise-grade, cloud-native, secure, multi-tenant SaaS architecture at the senior-most technical level.
Technical diligence experience
— has built or defended a technical readiness package (debt inventory, architecture risk, scalability evidence) for board, executive, enterprise-partner, or other senior stakeholder review.
Excellent executive communication skills; able to lead a multi-functional technical organization (engineering, cloud/security, and client delivery) as a unified executive team.
Genuine investment in building organizational bench strength over time, including mentoring and developing technical leaders as part of a collaborative, growth-oriented leadership approach.
MarTech / Through-Channel Marketing Automation (TCMA) experience — desirable, not required.

Education

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent demonstrated experience required; advanced technical or business education preferred.
What Success Looks Like — First 90 Days

**CBIA is Connecticut's largest business organization, with thousands of member companies, small and large, representing a diverse range of industries from every part of the state. We are the leading voice for businesses at the state Capitol.**

jobs.description:
Valeris is a fully integrated life sciences commercialization partner that provides comprehensive solutions that span the entire healthcare value chain. Formed by the merger of PharmaCord and Mercalis, Valeris™ revolutionizes the path from life sciences innovation to real\-life impact to build a world in which every patient gets the care they need. Valeris works on behalf of life sciences companies to improve the patient experience so that patients can access and adhere to critical medications. Backed by proven industry expertise, a deep commitment to patient care, the latest technology, and exceptionally talented team members, Valeris provides the data and strategic insights, patient support services and healthcare provider engagement tools to help life sciences companies successfully commercialize new products. Valeris provides commercialization solutions to more than 500 life sciences customers and has provided access and affordability support to millions of patients. The company is headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina and Jeffersonville, Indiana. To learn more about Valeris, please visit www.valeris.com.

  

Valeris is seeking a Director, IT Project Management Office (PMO) \& Technology Transformation to lead a small IT PMO while personally serving as the lead Project Manager on two of the company's largest active technology transformation initiatives. This is a dual\-mandate role: roughly ¼ PMO leadership (governance, standards, reporting, and a small team of project managers) and ¾ hands\-on delivery leadership of complex, cross\-functional programs.

  

The ideal candidate has run enterprise\-scale technology transformation programs, can stand up lightweight\-but\-effective PMO governance, and is equally comfortable in the boardroom translating program status for executives and in the weeds with workstream leads resolving a blocked dependency. This role reports to the VP, IT Technology Business Management, and partners closely with IT leadership, business sponsors, and external implementation partners.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

**IT PMO Leadership**

* Manage a lean, right\-sized IT PMO — establishing governance routines and consistent project management standards across the IT project portfolio.
* Define and maintain PMO methodology, templates, and tools (status reporting, RAID logs, stage\-gate/change control) appropriate to project size and risk.
* Manage, coach, and develop a small team of project managers; assign and balance workload across the active IT project portfolio.
* Own portfolio\-level reporting — consolidated status dashboards, risk/issue heatmaps, and executive summaries for IT and business leadership.
* Partner with the VP, IT Technology Business Management to align the IT project portfolio with budget, resource capacity, and business priorities.
* Drive continuous improvement of PMO processes based on lessons learned and delivery outcomes across the portfolio.

 **Program/Project Management — IT Transformation Initiatives**

* Serve as the lead Project Manager for two large, concurrent technology transformation initiatives, each spanning multiple workstreams (e.g., CRM, Portals, Integrations, Data and Analytics, Data Migration, etc.).
* Develop and maintain comprehensive implementation plans and timelines, including technical systems, infrastructure, data migration, communications, and process alignment.
* Translate executive sponsor goals into clear transformation roadmaps aligned to business outcomes, operational scalability, and growth.
* Track and update project milestones, proactively identify bottlenecks and dependencies, and escalate risks to senior leadership with recommended mitigations.
* Facilitate regular status meetings and steering committee sessions; prepare and distribute agendas, decisions, action items, and follow\-ups.
* Maintain issues\-and\-decisions registries, documenting owners, decisions, and deadlines across both initiatives.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams (IT, security, operations, finance) and external vendors/consultants supporting each initiative.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and security standards, coordinating audits and control validation as needed.
* Drive post\-implementation reviews, capturing lessons learned and measuring success against defined outcomes/KPIs.
* Act as a strategic integrator across both initiatives — breaking down silos, managing interdependencies between the two programs, and keeping delivery outcome\-driven.
* Perform additional tasks or projects as assigned

 **Valeris Values**

* Utilize Valeris’ values as the driving force behind the team’s success
* On time adherence to training deadlines for all corporate policies and procedures
* Ensure all SOPs are followed with consistency

 **Qualifications:**

**What you'll need to thrive in this role**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Project Management, Engineering, or a related field; PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification preferred.
* 12\+ years of progressive project/program management experience, including experience managing a PMO and a team of project managers.
* Demonstrated success leading large\-scale technology or business transformation initiatives (e.g., CRM implementations, M\&A integrations, platform migrations) from planning through post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Experience building or maturing PMO governance — intake, prioritization, status reporting, and stage\-gate processes — in a matrixed organization.
* Familiarity with enterprise technical systems and architectures such as Salesforce, Genesys, PrimeRx, HRIS, data migration, and cloud/SaaS platforms.
* Proficiency with project and portfolio management tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Asana, Jira, or ServiceNow).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting program status to senior/executive leadership.
* Strong influencing ability — guides without formal authority and secures stakeholder buy\-in

jobs.title: IT Business Relationship Director, Americas
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

Job Overview

We are hiring an IT Business Relationship Director to ensure IT service delivery meets the operational needs of program offices across the Americas geography (US and LATAM), translating business needs into IT priorities and IT technical capability into business value. The role sits at the intersection of IT and program operations — building trust with leadership, diagnosing where IT processes break down, and brokering the cross-office knowledge and escalation paths that don't currently exist structurally.

This role will operate as the connective layer between IT and Resettlement, Asylum and Integration (RAI) and Crisis, Response, Recovery and Development (CRRD) leadership across the US and LATAM, working alongside the Global IT Solutions team, the Americas IT Service Desk (POD) and RAI Operations staff. They will build a regular engagement cadence with RAI office and CRRD program leadership, develop enough programmatic fluency to judge whether an IT solution will work in the field, own escalations, knowing when an issue needs IT leadership, a vendor, or executive attention. The role embeds proactive communication and cross-office knowledge-sharing into how IT and program operations work together, so that consistency across offices is structural rather than dependent on individual relationships.

The ideal candidate has direct experience in complex, distributed program operations, and brings credibility with program leadership as a result — not just IT service management experience. They are equal parts relationship manager, translator, and escalation owner: able to build trust with operations staff, assess whether a proposed IT solution will hold up in the field, and judge when to resolve something directly versus route it structurally. They have a bias for proactive communication, a high bar for consistency across offices, and a clear instinct for equipping program and office staff with the tools, access, and know-how to handle their own work.

This role reports to the Senior Director, IT Business Relationship Management and partners closely with RAI and CRRD leadership through an agreed engagement model. The role will also work closely with the Global IT Solutions Team, including the Service Delivery Center of Excellence, Helpdesk team, Enterprise Applications and Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

Relationship Management and Engagement

Serve as the senior IT partner to RAI office and CRRD program leadership, providing strategic guidance and thought partnership on IT service delivery performance, planned initiatives, and emerging risks across the US and LATAM
Maintain a regular engagement cadence with RAI operations directors and senior CRRD leadership, ensuring IT priorities are aligned with program needs and that leadership has visibility of service delivery against commitments
Act as the accountable IT point of contact for escalations from office and program leadership — owning the response, not just the routing
Build sufficient familiarity with the programmatic context of each cluster to advise credibly on whether IT solutions will work in practice, and to represent office needs accurately to HQ IT
Own cross-office knowledge brokering — surfacing what's working in one office to others, and serving as the connective point for "what are other offices doing on this?" questions that currently have no structural answer
Act as the strategic focal point for IT initiative rollouts across RAI offices and CRRD programs in the Americas – shaping appropriate timing, delivery and relaying infrastructure, application, and programmatic IT needs from offices to HQ IT teams and vice versa.
Support IT budget planning for the Americas region and ensure asset documentation, audit readiness, and regulatory compliance obligations are maintained

Escalation, Risk Management and Service Performance

Own escalation pathways for issues that fall between the helpdesk and engineering teams, knowing when to involve specific IT leads, vendors, or procurement and following through to resolution
Monitor service delivery performance and key performance indicators across the Americas region, identifying patterns and recurring issues that should trigger problem management review; escalate trending patterns as they emerge for either immediate action, system enhancement, or larger risk management
Partner with the Global Service Desk Manager on T1/T2 technician performance, ensuring ticket priority logic and SLA adherence

Job Requirements

Knowledge & Experience

6-8 years in a relationship management, business partnering, or program/operations role bridging technical and non-technical stakeholders — direct experience with humanitarian, nonprofit, or similarly complex distributed-operations environments strongly preferred
Working knowledge of the IT service and technology lifecycle, from planning and delivery through operations and continuous improvement, sufficient to engage credibly with technical teams and evaluate whether a proposed solution is fit for purpose
Familiarity with IT best-practice frameworks and delivery models (e.g., ITIL, Agile/Scrum, or equivalent project delivery methodologies) and how they apply to service management and technology rollouts; ITIL Foundation certification preferred, not required
Demonstrated experience translating operational needs into technical priorities and representing technical capability back to non-technical leadership
Experience defining and tracking performance metrics (KPIs, SLAs, or equivalent) and running a recurring review cadence with stakeholders

Personal Attributes

Spanish language proficiency
Builds credibility quickly with leadership
Comfortable holding ambiguity and structuring it
Strong written and verbal communication; able to translate fluently between technical and program audiences

Working Environment

This position is based in the US – Hybrid. The role may require travel to US and LATAM Offices as necessary.

Compensation:
(Pay Rate: $132,000/yr). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

Professional Standards:
All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.

Cookies: https://careers.rescue.org/us/en/cookiesettings

This is a senior leadership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, develops processes with clarity, works cross-functionally by default, and is energized by building client relationships. You will own the quality, margin, and strategic direction of our technology services engagements from pre-sale through delivery, while unifying a cross-functional team of architects, engineers, and platform experts into a single, scalable practice.

This is not a role for someone who needs a fully defined playbook. Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning

The Vice President of Information Technology is responsible for leading the company's overall IT strategy, IT operations, and technical service framework, ensuring that enterprise information systems, infrastructure, application platforms, data capabilities, and technical resources consistently support business growth and organizational operations.

This role typically oversees IT strategic planning, enterprise applications, infrastructure, cloud computing, IT service management, information security coordination, technical projects, and IT budgeting. The VP collaborates with the CIO, CTO, COO, and heads of various business units to modernize the IT environment and enhance system stability, operational efficiency, technical service quality, and business support capabilities.

Core Responsibilities

I. IT Strategic Planning
Formulate the company's IT strategy, annual IT plans, and long-term technology development roadmaps.
Translate business objectives into plans for IT projects, systems, and infrastructure.
Assess IT capabilities, technical architecture, and resource requirements based on business growth.
Determine priorities for IT investments and key technical projects.
Ensure alignment between IT strategy and the overall corporate strategy.

II. IT Operations Management
Oversee daily IT operations and the technical service framework.
Supervise the performance of IT services, infrastructure, networks, endpoints, and systems.
Establish IT operational standards, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and service management mechanisms.
Monitor system availability, stability, and service quality.
Continuously improve IT operational efficiency and user experience.

III. Enterprise Application and System Management
Coordinate ERP, CRM, HRIS, financial systems, and other enterprise applications.
Manage the enterprise application lifecycle and system integration.
Drive system integration to reduce data silos and redundant technology implementations.
Evaluate new business systems and software solutions.
Ensure core systems meet business functionality and scalability requirements.

IV. Infrastructure and Cloud Computing
Oversee enterprise networks, servers, storage, endpoints, and cloud environments.
Develop plans for infrastructure modernization and cloud migration.
Ensure the capacity, performance, and reliability of IT infrastructure.
Establish disaster recovery and business continuity mechanisms.
Optimize infrastructure costs and resource utilization.

V. IT Security Coordination and Risk Management
Collaborate with the CISO and security teams to implement the enterprise information security strategy.
Ensure IT systems comply with corporate security policies and control requirements.
Oversee identity and access management, system permissions, and infrastructure security. Identify critical risks within IT operations and the technical environment.
Participate in emergency response for major security incidents, system failures, and business disruptions.

VI. IT Projects and Digital Transformation
Lead enterprise-level IT projects and digital upgrade initiatives.
Oversee project scope, budget, schedule, risks, and deliverables.
Drive initiatives in cloud computing, automation, AI, and the modernization of enterprise platforms.
Establish mechanisms for IT project portfolio management and investment evaluation.
Ensure technology projects deliver clear business value.

VII. Data and Technology Services
Support the development of enterprise data platforms, data integration, and analytics capabilities.
Collaborate with data teams to enhance data quality and information availability.
Drive the development of capabilities such as self-service analytics and management dashboards.
Establish management systems for IT service data and operational performance.
Leverage data to continuously optimize decisions regarding IT resources and services.

VIII. IT Budget and Vendor Management
Formulate and manage the annual IT budget.
Oversee expenditures for software, cloud services, hardware, and external technical services.
Establish mechanisms for IT vendor selection, evaluation, and performance management.
Optimize costs associated with technology procurement and contracts.
Ensure IT investments align with enterprise business priorities.

Define the IT organizational structure, roles, and management systems.

jobs.description:
#### **ABOUT THE ROLE**



We're looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to drive complex, cross\-functional cybersecurity programs across our enterprise technology landscape — security initiatives, risk remediation, compliance efforts, and technology projects that span many teams. You'll turn ambiguous goals into clear plans, chase down the right people across the organization to get things done, and own the outcomes end to end.



This is a delivery role with a technical spine. You won't just track tasks — you'll understand the systems, ask the right technical questions, surface risks early, and make the calls that keep programs on schedule. Success means predictable delivery, aligned stakeholders, and teams that can do their best work without churn.


#### **YOUR DAILY IMPACT AT PELOTON**


* Take large, cross\-team initiatives from intake through planning, execution, launch, and retrospective. Define scope, milestones, success metrics, and reporting
* Establish clear charters that define objectives, scope, stakeholders, success criteria, and decision rights — so every program starts with shared understanding and buy\-in
* Lead security initiatives such as vulnerability and risk remediation, compliance and audit readiness, incident follow\-ups, and control rollouts — coordinating security, engineering, and business teams to closure
* Relentlessly follow up across engineering, security, product, IT, and business owners to unblock work, confirm commitments, and keep remediation and delivery moving to the finish line
* Create realistic roadmaps and delivery plans across dependencies. Sequence work, set timelines, and keep them current as reality changes
* Map cross\-team and cross\-system dependencies, identify risks and blockers early, and drive them to resolution before they slip the schedule
* Provide crisp, honest status to leadership and stakeholders — what's on track, what's at risk, what needs a decision — tailored to the audience, and use strong communication to build alignment and drive action
* Facilitate planning, standups, reviews, and launch readiness. Keep meetings purposeful and decisions documented
* Spot process gaps and introduce lightweight practices that raise predictability and reduce toil, without adding bureaucracy

#### **YOU BRING TO PELOTON**


* 5\+ years in technical program or project management, delivering software or security programs across multiple teams
* Strong technical fluency — able to understand architecture, integrations, APIs, and security concepts well enough to ask sharp questions and challenge estimates
* Proven track record shipping complex, cross\-functional programs on time
* Exceptional communication skills — able to write clearly, present to senior leadership, and influence without authority
* Skilled at building effective project charters and driving alignment on scope, owners, and success criteria
* Persistent, proactive follow\-through — comfortable chasing down owners across many teams to close out commitments
* Skilled with Agile/Scrum and modern delivery practices, and comfortable adapting them to fit the work
* Experience with program tracking and planning tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, or similar)
* Clear, calm decision\-making under pressure and competing priorities

	+ Background in a CIO/IT, security, or enterprise\-platform organization
	+ Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts — vulnerability management, risk and compliance frameworks, or security controls
	+ Relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, CISSP, Security\+, CISM) a plus
	+ Exposure to AI/ML or agentic AI programs
	+ A prior hands\-on engineering or technical background
	+ Experience managing vendor relationships and external delivery partners
* How we work:
	+ We value clarity over ceremony — the right plan, the right owners, and honest status
	+ We surface risk early and solve problems as a team, not through blame
	+ We invest in our people: mentorship, growth, and space to do the best work of your career

Our mission is rooted in people inspired innovation, empowering financial institutions to deliver seamless, secure, and human centered experiences. jobs.title: VP of IT - Business Applications
jobs.description:
Vice President, IT and Digital Transformation

This is a senior IT and digital transformation leadership role, and it is first and foremost an enterprise applications and ERP leadership role. You will lead technology for a manufacturing business that grew through acquisition and runs multiple independent operating units, each with its own leadership, its own P&L, and in many cases its own systems. The mission is to consolidate and modernize a fragmented applications and ERP landscape, get the underlying data clean and usable, put practical AI to work on top of it, and earn the trust of the business-unit leaders to make it stick. It is a role for a leader who came up through ERP and business applications and wants a career-defining transformation to run.

Compensation:
$250,000 to $285,000 base, plus bonus and long-term incentives.
Logistics:
Remote with travel, US-based

Here's what you'll be doing:

Own the strategy, consolidation, and lifecycle of ERP and enterprise applications across multiple operating businesses, including modernizing legacy and fragmented ERP environments onto a modern, secure, cloud platform.
Lead full-lifecycle ERP work, whether that is standardization, upgrade, migration, or selective consolidation, balancing a unified platform with each business unit's operational needs.
Build the common data layer beneath those applications, driving data cleanup, normalization, and master-data governance so reporting, analytics, and AI have clean, trustworthy data to run on.
Identify and deliver the high-value, practical AI use cases that fit a regulated manufacturing business, from data-layer automation and knowledge retrieval to proposal generation, demand forecasting, and manufacturing workflow.
Operate as a peer to the business-unit leaders who own their P&L, building the relationships and trust needed to align them behind shared standards and carry the work through at the unit level.
Shape the go-forward people and workforce strategy for IT, deciding where to upskill existing teams, hire, or build a shared central capability, and defining the standard for what good looks like at each site.
Keep the business aligned with enterprise security and compliance standards for a regulated environment.
Lead IT due diligence and integration for future acquisitions.

Bin There Dump That

Bin There Dump That is looking for a Head of Technology & Systems to lead the technology strategy, systems ecosystem, and technology transformation supporting our growing franchise network across Canada and the United States.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who understands that great technology is about more than systems. It is about making the business easier to operate, more reliable, more connected, and better equipped to scale.

The Head of Technology & Systems will work across our Home Office, Franchise Operations team, Franchise Operators, and technology partners to ensure our technology investments deliver meaningful business value.

What You'll Do

Develop and lead BTDT's technology strategy and roadmap.
Lead major system implementations, migrations, integrations, testing, and optimization.
Evaluate our technology ecosystem and identify opportunities to simplify, integrate, automate, and improve.
Manage key technology vendors and establish clear expectations for performance, reliability, service, and accountability.
Establish standards for system reliability, incident response, business continuity, backups, access, and technology governance.
Partner with Operations and Finance & Analytics to improve data quality, reporting, dashboards, and system integrations.
Evaluate opportunities to responsibly leverage AI, automation, CRM technology, and emerging tools.

Support Franchise Operators with complex or systemic technology needs while developing scalable solutions for the broader network.
Ensure critical systems, integrations, processes, permissions, and technology dependencies are appropriately documented.
Translate complex technical issues into clear business recommendations for leadership and non-technical stakeholders.

You are a technology leader who can move comfortably between strategy and execution. You understand systems and architecture but also understand people, processes, operations, and the importance of successful adoption.

Knowledge of cybersecurity, access management, data governance, disaster recovery, and business continuity.

Why This Role?

You'll have the opportunity to influence how our systems connect, how our data is used, how emerging technology is evaluated, and how technology supports Franchise Operators and Home Office teams across the organization.

Our goal is simple: use technology to make BTDT easier to operate, easier to scale, more reliable, and more data-driven.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer / Co-Founder (Equity)
jobs.description:
Seeking an exceptional Chief Technology Officer / Co-Founder
to help build a vertically integrated artificial intelligence company spanning machine learning, high-performance computing, advanced systems engineering, and ultimately custom compute hardware.

Important: this is an early-stage co-founder position and is unpaid at the outset. Compensation will initially be equity-based, with cash compensation expected only as the company reaches appropriate financing or revenue milestones. Candidates should approach this as a genuine founding commitment, not a conventional salaried executive role.

This is not a conventional software-startup CTO role
. The position requires a deeply hands-on technical founder capable of working across the computing stack—from AI models and distributed systems through GPU infrastructure, compilers, accelerator architecture, semiconductor technology, and physical hardware.

The CTO will be expected to architect, prototype, code, benchmark, debug, research, experiment, and build.

Exceptional depth is sought across several of the following areas:
Machine learning, deep learning, foundation models, LLMs, training, fine-tuning, inference, quantization, and model evaluation
GPU computing, CUDA, Triton, TensorRT, vLLM, and comparable inference/runtime technologies
Distributed computing, HPC, multi-GPU systems, networking, memory optimization, and performance engineering
Python combined with strong systems-level development experience in Rust, C++, or comparable languages
Linux, containers, Kubernetes, MLOps, observability, and production infrastructure
AWS, Azure, GCP, bare-metal infrastructure, and hybrid or local compute architectures
RAG, embeddings, reranking, vector search, knowledge graphs, document intelligence, and agentic systems
Compiler technologies including LLVM, MLIR, XLA, Triton, or accelerator-oriented compiler stacks
Computer architecture, GPUs, NPUs, tensor accelerators, ASICs, FPGAs, RTL, memory hierarchies, and high-speed interconnects
Semiconductor fabrication, photolithography, EDA, physical design, process engineering, advanced packaging, chiplets, or tape-out
Advanced additive manufacturing, printed electronics, or emerging fabrication methods
Cybersecurity, edge computing, robotics, RF, defense technology, or other technically demanding systems environments

The technical bar is intentionally high, no candidate is expected to possess all listed skills.

The ideal candidate can understand an AI workload at the model level, profile its behavior at the systems level, identify bottlenecks imposed by current computing architectures, and reason downward toward a purpose-built accelerator.

Particular interest exists in people who have crossed traditional disciplinary boundaries: AI engineers who understand silicon, semiconductor engineers who understand machine-learning workloads, HPC engineers who have built sophisticated AI systems, compiler engineers who understand accelerator architecture, hardware engineers with serious software expertise, and researchers capable of turning theory into working systems.

This is fundamentally a builder role
. The CTO must be comfortable operating without a large engineering organization, an established playbook, or layers of abstraction separating leadership from implementation.

Exceptional critical thinking ability, technical independence, curiosity, and the ability to rapidly become competent in unfamiliar disciplines matter as much as any particular technology stack.

jobs.description:
Position Purpose

The Global Automation Engineering & Technology Head is accountable for defining and executing the enterprise strategy for GxP manufacturing and laboratory digital systems, including PCS, MES, OT Data Systems, and LIMS platforms. This role provides global lifecycle ownership, governance, and standards for platforms, data, and recipes across manufacturing and QC laboratories, ensuring harmonized, compliant, and future-ready operations. Acting as a Center of Excellence, the position establishes digital roadmaps, oversees Tier 1 project delivery and Tier 2/3 governance, and drives strategic partnerships with suppliers and platform providers. The role interfaces broadly across I&T, Operations, Technical Operations, Quality, and Data Analytics to enable an integrated, data-driven, and innovation-oriented digital ecosystem.

Reporting Relationships

Role that this position reports to: Global Head Engineering

Role/s That Report To This Position

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

Digital Manufacturing & QC Strategy and Roadmap (Operational Technology Domain)

Define and execute the global Operational Technology (OT) strategy and roadmap for manufacturing and QC systems, ensuring alignment with I&T and business strategies.

Advance paperless, recipe-driven, and data-integrated execution aligned to ISA-88/95 and Pharma 4.0 principles.

Prioritize OT initiatives that enhance productivity, regulatory compliance, and manufacturing reliability.

Communicate OT strategy, value realization, and roadmap progress to executive and site leadership.

Enterprise OT Platform Lifecycle Ownership (DCS, MES, OT Data Systems, LIMS)

Provide lifecycle ownership for Enterprise GxP manufacturing and lab OT platforms including OSI Pi, LIMS, Enterprise MES, Edge, Configuration management, and other enterprise tools

Provider governance and decisioning on Automation Systems (DCS/SCADA), MES, etc.

Ensure platforms meet operational, compliance, and performance standards across global sites.

Drive harmonization and modernization of Enterprise OT platforms and support the roadmap for site integrations.

OT Governance, Compliance, and Architecture Leadership

Lead enterprise OT governance structures (Design Authority, Standards Council, etc.).

Define global OT standards for configuration, recipes, data, and cybersecurity in alignment with I&T, C&Q/CSV, GAMP 5 and GxP requirements.

Maintain validated, secure, and interoperable architectures between plant-level systems and enterprise data layers.

Ensure OT environments adhere to 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, and digital validation best practices.

OT Technology Deployment and Capital Project Oversight

Accountable for Tier 1 capital project delivery for manufacturing and QC digital platforms.

Govern Tier 2/3 site projects to ensure adherence to global OT standards, validation, and cybersecurity requirements.

Manage readiness, commissioning, and hypercare for OT systems introduced via T1 capital or digital programs.

Organization / Center of Excellence Leadership and Team Development

Lead the global OT organization encompassing Lab Systems, Data Systems, Recipe Standards, and Innovation & Partner Enablement.

Operate as the OT Center of Excellence (CoE), defining best practices, playbooks, and training for site automation and lab teams.

Build global OT capabilities, talent pipelines, and competency frameworks.

Manage OT budgets (opex/capex) and resource allocation to maximize enterprise value.

Place a high priority on developing others through coaching, feedback, and developmental goals.

Provide a positive and equitable working environment, emphasizing values such as Customer Focus, Innovation, Integrity, Collaboration, and Superior Performance.

Strategic OT Supplier and Platform Partnerships

Develop and manage strategic partnerships with automation, MES, historian, and lab system platform provider (e.g., Siemens, Jag, Starlims, Aveeva (OSI) Pi).

Develop and manage strategic partnerships with integrator partners (Mescada, CapG, Avacone, Cognizant, etc.)

Align supplier roadmaps to OT strategy and ensure service excellence, cost optimization, and innovation delivery.

Establish joint governance with system integrators (SIs) and solution providers for lifecycle performance.

Leverage partner ecosystems to advance automation, edge computing, and digital manufacturing maturity.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Operational Influence

Collaborate closely with I&T, Operations, Technical Operations, Quality, Validation, and Data Analytics while retaining ownership of the OT domain.

Ensure seamless data and integration flows between OT systems, enterprise layers, and cloud solutions under validated control.

Influence global and site leaders to adopt standardized OT processes, architectures, and governance.

Represent OT in enterprise risk, cybersecurity, and digital transformation forums.

Innovation and Emerging OT Technologies Enablement

Identify and pilot emerging OT and industrial digital technologies (AI/ML at the edge, digital twins, composable MES, Cloud, etc.).

Translate pilots into validated, scalable solutions that enhance reliability, compliance, and improve business outcomes.

Embed advanced analytics and process optimization into OT platforms.

Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement across the OT ecosystem.

Position Qualifications And Experience Requirements

Education

Bachelor of Science in an Engineering, Automation, Computer Science or local equivalent.

Experience

15+ years’ work experience, with at least 5 years’ experience in execution systems, operational technology, IT and operations

Specific experience in process automation, MES and batch manufacturing industry standards (ISA S88 &S95)

Direct experience designing, building, deploying and supporting automation and execution systems (SCADA, DCS, MES, PAT, LIMS, Digital Methods, OSI Pi Data historian, etc.) in a regulated large-scale process-based manufacturing environment.

Experience in running site-based shop floor and laboratory systems in a globally distributed footprint is highly desirable

A proven track record of influencing the industry on operational technology via publications and presentations is strongly preferred.

Experience building, managing, and deploying high performing, innovative and transformational process automation / execution systems across a global organization.

Demonstrated ability to influence at all organizational levels through clear, concise and impactful verbal and written communication skills

Ability to build, mentor and grow a high performing and cohesive team

Experience in Process Excellence methodology is desirable but not required.

Ability to work across a range of countries and cultures

Demonstrated experience in managing leaders, employees, and cross-functional project teams.

Strong project management skills and experience in engineering projects within biopharma manufacturing.

Functional knowledge of cGMPs and manufacturing operations in FDA-regulated facilities.

Competencies

Automation & Execution Systems Expertise

Project Management

Regulatory Compliance

Team Leadership & Development

Strategic Planning

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Stakeholder Engagement

Strategic innovation

Delivering Enterprise Results and Value Orientation

About CSL Behring

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives.
