Your primary role involves understanding their short\- and long\-term security needs and providing expert guidance to enhance their security posture. You will be integral to landing Microsoft as a leader in cybersecurity, ensuring our solutions meet their business objectives. The CSO will be part of the CVPs extended leadership team and provide advice on the security business while also ensuring leader enablement. They will play an active role in building out the account strategy, building trust with CISOs, and other CxOs with a security interest, to drive successful strategic pursuits. They will actively engage in industry forums, providing deep insights on security, privacy and regulatory requirements and positioning Microsoft as the Security leader.The Customer Security Officer will also be the trusted advocate and voice of their customer in the Go to Market teams and influence the product roadmap and strategic investment in new product areas based on both customer feedback as well as changing industry trends.The Customer Security Officer role involves working as part of a global team, and although regionally based, the person hired will also support colleagues in other geographies.


It will involve up to 25% travel, with some global travel required occasionally. Successful candidates will work closely cross functionally with our customer account teams, the service delivery teams, industry teams, legal and corporate affairs, product engineering, Microsoft Security Partners and the Digital Crimes Unit to deliver on key business priorities, goals, and objectives.


Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Partner with area sales leadership and account teams in developing long term strategic plans for key win accounts in your area.
* Engage with customer C\-suite executive with Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) being the primary role, to understand their strategic objectives.
* Develop and nurture trusted advisor relationships helping CISO mature their security program by establishing the foundation for quality of platform security program architecture leveraging industry frameworks and standards.
* Develop strategic, operational, and tactical recommendations tailored to each customer with the intent of improving customer security posture and compliance position, aligned with their business goals and risk tolerance.
* Monitor and analyze emerging security trends, share insights with customers as well as our area leadership and guiding them through the potential impacts on their industry.
* Be the trusted Security partner between Microsoft and our strategic customers in developing, implementing, and executing on their security priorities, driving customer intent to buy and post sales deployment.Advise, coach and train the area leadership on MS security solution value prop and positioning.
* Be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) supporting area leaders on security conversations in executive forums as CISO roundtables, etc.In alignment with Microsoft’s key priorities, establish customers’ security strategy and ensure execution of said strategy with key C\-suite customer stakeholders.
* Lead Security presentations, demonstrations, and workshops in Industry forums to provide thought leadership on AI Transformation best practices, and on Microsoft’s Security portfolio.
* Develop and maintain industry expertise: The Customer Security Officer will stay up to date with the latest developments and advancements in security including new tech, competitors, and internal product and services offerings.
* Growth Mindset. Experience and passion for learning; implementing practices from others; trying, failing, and learning from both successes and failures; sharing practices and knowledge for others’ benefit.
* Other
	+ Embody our culture and values

  

**Qualifications**  

### **Required/minimum qualifications**

* Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4\+ years technical pre\-sales or technical consulting experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 6\+ years technical pre\-sales or technical consulting experience OR 7\+ years technical pre\-sales or technical consulting experience
	+ OR equivalent experience.
**Other Requirements**

* This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States that does not now or in the future require employer sponsorship

### **Additional or preferred qualifications**

* 6\+ years experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.
* Direct experience with AI platforms, applications and/or AI\-enabled business transformation. Certification in relevant technologies

jobs.description:
LOCATION: US – Austin  
TYPE: Full time  
WORK SHIFT: Hybrid  
POSTED: September 28, 2026  
ID: JR0132259  
Overview  
At Western Union, we’re more than a trusted name in global payments. We’re moving beyond remittances, beyond cash, and beyond the expectations of our customers.  


Our talented teams enable us to transform into a digital\-first company, built on the strength of our retail foundation and powered by next\-generation payments. All this with the goal of helping people prosper.  


Our customers inspire us to push boundaries and create services that make life easier and communities stronger. Wherever you are in the world, we’re committed to shaping the next generation of financial experiences.  


Join us as we go beyond and be part of a team that’s redefining what’s possible.  
We are seeking a seasoned Vice President of Cyber Governance, Risk \& Compliance to lead the strategy, execution, and continuous maturation of our cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance program. Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer, this leader will oversee the frameworks, processes, and teams responsible for cyber risk governance, regulatory readiness, policy management, control assurance, third\-party cyber risk oversight, and related GRC capabilities.  


In addition to leading Cyber GRC, this executive will serve as Deputy CISO for Western Union, supporting the CISO in the leadership and execution of the broader enterprise cybersecurity strategy. The Deputy CISO will represent the CISO in designated executive, Board, regulatory, business, and technology forums; help coordinate priorities across cybersecurity functions; provide leadership during significant cyber incidents; and assume delegated CISO responsibilities as required.  


The successful candidate will combine deep GRC and financial services expertise with the executive presence, business acumen, cybersecurity knowledge, and leadership capabilities necessary to operate across the full breadth of the cybersecurity organization.  


Role Responsibilities (GRC):  


Lead the cyber GRC function and define strategic roadmap, operating model, and maturity targets.  
Maintain governance structures supporting cyber risk decision\-making, escalation, and executive oversight.  
Drive cyber risk appetite, exception management, and risk acceptance processes.  
Oversee cyber and technology risk assessment methodologies and execution.  
Develop and maintain executive and Board\-level cyber risk reporting and metrics.  
Lead preparation and coordination for regulatory exams, internal/external audits, and customer assessments related to cybersecurity.  
Oversee control framework management, evidence programs, and issue remediation governance.  
Own lifecycle management of security policies, standards, and governance documentation.  
Oversee cyber due diligence and ongoing risk monitoring for third\-party vendors, partners, and strategic providers.  
Build, mentor, and scale a high\-performing GRC team.  


Role Responsibilities (Deputy CISO):  


Support the CISO in defining and executing the enterprise cybersecurity strategy.  
Serve as a strategic advisor to the CISO on cybersecurity risk, organizational priorities, investment decisions, regulatory matters, and emerging threats.  
Represent the CISO in designated executive, Board, business, technology, regulatory, risk, and governance forums.  
Help coordinate strategy, priorities, dependencies, and execution across cybersecurity functions.  
Promote integration among Security Operations, GRC, IAM, Security Engineering, Architecture, Application Security, Threat Intelligence, Incident Response, Fraud, and other relevant capabilities.  
Participate in cybersecurity strategic planning, budgeting, workforce planning, investment prioritization, and organizational design.  
Assist in preparing and delivering Board and executive\-level cybersecurity reporting.  
Represent cybersecurity during significant regulatory examinations and interactions when delegated by the CISO.  
Identify cross\-functional gaps and organizational risks and drive accountability for their resolution.  
Provide leadership continuity for the cybersecurity organization during periods when the CISO is unavailable.  
Assume additional CISO responsibilities and authorities when specifically delegated.  
Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, constructive challenge, collaboration, and continuous improvement.  
Build trusted relationships across Technology, Operations, Product, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit, and business leadership  


Role Requirements:  


Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.  
15\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, audit, compliance, or governance roles.  
7\+ years of people leadership experience with increasing organizational scope.  
Proven experience building, transforming, or materially uplifting cyber GRC programs in financial services or similarly regulated industries.  
Deep knowledge of cybersecurity governance, financial services regulatory expectations, security/control frameworks, audit/regulatory exams, and third\-party cyber risk programs.  
Experience interacting directly with senior executives, Boards, regulators, auditors, and risk committees.  
Demonstrated understanding of cybersecurity beyond GRC, including security operations, identity, application security, cloud security, incident response, security engineering, architecture, and emerging technology risk.  
Demonstrated ability to translate cybersecurity and technology risks into business terms and actionable executive decisions.  
Possesses at least one of the following professional credentials (or other industry\-related credential): CISSP, CRISC, CISM, CISA  


The successful candidate will demonstrate:  


Executive presence and sound judgment  
Strategic and enterprise\-level thinking  
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity and technology risk  
Regulatory fluency

Enterprise Platforms Technology (**EPTech**) comprises many of Capital One’s most important enterprise platforms. We establish practices for building technology solutions across the company and deliver capabilities that exemplify those practices.

  

As a Director TPM in EPTech, you will leverage your technical acumen and engineering experience to drive the strategy and execution of large\-scale, technically complex, cross\-functional programs aligned with Capital One’s business priorities. * Drive development of and alignment on program roadmap anchored in business objectives, definition of done, technical solutions, and sequencing of dependencies
* Lead cross\-platform technical investment planning and ensure architectural alignment toward long\-term platform convergence and reuse
* Serve as an executive\-level escalation point for program risks, influencing technology leaders to make data\-driven tradeoffs between speed, cost and resiliency
* Ensure definition of measurable outcomes of platform success (availability, scalability, cost efficiency, developer velocity) and ensure delivery accountability across multiple engineering teams

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field
* At least 7 years of experience managing technical programs

* 3\+ years of experience in building distributed systems \& highly available services using cloud computing services / architecture \- preferably using AWS
* 3\+ years experience building highly scalable products \& platforms
* 3\+ years of experience with Agile delivery
* 3\+ years years experience delivering large and complex programs \- where you contribute to the business or technical vision, collaborate with large cross\-functional teams, secure commitments on deliverables and unblock teams to land business impact

The University of Louisville is hiring a Research Projects Program Manager. The position, with a specialty in operational technology testing and validation, will serve as the overall event director, working to plan, coordinate, and execute testing and validation experiences in support of the Department of War (DoW). This role is responsible for developing event scenarios, assigning team roles, monitoring progress, and ensuring successful delivery of all program objectives.  



  

This is a grant funded position with funding through August 15, 2027\. Continued employment is contingent upon the availability of funds.  



  

This position supports defense‑related projects funded by a U.S. Department of Defense grant. An offer of employment is contingent upon the selected candidate being eligible for and able to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance (Secret or higher) and any necessary export control licenses to perform the job functions.  



  

This is an in\-person position.  

  



Key Responsibilities


* Serve as the primary point of contact for DoD sponsors and stakeholders.
* Design, plan, and execute technology testing events, field exercises, and validation experiences that simulate real\-world operational conditions relevant to current defense priorities and contemporary conflict environments.
* Coordinate with military stakeholders, technical subject matter experts, academic partners, and industry participants to develop realistic test scenarios, success criteria, and evaluation frameworks.
* Oversee project planning, scheduling, and resource allocation to ensure all milestones and deliverables are met.
* Assign roles and responsibilities to project staff and ensure clear communication across all functional areas.
* Manage logistics and operational execution for field demonstrations, prototype testing, and technology assessment events, including site coordination, scheduling, resource allocation, equipment support, and vendor readiness.
* Excellent communication skills are required, as this position will interact with a variety of personnel across academic, industry, defense, and federal funding landscapes.
* Track participant progress, testing outcomes, technology performance metrics, and program impact; collect and analyze data to generate reports and demonstrate measurable outcomes aligned with relevant Statement of Work requirements.
Develop after\-action reports, lessons learned, and recommendations for technology refinement, follow\-on funding opportunities, and transition pathways into defense acquisition or pilot programs.  
*

* 5 \+ years of direct experience in program management, defense technology testing, operational exercises, field demonstrations, or technology validation environments.
* Experience coordinating complex technical projects involving multiple stakeholders, vendors, and operational constraints.
* Ability to effectively communicate technical and operational concepts with a variety of audiences.
* Proven expertise in managing programs, including planning, execution, budgeting, risk management, logistics coordination, and delivery of technical demonstrations or validation events (PMP certification or equivalent experience a plus).
* Familiarity with defense innovation, prototype evaluation, dual\-use technologies, autonomy systems, sensing platforms, communications technologies, or advanced manufacturing solutions preferred.

jobs.description:
What IT Program & Project Management Office (PMO) contributes to Cardinal Health

The PMO drives business outcomes by transforming strategic vision into execution through robust program governance, modern tools, and proactive change leadership. This function mobilizes high-performing project teams, aligns resource capacity to strategic priorities, and establishes clear accountability for deliverables. As financial and operational stewards, this job family optimizes project investments, proactively mitigates risks, and ensures rigorous adherence to quality standards while leveraging strategic partnerships and holding vendors accountable to ensure project success is achieved and outcomes are realized.

The Director, Technology Strategy & Execution (IT PMO) is a key leader in the IT Project Management Office responsible for shaping the portfolio and maximizing its strategic value. This role goes beyond traditional execution metrics; while maintaining a rigorous focus on delivering projects on time, within scope, and on budget, this leader ensures that the fundamental business case is met, strategic outcomes are achieved, and long-term business value is realized. This leader will oversee a portfolio of complex IT initiatives, ensuring close alignment with organizational goals, and will be instrumental in evolving the PMO into a high-performing strategic partner that actively shapes and protects business investments.

Location
- Nationwide, fully remote (with preference towards candidates in ET/CT, willing and able to travel to our global HQ in Central Ohio 5-10%)

Responsibilities

Portfolio & Strategic Alignment: Champion the IT PMO strategy by shifting from administrative progress reporting to actively shaping the enterprise portfolio, ensuring investments directly drive strategic business value and outcomes.
Predictive PMO Enablement: Champion the adoption of Planview and the integration of AI-driven insights, focusing on what will happen to drive proactive decision-making rather than merely reporting on what has already occurred.
Talent Leadership & Workforce Coaching: Build a future-ready workforce by upskilling, mentoring, and coaching project managers; cultivate critical situational skills including critical thinking, relationship building, and thriving in ambiguity.
Upstream Demand Shaping (“Shift Left”): Drive proactive “shift left” processes, including pre-project estimating and business-case planning, to ensure new work is rigorously scoped and aligned to strategic goals before execution begins.
Empowered Truth & Accountability: Foster a high-trust culture where PMO professionals are empowered to drive accountability, speak the truth on project health, and proactively escalate risks and critical dependencies.
Executive Risk & Resource Stewardship: Partner with senior leadership to assess enterprise-wide project risks, strategic dependencies, and resource constraints, facilitating timely, data-driven decisions and governance.
Vendor Accountability & Value Management: Collaborate with Solution Owners and Indirect Procurement to actively manage technology investments, leveraging strategic partnerships and holding vendors accountable to maximize delivered value.
Strategic Influence & Negotiation: Drive consensus and alignment across diverse, cross-functional stakeholder groups in sensitive or complex business situations while maintaining positive, collaborative relationships.

Qualifications

Ideally targeting individuals with 10-12+ years of experience in IT project/program management (5+ in people leadership capacity highly preferred)
Proven experience managing large-scale IT programs, with a demonstrated ability to evolve a PMO from an execution-focused to a value-driven organization.
Prior experience with Planview is preferred, not required.
Proven experience designing and implementing front-end governance or “shift left” processes, including pre-project sizing, demand shaping, and strategic capacity management.
Exceptional relationship-building and situational leadership skills, with a proven ability to challenge status-quo thinking, negotiate high-risk vendor parameters, and influence executive stakeholders.
Strong leadership capabilities with experience in championing talent development, coaching, and building a high-performing, resilient team.
PMP or similar certification preferred.

Healthy lifestyle programs

jobs.title: Growth Platforms - Deloitte Microsoft Technology Practice - Global Sale & Solution Center - Architect, Senior Manager - C_MAT
jobs.description:
The Team

Deloitte delivers Microsoft services globally across strategy, architecture, implementation, and operations. Our global network offers a flexible delivery model enabling us to best serve our clients, markets, geographies with integrated solutions and services. We are recognized as a global leader in Cloud and Digital transformation. IMPORTANT NOTE: Microsoft is a Deloitte audit client, so we cannot and do not have an alliance or partnership with Microsoft.

Deloitte is recognized as an undisputed global leader in a high-growth and rapidly transforming market. We architect strategies for growth transformation and value creation. We use digital innovation to unlock business value through the power of technology. Given Deloitte's attest relationship with Microsoft it is also a priority objective to understand and promote our need for independence globally.

The Role

The Deloitte Microsoft Technology Practice is seeking a Microsoft Global Sales and Solution Center (GSSC) Architect to support strategic client opportunities. This full-time role works within a rotational, cross-functional team of architects and enablement professionals from Global Member Firms and the USI shared services team. The architect should bring deep expertise in Microsoft Azure and working knowledge across Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Security, and Microsoft Copilot and agentic AI capabilities. The role requires experience in enterprise architecture, solution shaping, estimation, commercial modeling, and delivery leadership. Experience working with Deloitte practices is preferred. The GSSC coordinates across business, industry, and technology teams to accelerate offering development and provide a central hub for pursuit architecture, estimation, responsible AI, security, and delivery planning for strategic Microsoft pursuits in the U.S., including Government & Public Services.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/16/2026.

Work You'll Do

Strategic Responsibilities

Contribute to the vision, operating model, and roadmap for Microsoft GSSC initiatives in partnership with practice leadership and the Microsoft CTO/Chief Architect community.
Lead architecture and commercial shaping for complex Microsoft pursuits spanning Azure, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Security, and Copilot and agentic AI solutions.
Translate business and industry outcomes into secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-optimized reference architectures w/ Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Well-Architected Framework.
Shape responsible AI and agentic solutions, including model and agent selection, grounding and retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, observability, human oversight, and content-safety controls.
Establish trusted client relationships and guide pursuit teams through architecture tradeoffs, implementation options, delivery risk, licensing considerations, and measurable business value.
Identify reusable assets, accelerators, industry patterns, and investment priorities that differentiate Deloitte in the market.
Architect Operate and managed-service capabilities, including observability, reliability engineering, SecOps, FinOps, data governance, and continuous optimization.
Promote platform engineering, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, inner-source practices, GitHub and Azure DevOps automation, and AI-assisted software delivery.
Champion Microsoft independence requirements and permissible-use guidance in internal and client-facing activities.
Build practice capability through architecture reviews, communities of practice, webinars, coaching, and industry-specific solution enablement.

Tactical Responsibilities

Standardize pursuit intake, architecture decisions, estimation, staffing, pricing, delivery planning, and quality reviews through reusable templates and Deloitte artifact standards.
Apply Microsoft independence guidance and coordinate timely reviews for proposed technologies, solution components, demonstrations, and client interactions.
Develop estimates, consumption assumptions, licensing inputs, pricing models, and commercial constructs for cloud, data, AI, application, security, and managed-service engagements.
Coordinate with adjacent ecosystems and practices, including SAP, Oracle, data and analytics, cyber, engineering, industry, and cloud operations, for integrated solutions.
Use Azure DevOps and GitHub for demand tracking, repositories, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, architecture records, code scanning, automated testing, and AI-assisted delivery workflows.
Lead rapid prototypes and R&D for Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI services, and modern application platforms.
Embed Zero Trust, Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Purview, Defender, Sentinel, data residency, accessibility, privacy, and responsible AI requirements into solution designs.
Facilitate architecture reviews and Well-Architected assessments that address reliability, security, cost optimization, operational excellence, performance efficiency, and sustainability.
Measure and continuously improve GSSC outcomes, including pursuit cycle time, estimate quality, asset reuse, architecture risk, delivery readiness, and realized business value.

Required Qualifications

Experienced Consultant 8+ years.
Five or more years of Microsoft cloud architecture, engineering, or delivery experience, including deep Azure expertise.
Demonstrated architecture experience across cloud-native applications, integration, data platforms, identity, networking, security, resiliency, and hybrid or multicloud environments.
Hands-on knowledge of generative and agentic AI patterns using Microsoft Foundry and/or Copilot Studio, including grounding, tools and connectors, orchestration, evaluation, monitoring, and responsible AI controls.
Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, and Power BI.
Experience with GitHub, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code using Bicep or Terraform, automated testing, software supply-chain security, and platform engineering.
Knowledge of Microsoft Entra, Defender, Sentinel, Purview, Zero Trust, privacy, data governance, regulatory requirements, and secure AI design.
Ability to apply the Cloud Adoption Framework, Azure Well-Architected Framework, architecture decision records, FinOps practices, and workload assessment methods.
Strong pursuit leadership, estimation, licensing and consumption planning, commercial shaping, executive communication, and cross-functional team-management skills.
Experience developing reusable assets, accelerators, reference architectures, or industry solutions is preferred.
Deloitte experience and practical knowledge of Microsoft independence requirements are preferred.
Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification is preferred; Azure AI Engineer Associate, Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Power Platform Solution Architect Expert, Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, or equivalent role-relevant credentials are beneficial.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $141,200-$278,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
Company Description
OMEGA GESTION DE INVERSIONES SGIIC SA is an independent investment firm focused on alternative assets, with deep specialization in Hedge Funds and Private Equity. The firm offers sophisticated investment solutions designed for clients seeking diversification beyond traditional markets. OMEGA combines rigorous research, risk management, and innovative strategies to deliver long-term value. Team members collaborate in a dynamic, analytical environment where technology and security are critical to safeguarding client assets and data.
Role Description
The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is a full-time, remote role responsible for leading the firm’s information security strategy and operations. The CISO will design, implement, and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures aligned with regulatory requirements and best practices for financial and alternative investment firms. Day-to-day responsibilities include overseeing cybersecurity monitoring and incident response, managing application and infrastructure security controls, and coordinating business continuity and disaster recovery planning. The CISO will assess and mitigate security risks, lead security audits and compliance reviews, and report on security posture and remediation plans to senior leadership. This role also involves collaborating with technology, operations, and investment teams to ensure secure architecture, vendor risk management, and continuous improvement of security capabilities.
Qualifications

Strong expertise in Information Security Management and Information Security, with experience defining and enforcing security policies, standards, and governance frameworks.
Comprehensive knowledge of Cybersecurity practices, including threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, and security monitoring in financial services or similar regulated environments.
Experience in Application Security, covering secure software development practices, code review, threat modeling, and integration of security controls into applications and platforms.
Proven ability to design and maintain Business Continuity and disaster recovery plans, ensuring resilience of critical systems and services.
Experience with relevant regulatory and industry frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, financial sector regulations) and risk management methodologies.
Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, lead cross-functional initiatives, and present complex security topics to non-technical audiences.
Background in IT infrastructure, cloud security, and identity and access management; familiarity with vendor and third-party risk management.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or equivalent are highly beneficial.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a remote setting, manage priorities, and drive strategic security initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term moves and work to create a vision that is forward-thinking for our people, our clients, and the world at large.

We are looking for a Vice President - Technology
to join our Group at Endress + Hauser Flow India

What is the role about?

The role is to lead the maintenance and technical improvement activities within the manufacturing division. It is also about leading local R+D activities for development of new products or features as well as the production rig manufacturing and retrofit team, executing engineering directives from global headquarters for global applications in 6 factories in Asia, Europe and the Americas.

Which tasks will you perform?

Lead the maintenance and technical improvement organization, ensuring high equipment uptime, precision, and operational stability.
Guide the retrofit and rig manufacturing team including its department head, to implement upgrades and new builds based on HQ Engineering specifications.
Steer the development team, including its department head, to develop product features and improvements for local markets based on HQ Marketing and R+D specifications.
Drive life cycle management of high-value production equipment.
Ensure alignment with global engineering standards and directives.
Collaborate with peer VPs and global stakeholders to support factory-wide strategic initiatives.
Conduct organizational transformation and continuous improvement programs.
Build and develop high-performing technical teams for new and evolving activities.
Implement and optimize business processes related to maintenance, retrofits, and technical operations.
Promote a culture of safety, innovation, and operational excellence.
Steer the manufacturing engineering team including its department head, to ensure preparedness for capacity planning for volume growth, planning and monitoring of Investment roadmap, ensuring lean production concepts and developing and life cycle management of manufacturing processes
Guide a Team of MES software development team including its department head, to ensure development and implementation of SAP MES applications and digital manufacturing.

What do we expect from you?

Masters in the field of Mechanical or Electrical Engineering with a proven experience of manufacturing / development of complex industrial products and/or industrial engineering.
To be able to lead, Inspire and guide a team of Managers
Have a Proven track record of mastering metrological methods and technologies
Excited to Develop / Manufacture Complex Engineering Products
Experience of Building Teams
Possess a LEAN Six Sigma Black Belt
Lead an Organizational transformation
Experience of Business process management and Communication and collaboration in global networks
Strategic and hands-on leadership style
Strong intercultural communication and collaboration skills.
High resilience and adaptability in dynamic environments.
Passion for innovation and continuous improvement.

Masters / PHD in electrical or mechanical engineering / Master of Business Administration or equivalent and LEAN Six Sigma Black Belt
Min experiences 15 years
>10 years leadership in manufacturing complex industrial products and/or machinery, industrial engineering and / product development
Min. 5 years’ experience in leading managers

Endress+Hauser is amongst world’s best employers with Net Sales of 3.3 billion euros (Over 15,800 employees worldwide)
Over 8,700 patents and patent applications.
We promote lifelong learning with versatile training and further education opportunities, internal knowledge transfer and e-learning.
Immense Opportunities for growth
Global Exposure and International Travel

jobs.title: Director, Digital Marketing Technology
jobs.description:
About The Role

The Director of
Digital Marketing Technology
is responsible for developing, optimizing, and governing the marketing technology ecosystem that supports demand generation, digital customer experience, product marketing, CRM operations, and data-driven decision-making across the organization. This leader will align tools, processes, and integrations to accelerate growth for a multi-brand foodservice and hygiene healthcare portfolio, driving efficiencies that improve marketing performance, sales enablement, and customer engagement.

Location:
This role will be located ON-SITE
at our corporate office in either Lodi, NJ
or Oklahoma City, OK
.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Technology Strategy

Define and maintain the enterprise marketing technology roadmap aligned to business priorities, digital transformation goals, and brand growth plans.
Evaluate emerging platforms and tools in areas such as automation, personalization, analytics, content management, and digital advertising.
Ensure technology scalability across diverse verticals (foodservice, healthcare, hygiene).

Platform Management & Optimization

Own the architecture, implementation, and integration of platforms including:
CRM (e.g., Salesforce)
Marketing automation (e.g., HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot)
CMS (e.g., WordPress, Sitecore)
DAM, PIM, SEO tools, data enrichment platforms, analytics dashboards, and ERP data connections.

Improve system performance, data quality, workflows, lead management, and reporting insights.

Governance & Data Integrity

Establish governance protocols around data capture, segmentation, privacy compliance (GDPR, HIPAA considerations), and lifecycle.
Partner with IT to ensure security standards and reliable system architecture.
Drive cross-brand data standardization to enable unified reporting.

Sales Enablement

Oversee connectivity between marketing systems and CRM-driven sales workflows.
Automate handoff processes, lead scoring, and intent-based routing.
Provide visibility into funnel health, conversion metrics, and revenue attribution.

Digital Customer Experience

Support digital product catalog experiences, configurators, content syndication, and sample request flows.
Drive personalization strategies across web, email, and channel partner ecosystems.
Enable customer journey mapping and optimization.

Analytics & Performance Insights

Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks for multi-brand performance tracking.
Translate data into recommendations for campaign optimization, product focus, and content strategy.
Partner with Finance and Sales to validate attribution models.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Collaborate with Brand, Product Marketing, Sales, IT, Customer Success, Ecommerce, and Operations.
Train marketing teams on platform capabilities, measurement practices, and automation workflows.
Manage vendor relationships and negotiate platform contracts.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Information Systems, or related field (Master’s preferred).
8–12+ years of marketing operations or marketing technology experience, ideally in B2B manufacturing, healthcare, or foodservice industries.
Proven success implementing martech platforms across distributed business units.
Deep understanding of:
Lead lifecycle & scoring
CRM architecture
Multi-touch attribution
Funnel analytics
Data enrichment and governance

Experience managing marketing technology budgets and vendor relationships.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business value.

Preferred Skills

Experience with field sales teams and distributor networks.
Understanding of healthcare compliance and foodservice regulatory landscapes.
Familiarity with ERP integrations and product data management workflows.
Comfort leading change management in evolving organizations.

What You'll Bring

Strategic mindset with hands-on technical proficiency.
Passion for enabling marketers with better tools, data, and insights.
Curiosity for new platforms and evolving digital customer expectations.
Ability to influence without authority across matrixed teams.

Why Join Us

At CFS-style Organizations, You’ll Have An Opportunity To

Shape a modern marketing engine within a growing, multi-brand organization.
Champion digital transformation from strategy to execution.
Help healthcare and foodservice operators deliver safer, cleaner, more efficient experiences to patients, guests, and staff.
Work with collaborative teams who value innovation, accountability, and results.

CFS Brands

Headquarters located in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, CFS BRANDS is a market-leading designer, manufacturer and distributor of commercial foodservice, healthcare, and industrial hygiene products.

CFS BRANDS has maintained its industry-leading position and consistent growth with a strong focus on customer support and satisfaction, product variety and availability, and a unique ability to be a “one-stop shop” solution for a wide range of organizations. CFS BRANDS enjoys this competitive market advantage through its extensive network of brands and global manufacturing and distribution facilities.

CFS BRANDS’s core products include dinnerware, drinkware, professional cookware, industrial hygiene products brushes and cleaning tools, dispensing systems, and healthcare meal service equipment. These products are provided through major distributors customers across the country.

CFS BRANDS became a portfolio company of The Jordan Company (“TJC”), a private equity firm, in 2018. More information on CFS BRANDS can be found at www.cfsbrands.com.

jobs.title: Program Manager – Construction Management Services (CMS)
jobs.description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!  



At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.  



**Job Description:**


Parsons is seeking a highly qualified **Program Manager** to lead Construction Management Services (CMS) in support of a major U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) program. The Program Manager will be responsible for the overall management, coordination, and execution of CMS task orders under an Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ), Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC), ensuring compliance with all contract requirements, Federal regulations, and USACE standards.

  

  

**What You’ll be Doing**


* **Program Leadership:** Provide overall management and leadership for all CMS activities, ensuring compliance with USACE, Federal, and contract\-specific requirements.
* **Staffing \& Coordination:** Oversee recruiting, staffing, and coordination of CMS personnel to meet all experience, performance, and responsibility requirements for each task order. Lead bi\-weekly meetings as requested by the Contracting Officer and track payment invoices for all task orders, providing monthly reports on contract totals and remaining capacity.
* **Quality Assurance:** Ensure the implementation of Quality Assurance (QA) procedures in accordance with the Government Project Specific Quality Assurance Plan (PSQAP), ER 1180\-1\-6, and other applicable regulations.
* **Contract Administration:** Support the Contracting Officer’s Representative (COR) in contract administration, including review of submittals, progress schedules, safety plans, and contract modifications.
* **Reporting \& Documentation:** Oversee the preparation and submission of required documentation and reports, including daily QA reports, pre\-construction plan reviews, and correspondence for COR signature, using MS Word/Excel, USACE RMS, and other approved formats.
* **Risk Management:** Identify program risks and develop mitigation strategies, including those related to schedule, cost, safety, and quality.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Serve as the primary point of contact for coordination with Government personnel, subcontractors, and other stakeholders.
* **Compliance:** Ensure all personnel meet required training (e.g., USACE Construction Quality Management for Contractors, safety, and ethics), security clearance, and background check requirements.
* **Veterans Employment:** Promote the training and employment of U.S. veterans in accordance with USACE guidance.
  

  

What Required Skills You'll Bring:


* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field.
* Must have a current/active Secret Clearance or above
* Must be able to travel up to 50% of the time.
* 15\+ years with a minimum of 5 years of experience in program management for construction management services, with at least 10 years preferred for senior\-level consideration. Experience must include oversight of large, complex construction programs, preferably for Federal or military clients
* Demonstrated ability to manage multi\-disciplinary teams and multiple concurrent task orders.
* Strong knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR), USACE practices, and applicable codes/standards.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Proficiency in project management tools and USACE RMS.
* Ability to obtain and maintain additional security clearances as required by specific task orders.
* Commitment to maintaining a safety\-minded management team and culture.
* Completion of USACE Construction Quality Management for Contractors course (within last 5 years)
* Minimum 10 hours of recent safety training (within last 2 years)
  

  

What Desired Skills You'll Bring:


* Active TS/SCI clearance
* Professional Registration as PE or RA
* Certification as PMP and/or CCM
* Experience managing large programs using Progressive Design Build, CM at Risk, or other early contractor involvement

**Security Clearance Requirement:**


An active Secret security clearance is required for this position.
This position is part of our Federal Solutions team.
The Federal Solutions segment delivers resources to our US government customers that ensure the success of missions around the globe. Our intelligent employees drive the state of the art as they provide services and solutions in the areas of defense, security, intelligence, infrastructure, and environmental. We promote a culture of excellence and close\-knit teams that take pride in delivering, protecting, and sustaining our nation's most critical assets, from Earth to cyberspace. Throughout the company, our people are anticipating what’s next to deliver the solutions our customers need now.
Salary Range: $148,300\.00 \- $266,900\.00
We value our employees and want our employees to take care of their overall wellbeing, which is why we offer best\-in\-class benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), 401(k), life insurance, flexible work schedules, and holidays to fit your busy lifestyle!
This position will be posted for a minimum of 3 days and will continue to be posted for an average of 30 days until a qualified applicant is selected or the position has been cancelled.
Parsons is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other protected status.

jobs.title: DIRECTOR OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
jobs.description:
**DEPARTMENT:** Information Services




**POSITION:** Director of Information Technology




**SUPERVISOR:** Vice President of Human Resources and Information Technology/Director of Information Services


The Director is responsible for general oversight under the guidance of senior leadership. The Director is responsible for the design, implementation, and maintenance of the healthcare center's core infrastructure equipment and systems. The role involves ensuring the stability, integrity, and security of in\-house voice, data, video, wired and wireless network infrastructure. This role may require availability after hours as needed for network/system maintenance, emergencies, or to respond to cybersecurity incidents.

* Manage and coordinate all IT\-related matters including systems integration, data, wireless communications, mobile technology, telephony, security, and computer hardware and software.
* Oversee the administration and maintenance of computer stations and software for company and clinical operations, ensuring all systems are compliant with health industry regulations such as HIPAA and HITECH.
* Develop and implement network maintenance and growth plans. Oversee the administration of the company's all networks.
* Develop and enforce policy and procedures to ensure the protection of the IT assets and the integrity, security and privacy of information entrusted to or maintained by the organization.
* Manage IT staff, under the guidance of senior management which includes hiring, training, guidance, and discipline. Ensure high team morale through effective communication and timely issue resolution.
* Conduct routine system audits to ensure compliance with the organization's established standards, policies, and configuration guidelines.
* Maintain knowledge of evolving trends in IT infrastructure and cybersecurity and apply new technologies where applicable.
* Create and manage a disaster recovery plan and respond to all cybersecurity breaches.
* Develop a technical process improvement framework to optimize systems, networks, and infrastructure for better efficiency and performance.
* Oversee the development and enhancement of systems, networks, and integrating new systems with those existing.
* Ensure that networks, systems, and data availability meet business continuity requirements.
* Monitor and analyze system logs to identify potential issues with computer systems, networks, and applications.
* Spearhead troubleshooting, systems backups, archiving, incident response, and disaster recovery, providing expert support when necessary.
* Collaborate with senior management as it pertains to relationship management of vendors and support staff that provide hardware, software, system, network, cybersecurity, and solutions.
* Oversee large scale IT projects such as upgrades and deployments, where necessary. Represent the IT department in coordination with project leaders from other departments and divisions.
* Evaluate potential cybersecurity breaches, coordinate incident response, and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure clear communication with all parties.
* Assist senior management with budgetary planning for the IT department.
* Perform any other duties as assigned.




This role requires the ability to prioritize tasks effectively in a fast\-paced environment, strong customer service skills, and a willingness to explore and adopt new technologies that enhance institutional efficiency. The incumbent must demonstrate strong technical skills in network and systems engineering, along with an in\-depth understanding of cybersecurity principles and best practices.




The role should be carried out according to the highest ethical and moral standards, in adherence to the facility’s corporate compliance plan and all applicable laws. The incumbent must adhere to the facility’s confidentiality statement in accessing and safeguarding protected health information (PHI/ePHI) of residents and employees, as necessary to perform job duties.




Dynamic, hands\-on Director of Information Technology to provide technical expertise and leadership in the areas of network, systems, and cybersecurity, as well as project management. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing and managing all aspects of our information technology systems and ensuring the seamless operation of our IT infrastructure.




* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field; a master’s degree or relevant certifications (such as CISSP, CISM, PMP) are desirable.
* Minimum of 7 years of experience in IT management, with a focus on network, systems, and cybersecurity; experience in a healthcare environment is preferred.
* Excellent project management skills, with a proven track record of successful IT project implementation.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and manage IT personnel.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with all levels of the organization.
* Proactive and solution\-oriented, with the ability to anticipate and address potential IT issues before they arise.

jobs.title: Chief Information Officer, Optum Serve
jobs.description:
For those who want to invent the future of health care, here's your opportunity. We're going beyond basic care to health programs integrated across the entire continuum of care. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

As the Chief Information Officer (CIO) for Optum Serve, you will serve as a strategic technology executive leading the technology roadmap, engineering, IT operations, and platform capabilities that support our federal government clients. Optum Serve is dedicated to helping federal agencies \- including the Department of War (DoW), Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), and Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) \- deliver world\-class healthcare, administrative services, and advanced technology programs.

  

In this role, you will lead a high\-performing technology organization, navigating complex federal regulatory landscapes, contractual constraints, and stringent security frameworks. You will drive innovation, AI products, leverage cloud solutions, and advanced emerging tools, and ensure operational excellence across mission\-critical healthcare systems that serve millions of military members, veterans, and citizens.

  

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely \* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.


For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Manage and orchestrate the entire IT ecosystem that supports the Optum Serve business including driving overarching technology strategy, AI product delivery, and delivery execution for the Optum Serve business, ensuring alignment with federal healthcare goals and enterprise objectives
* Serve as a senior customer facing technology executive advisor, engaging senior federal customers and internal executives on complex, high impact technology challenges
* Provide thought leadership on federal healthcare technology trends, emerging capabilities, and regulatory considerations
* Lead transformation of the Optum Serve technology operating model, continuously improving governance, value delivery, capability ownership, accountability structures, and organizational effectiveness
* Partner with Growth and Strategy leaders to identify emerging market opportunities, shape future capabilities, and ensure technology investment strategies support long\-term growth objectives
* Serve as a strategic advisor on how technology, data, AI, and digital capabilities can create competitive differentiation in federal healthcare markets
* Partner with business executives to establish transparent prioritization frameworks that align technology capacity with Optum Serve's highest\-value strategic, operational, contractual, and customer commitments
* Establish and mature technology capability management processes, including build, buy, partner, and reuse strategies that maximize enterprise assets while accelerating delivery
* Provide enterprise wide technical and strategic advisory leadership influencing growth, modernization, and digital transformation initiatives
* Shape and validate customer aligned technology strategies and solution approaches for capture, proposal, and pre\-sales efforts
* Identify growth opportunities through market intelligence, customer engagement, and strategic advisory insight
* Translate ambiguous and novel customer requirements into scalable, compliant solution architectures leveraging existing enterprise platforms
* Lead executive briefings, industry day engagements, and solution demonstrations as the senior technical authority
* Advise on integration, interoperability, data architecture, and security approaches across platforms and partners
* Navigate and manage strict federal regulatory requirements, contractual obligations and security frameworks (including FISMA, FedRAMP, FAR/DFARS compliance, HIPAA, and NIST guidelines)
* Lead the integration of advanced emerging technologies and enterprise AI tools, setting strategic technology goals, and aligning talent development with key digital competencies to accelerate modernization
* Champion the ethical and compliant use of technology and advanced analytics, embedding transparency, fairness, and strict data governance across the solution development lifecycle
* Strategically leverage AI, data, and cloud capabilities to solve complex operational problems, unlock new program efficiencies, and deliver robust mission value to federal agencies
* Manage enterprise risk and security postures in coordination with the Chief Information Security Officer, ensuring consistent renewal of federal Authorities to Operate (ATOs) and the protection of sensitive data (CUI)
* Oversee multi\-million\-dollar technology budgets, direct contract negotiations, and optimize vendor partnerships to achieve strong SLAs and financial stewardship
* Build, mentor, and inspire a world\-class technology organization, promoting a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer\-centric delivery

  

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 15\+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including 5\+ years of executive\-level IT management
* 8\+ years of experience leading technology delivery, IT operations, or systems engineering specifically within federal government contracting environments (e.g., DoW, VA, HHS)
* 8\+ years experience advising executive stakeholders and customers on technology strategy, architecture, and modernization
* 5\+ years of experience managing compliance and contract governance constraints, including FAR/DFARS, FISMA, FedRAMP, NIST standards, and HIPAA
* 5\+ years of direct financial responsibility overseeing large\-scale technology portfolio

jobs.title: Director, Technical Program Manager (EPTech)
jobs.description:
Posted Date 9/28/2026
Description Director, Technical Program Manager (EPTech)
Do you love driving complex technical initiatives and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast\-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors, who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking Technical Program Managers who are passionate about marrying technology with business strategy to join our team. As a Technical Program Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving major technical transformations and scaling platform capabilities across Capital One.

  

  

??Enterprise Platforms Technology (**EPTech**) comprises many of Capital One’s most important enterprise platforms. We establish practices for building technology solutions across the company and deliver capabilities that exemplify those practices.


As a Director TPM in EPTech, you will leverage your technical acumen and engineering experience to drive the strategy and execution of large\-scale, technically complex, cross\-functional programs aligned with Capital One’s business priorities. You’ll break down complexity and organizational silos, influence roadmaps, dive deep into system design and architecture, make technical tradeoffs, drive platform consolidation, and identify, resolve, define, and escalate mitigation plans for hard technical dependencies.

  

  

**What You’ll Do:**


As a Director of Technical Program Management (TPM), we’re looking for someone that can help us lead programs that deliver on critical business goals and build large scale products \& platforms that will help Capital One customers have incredible experiences.

  

  

In addition to the technical program, you will also work to pave the way for an expanding TPM discipline within the team, by leveraging your industry knowledge and experience to teach the organization what a great TPM can achieve.

  

  

* Contribute to the organization’s TPM / Delivery strategy: establish operating mechanisms, maturity models, and tooling that scale across portfolios
* Drive development of and alignment on program roadmap anchored in business objectives, definition of done, technical solutions, and sequencing of dependencies
* Lead cross\-platform technical investment planning and ensure architectural alignment toward long\-term platform convergence and reuse
* Serve as an executive\-level escalation point for program risks, influencing technology leaders to make data\-driven tradeoffs between speed, cost and resiliency
* Ensure definition of measurable outcomes of platform success (availability, scalability, cost efficiency, developer velocity) and ensure delivery accountability across multiple engineering teams
  

  

**Basic Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in a technical field
* At least 7 years of experience managing technical programs
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* 7\+ years of experience designing and building solutions using distributed computing or service oriented architecture (SOA)
* 3\+ years of experience in building distributed systems \& highly available services using cloud computing services / architecture \- preferably using AWS
* 3\+ years experience building highly scalable products \& platforms
* 3\+ years of experience with Agile delivery
* 3\+ years years experience delivering large and complex programs \- where you contribute to the business or technical vision, collaborate with large cross\-functional teams, secure commitments on deliverables and unblock teams to land business impact
* Experience in building systems \& solutions within a highly regulated environment
* MBA or Master’s Degree in a related technical field (Computer Science, Software Engineering)
* PMP, Lean, Agile, or Six Sigma certification
* 3\+ years of people management experience or influencing organization as an IC
* Experience driving platform standardization across multiple product portfolios or lines of business
* Track record of building TPM maturity (operating models, career frameworks, metrics) at scale within engineering organizations
* Exceptional communication and influence skills, capable of engaging deeply with technical teams while translating implications into compelling business narratives that persuade senior leadership
  

  

***At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration related support for this position (e.g. H1B, F\-1 OPT, F\-1 STEM OPT, F\-1 CPT, J\-1, TN, E\-3, and O\-1, or any other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer).***


The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part\-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.


McLean, VA: $230,400 \- $263,000 for Director, Technical Program Management  

  

New York, NY: $251,400 \- $286,900 for Director, Technical Program Management  

  

Plano, TX: $209,500 \- $239,100 for Director, Technical Program Management  

  

Richmond, VA: $209,500 \- $239,100 for Director, Technical Program Management  

  

San Francisco, CA: $251,400 \- $286,900 for Director, Technical Program Management  

  



  

  

  

  

  

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.


This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es)

Company Description

About Sia 

Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity, and driven by responsibility. We're optimists for change, and we help clients initiate, navigate, and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.

Sia’s Cybersecurity & AI Trust team is the powerhouse of our firm’s innovation. With over 100 experts worldwide, we tackle projects from proof-of-concept to large-scale deployment, always pushing the boundaries of AI capabilities. By joining Sia’s Cybersecurity team, you’ll step into a vibrant, collaborative environment that nurtures professional growth and empowers you to shape the future of consulting.

Job Description

As a Managing Director within Sia’s Cybersecurity & AI Trust Business Line, this role is responsible for driving the growth and market positioning of the firm through business development, account management, and deep cybersecurity expertise across areas such as cyber strategy, security transformation, and risk and compliance. Responsibilities include the development of strategic client relationships and large-scale engagements across key markets and industries, as well as leading and growing a team of consultants and contributing to the firm's cybersecurity thought leadership and offering development. This position requires a strong external presence, an established senior executive network, and a proven track record of originating and closing new businesses, alongside the ability to lead complex engagements and convert deep technical expertise into sustained commercial impact.

Key Responsibilities

Lead complex cybersecurity engagements from strategy through execution, serving as the senior executive accountable for delivery and client impact.
Provide executive-level guidance on cybersecurity governance, cyber resilience, and cyber transformation to Boards and C-suite leaders.
Lead delivery excellence by ensuring technical rigor, quality assurance, and consistency across engagements while driving optimized staffing and efficient delivery management.

Business Development:   

Drive substantial revenue growth by originating new business through proactive client acquisition, expanding existing relationships, and managing strategic accounts.
Drive the hub’s cybersecurity business expansion by leading go-to-market strategy, commercial prospecting, pre-sales engagement, client sales discussions, and development of tailored solution offerings.
Champion cross-Business Line collaboration by identifying and facilitating opportunities to bring complementary Sia expertise (e.g., Risk, Data, Strategy) into client engagements, maximizing the firm's overall value proposition.

People Leadership and Team Development

Provide, oversight, and mentorship to project teams, ensuring high-quality delivery and alignment with client objectives. 
Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning across engagements and internal initiatives.  
Attract, develop and retain top talent by actively coaching team members, supporting professional growth, and contributing to performance management.  
Implement the Business Line strategy and actively promote the firm’s mission, vision, culture and purpose
Participate in the major cybersecurity trade shows attended by C-Level executives
Drive the achievement of relevant cybersecurity clearances

Thought Leadership & Market Presence

Shape a differentiated point of view on industry trends, emerging technologies, and enterprise transformation, and represent Sia as a recognized voice through conferences, panels, and executive forums. 
Build market credibility through advisory roles, council memberships, and active leadership in professional organizations. 

This job description is not intended to be all inclusive. Duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be added, deleted, or modified at any time based on business needs.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, or information security.
7+ years in a senior leadership role within a consulting firm
Experience leading large-scale enterprise cybersecurity transformations.
Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or cloud security certifications are strongly preferred.

Additional information

Compensation & Benefits 

Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow. 

Compensation 

Base Salary: $200,000–$280,000. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable law.
Personal Sales Bonus (uncapped) 
Annual Performance Bonus (appraisal)

Benefits 

Medical, dental, and vision coverage 
Company-paid life and AD&D insurance; voluntary supplemental insurance and EAP at no cost 
401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA
College savings and student loan repayment programs 
Paid parental leave 
Generous PTO, nine company holidays, and one floating holiday 
Monthly cell phone stipend 
Well-being and professional development programs

GFT
is seeking a Senior Project Manager
to join our Practice or IT Services team! This role follows a remote work model, however you must be located in the United States and preferably in the Central time zone.

Tax-deferred 401(k) savings plan.
Competitive paid-time-off (PTO) accrual.

Commitment to professional development, access to internal and external training programs, and support of active participation in professional organizations
Incentive compensation for eligible positions.

jobs.description:
**Position Description:**Tenna is seeking a hands\-on, forward\-thinking Director of Information Technology to lead and scale our IT function as we continue to grow. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Officer, this leader will own the vision, strategy, and day\-to\-day execution of Tenna’s technology environment, from infrastructure and identity management to company\-wide cybersecurity and compliance. This is a true player\-coach role: you’ll set the direction for IT, build and mentor a high\-performing team, and manage the department’s budget, while also rolling up your sleeves as the go\-to technical expert across Microsoft, Windows, Linux, and cloud environments. You’ll partner closely with Executive Leadership, the CIO, and the CTO to keep our largely remote workforce secure, connected, and productive, and to ensure our systems can scale with the business. This is a highly visible, high\-impact role with the opportunity to shape how technology powers Tenna’s next stage of growth. The perfect candidate is a proven IT leader and Microsoft expert who thrives on ownership, brings a security\-first mindset, and is energized by solving complex problems in a fast\-paced environment.

  


**Why Tenna?**
At Tenna, we believe the best is right in front of all of us, and that each day holds more potential than the one before. We believe that every new discovery can lead to something better than we thought possible. When we boil it down, the top five qualities that define the Tenna Team are quality\-obsessed, gritty, continuous learners, collaborative problem solvers, and just plain awesome. Sound like you? Join us as we empower our customers to control their mixed assets anytime, anywhere, on one comprehensive platform. Apply now!
### **Responsibilities**

* Lead all IT operations for a largely remote organization, providing strategic direction while serving as the senior hands\-on technical practitioner and escalation point
* Configure, operate, and maintain Tenna’s network and server systems, ensuring continuous availability, security, and consistency across all IT resources
* Manage and configure Active Directory, including security groups, domain group policies, Windows update auditing, and feature build deployments
* Administer Azure Active Directory, Azure AD Connect, and SSO integrations, including creation and lifecycle management of user accounts and access
* Administer and maintain Red Hat Enterprise Linux server environments end\-to\-end, including build, configuration, security hardening, and patch management
* Oversee Windows Remote Desktop Services (RDS) environments and administer Office 365 backup and restoration processes
* Support and enable a remote workforce, ensuring secure, reliable access to systems, devices, and applications from any location
* Oversee IT security across the entire company, including Azure Conditional Access policies, Windows hardening standards, and Linux security controls
* Maintain and patch Splunk SIEM infrastructure; monitor and act on security event data
* Audit and enforce security configurations across AWS VPC and EC2 environments
* Own corporate cyber insurance compliance obligations and lead the annual renewal process
* Develop, deliver, and continuously improve the corporate Security Awareness and Training Program
* Enforce Technology Security Policy across the organization; develop and maintain the Corporate Technology Retention Policy and Disaster Recovery Policy
* Coordinate and manage Corporate Technology Penetration Testing engagements and partner with the CTO on all regulatory compliance requirements (i.e. SOC)
* Own and manage the full IT department budget, including all hardware, software, licenses, and SaaS procurement, with full budget authority
* Conduct software and SaaS licensing cost audits, manage cellular corporate accounts, and maintain ongoing license and vendor tracking
* Manage physical network hardware, infrastructure, and the corporate building access system
* Oversee all hiring, performance management, and mentoring of IT team members, including Systems Administrators and Interns
* Partner with Executive Leadership and the CIO to ensure consistent adherence to Tenna’s IT policies and strategic technology direction

### **Requirements**

* 12\+ years of progressive Information Technology experience with demonstrated growth in scope and responsibility
* Proven experience managing people and leading technical teams, including hiring, performance management, and development
* Proven experience managing an entire IT department with full budget authority
* Proven experience overseeing IT security across an entire company
* Demonstrated experience supporting a remote workforce
* 10\+ years of Windows Server administration, including hands\-on experience managing and configuring Active Directory
* Expert\-level knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem is required, including Office 365, Azure AD, and Azure AD Connect; candidates with Google Workspace\-only experience will not be considered
* 10\+ years of Linux server administration with the ability to handle all aspects independently (Red Hat Enterprise Linux strongly preferred)
* Working knowledge of Amazon Web Services (VPC, EC2, S3, Route 53\) is required; expert\-level experience is not necessary
* Solid understanding of VPN infrastructure, enterprise networking, and routing protocols
* Proficiency with Microsoft Windows, macOS, and iOS operating systems, as well as Microsoft Office Suite and Salesforce
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders
* Self\-directed, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment
* Ability to report on\-site to our New Hope, PA office 1–2 times per week
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, or equivalent Information Technology work experience is required.
