jobs.title: Director of Technology Systems
jobs.description:
**GATEWAY SERVICE GROUP**

**Director of Technology Systems**  

Shared Services \| Hybrid — St. Louis or Washington, D.C., up to 50% travel  

Reports to: VP, Strategy and Corporate Development  

**$160,000–$180,000 base \+ 20% target bonus \+ equity participation**  

Gateway Service Group is one of the fastest\-growing commercial property services platforms in the country. We have already chosen the systems that will run this company. What we need now is the person who makes them work together — and who holds the vendors delivering them to the standard we set.  

This is not a strategy role looking for someone to pick a stack. It is an ownership role for someone who wants to build one.  

**About Gateway Service Group**  

Gateway Service Group is a growing, private equity\-backed commercial property services platform operating across lot sweeping, day porter, power washing, construction sweeping, and other exterior property service lines, with branches serving St. Louis, Atlanta, Washington, D.C., Dayton, Philadelphia, and Kansas City.  

**Position Overview**  

The Director of Technology Systems owns how our technology platform performs: making the systems we have chosen work together, holding the vendors who deliver them accountable, and turning what comes out of them into visibility the business actually runs on.  

You are not joining a blank page. Our platform decisions are made and several systems are already live; your job is to finish the build, connect it, and get our systems adopted and talking to each other across every branch and every business we acquire.  

It is also a role that reaches across the whole company. Operations, finance, sales, and HR all depend on these systems, and none of them report to you. Credibility does the work that authority cannot — you earn it by making things work, and you keep it by being straight about what is not working yet.  

You will work closely with our sponsor’s technical operating partner, who continues to lead long\-range architecture and cybersecurity, so you are not carrying the strategy alone. And there is room to grow here: we are hiring at Director level for someone who will own more over time as the platform scales.  

**Key Responsibilities*** **Own the integration program —** serve as the internal accountability owner for the integration between our ERP and our field service platform — holding milestones, vendor performance, and cross\-functional coordination on schedule, with a 12\-month execution plan approved by executive leadership within 90 days of start
* **Drive the selected stack into every branch —** complete our ERP, billing, and field service rollouts across all locations, and carry the HRIS implementation — already well in flight by the time you arrive — through go\-live and adoption
* **Deliver the reporting layer —** the three to five executive KPIs the business runs on, plus recurring versus non\-recurring revenue and gross margin by service line by location, built off the operating platforms where the data already lives
* **Own vendor and MSP relationships —** contract oversight, SLA accountability, and licensing across the technology portfolio — including handling first\-level triage internally before escalating outward, and holding implementation partners to the dates they committed to
* **Execute IT controls and access governance —** including segregation\-of\-duties remediation, working through our managed service provider and alongside finance
* **Support systems work on acquisitions —** our integrations team runs each deal; your job is to make sure no integration milestone waits on systems, vendor scheduling, or data capacity
* **Support compliance\-driven technology needs —** including fleet telematics and DOT reporting, contractor prequalification portals, and payroll and HRIS data integrity
* **Put AI to practical use —** identify and implement AI\-powered tools that automate real workflows, along with the governance and usage standards to deploy them responsibly
* **Manage the technology budget —** report rollout progress and vendor performance to executive leadership regularly, and build institutional capability so that no system depends on one person’s knowledge — including your own

**Who You Are*** **Player\-coach:** you design the plan and execute it personally — equally comfortable presenting a roadmap in the boardroom and configuring a system the next morning in the field at our local branches
* **Builder:** you have built integrations and reporting systems from scratch, and you know what it takes to go from zero to operational in a resource\-constrained environment
* **Owner:** when something breaks, you find out about it before anyone has to tell you. When a vendor slips or an integration breaks, you own it to resolution rather than relaying the vendor’s excuse, and you surface problems to leadership early rather than after they compound
* **Communicator:** you explain complex technology decisions in plain language, and you approach non\-technical colleagues with patience and clarity — whether they run a branch or sit on the leadership team
* **Resourceful:** you do not default to needing more headcount when there is a gap — you find a way with what you have, then build the system that prevents the gap from coming back
* **Coachable:** you will work with a technical operating partner and an executive team who will challenge you, and you get curious rather than defensive when someone tells you that you are wrong
* **Dependable and team\-first:** crews get paid on time because the systems work. You show up the same way for the high\-visibility work and the unglamorous implementation detail, you share what you know freely, and you never let the systems live only in your head

**Required Qualifications*** Eight or more years of progressive enterprise technology, business systems, or technical program management experience, with increasing ownership over time
* At least one ERP or field servic

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Program Protection
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE**



The Anti\-Tamper (AT) team is hiring a Technical Program Manager to drive security on the next generation of autonomous vehicles. You will own complex programs across the AT portfolio from strategy to rollout — partnering daily with infrastructure, platform, and product teams across the company, while building the metrics and reporting that keep leadership informed on program health. This is a hands\-on, builder role. You should be comfortable reading architecture diagrams, pushing back on vague requirements, and turning security goals into shipped outcomes.


### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* **Ensure Overall Success:** Drive the successful execution of AT programs, ensuring defined requirements are met, stay on schedule, and align with budget.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Own project deliverables and provide regular status updates to internal stakeholders.
* **Program Execution:** Lead execution across project tasks and work plans, partnering closely with senior leadership and engineering. Operate with a high degree of ownership and independent judgment. Serve as a trusted partner to our AT teams.
* **Technical Coordination:** Develop a working understanding of AT architectures and their implementations. Coordinate across the portfolio to identify and fill technical gaps. Gather and analyze metrics to identify areas for improvement and track the impact of new initiatives. Maintain a clear picture of program or process health that can be communicated to stakeholders.
* **Project Coordination:** Define project scope and track changes. Identify, document, and monitor project risks. Maintain and update project schedules, action items, and documentation.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Act as a point of contact for internal teams, gathering requirements and feedback. Represent the services and technical capabilities of the AT team to business stakeholders.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree in a technical field like Computer Science, Information Systems, OR a degree in a related field with a demonstrated passion for weapon system security.
* 4\+ years of program and project management experience within a technology environment managing multiple concurrent workstreams.
* 5\+ years of experience in engineering or other related technical disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze technical data, build metrics, and use them to drive decisions and track program and project health.
* Experience working directly with technical teams to translate both program and business requirements into actionable project plans.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent organizational skills with a high detail orientation and commitment to quality.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Occasional travel to other company sites may be required, up to 10% of the time.
* Able to obtain and maintain a US Secret Clearance.

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Project management certification (e.g., PMP, CompTIA Project\+, CAPM).
* Hands\-on experience with project management and collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Smartsheet).
* Background as an AT engineer with expertise in Anti\-Tamper methodologies for protecting critical program information
* Experience standing up or maturing an AT team and portfolio at a high\-growth company


The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including:

  


### **Benefits**



At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  



### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**



Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:


* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
	+ Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
	+ Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly iden

JOB DESCRIPTION
**Title:**


Technical Program Manager
***Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!***


KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high\-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.

  

  

**Why Join Us?**


* **Innovative Projects:** KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions.
* **Collaborative Environment:** Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace.
* **Impactful Work:** Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of space defense.
  

  

**Position Summary:**


KBR, Inc. is seeking a highly capable technical program manager to join our team in Dayton, OH (on\-site). This role supports the Architecture and Systems Engineering (ASE) Group in the development, implementation, and proliferation of mission system Government Reference Architectures (GRAs). These GRAs provide the backbone for enabling advanced sensor capability for emerging and legacy systems across the Air Force, other component services, and international partners. This position serves as a technical program manager performing cost, schedule, performance, and risk management for various contractual activities conducting open system architecture maturation, model\-based systems engineering, software development, and system verification \& validation. The ideal candidate would have experience in agile development, stakeholder management, and program management.  



  

**Key Responsibilities:**


* **Manage:** Utilize data\-driven techniques to guide an industry/government consortium in the maturation, verification, and implementation of GRAs. Program management duties include balancing program cost and schedule factors to drive successful mission outcomes for the Government customer.
* **Lead:** Leads a multi\-disciplinary industry and Government team in developing and executing technical and programmatic strategies focused on delivering superior open system architecture products that meet adopter needs. Utilizes adopter feedback to develop easy\-to\-use Government Reference Architectures and standards.
* **Engage:** Proactively engage with a diverse stakeholder community to ensure user feedback is rapidly and iteratively incorporated into ASE products. Works with stakeholders to formulate collaborative approaches to deliver successful program outcomes.
* **Deliver:** Process owner supporting Agile development of Government Reference Architectures and standards focused on delivering easy to use products and services supporting multiple customers.
* **Perform:** Support the Government customer in developing tactical execution plans based on high\-level strategic guidance. Utilize agile management processes to lead an industry consortium in the execution of those plans.
* **Gap Analysis \& Risk Identification:** Based on identified system capability gaps, system requirements, and stakeholder feedback, formulate and implement executable program strategies that deliver high\-quality open architecture products. Identify and define suitable risk mitigation plans to address program and/or technical issues.

  

**Work Environment:**


* **Location:** Onsite
* **Travel Requirements:** 0\-10%
* **Working Hours:** Standard – Core hours 0900 \- 1500
  

  

**Qualifications:**


**Required:**


* Bachelor of Science is a technical field.
* Active Top Secret clearance.
* 3\+ years in technical execution.
* 10\+ years of technical program management.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to form strong relationships with team members, customers, and other Government partners.
* Strong technical proficiency with a willingness/ability to learn about mission system software architectures.
* Work with a team of Government and industry SMEs to ensure that programmatic and technical objectives are met.
* Ability to own responsibility for deliverables, cost, and schedule.
* Ability to manage workload of simultaneous tasking in a fast paced, high\-demand environment.
* Personality for a consensus building among multiple stakeholders with competing equities.
  

  

**Desired:**


* 10\+ years in technical execution in a software\-related discipline.
* 7\+ years of Government acquisition program management

jobs.title: Vice President, Technology and Product (Remote)
jobs.description:
Company Description

About M3:
A Japanese global leader in the provision of ground-breaking and innovative technological and research solutions to the healthcare industry. The M3 Group operates in the US, Asia, and Europe with over 5.8 million physician members globally via its physician websites which include mdlinx.com, m3.com, research.m3.com, Doctors.net.uk, medigate.net, and medlive.cn. M3 Inc. is a publicly traded company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (jp:2413, NIKKEI 225) with subsidiaries in major markets including the US, UK, Japan, South Korea, and China, and in 2020 was ranked in Forbes’ Global 2000 list. The M3 Group provides services to healthcare and the life science industry. In addition to market research, these services include medical education, ethical drug promotion, clinical development, job recruitment, and clinic appointment services. M3 has offices in Japan, UK, France, Germany, Brazil, Sweden, China, USA, and South Korea, as well as India.

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Vice President, Technology and Product
to join MDLinx
, an M3 company.

About The Business Unit

MDLinx Mission: Transform Omnichannel from Message Delivery to Belief Engineering

MDLinx is on the path to transform its business and product line-up from endemic to omnichannel engagement model, aiming at fulfilling the promise of true omnichannel approach to pharmaceutical brand promotion – “right message to the right physician at the right time on the right channel”. Our goal is to provide pharmaceutical brands with best-in-class personalized HCP engagement programs across the wider media ecosystem, designed to accelerate disease state and brand knowledge penetration, lead generation, and customer conversion. Our ambition is to leverage an omnichannel approach to establish a new philosophy for physician engagement, shifting from delivery to belief engineering.

Job Description

Strategic Leadership

Define and execute the technology roadmap with a focus on AI-driven personalization and content intelligence.
Champion rapid prototyping and experimentation culture across engineering and product teams
Partner with Product, Editorial, Sales, and Marketing teams to translate business needs into technical solutions.
Lead AI/ML initiatives for content curation, recommendation engines, and predictive physician engagement.
Establish an experimentation framework with an A/B testing infrastructure and data-driven decision-making.
Drive innovation sprints and hackathons to accelerate the development of new features.

Platform & Architecture

Build robust community platforms enabling peer-to-peer engagement among healthcare professionals.
Develop a comprehensive MarTech stack integrating CDP, marketing automation, and omnichannel orchestration.
Architect first-party data infrastructure to capture, unify, and activate physician behavioral signals
Design scalable APIs and integration layers for pharmaceutical partner platforms and data exchanges.
Implement real-time personalization engines leveraging machine learning and behavioral targeting.
Create a modular, composable architecture supporting rapid feature deployment and experimentation.
Ensure platform reliability, security, and compliance with healthcare industry standards (HIPAA, etc.)

Team Development & Management

Build and scale a high-performing engineering organization embracing experimentation and innovation.
Foster a culture of rapid prototyping, fail-fast mentality, and continuous learning.
Establish innovation time (20% projects) and regular hackathons for creative exploration.
Implement agile development with emphasis on quick iterations and the MVP approaches.
Create cross-functional pods combining engineering, data science, and growth teams.
Partner with HR on talent acquisition, focusing on AI/ML and growth engineering expertise.

Data & Analytics

Build a comprehensive first-party data strategy to create a competitive advantage in physician engagement.
Develop unified physician profiles aggregating behavioral, preference, and interaction data across touchpoints.
Implement a customer data platform (CDP) for real-time audience segmentation and activation.
Create data clean rooms for secure collaboration with a pharmaceutical partners.
Design privacy-first architecture supporting targeted advertising without third-party cookies.
Build predictive models for content affinity, engagement propensity, and lifetime value.

AI & Innovation

Lead AI transformation with a focus on generative AI for content creation and summarization.
Implement LLMs for automated medical literature analysis and insight extraction.
Develop an experimentation platform that enables the rapid testing of new features and algorithms.
Create an innovation lab for exploring emerging technologies (voice interfaces, AR/VR, etc.)
Build ML pipelines for automated content tagging, classification, and knowledge graphs.
Foster a fail-fast mentality with a structured approach to proof-of-concepts and MVPs.

Community & Engagement

Design and implement features for the physician community, enabling peer collaboration and knowledge sharing.
Build social layers, including discussion forums, case studies, and peer review systems, to foster a collaborative environment.
Develop gamification strategies to increase engagement and platform stickiness.
Create user-generated content platforms with moderation and quality control systems.
Implement social proof mechanisms (ratings, reviews, endorsements) for content and CME programs.
Build referral and advocacy programs leveraging network effects.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

Evaluate and integrate best-in-class MarTech vendors across the marketing technology stack.
Build strategic partnerships with AI/ML platform providers and data enrichment services.
Manage relationships with advertising technology partners for programmatic capabilities.
Collaborate with M3 global technology teams on shared AI initiatives and data strategies.
Present the technology strategy and experimentation results to the board and executive stakeholders.
Optimize technology spend with a focus on ROI from rapid prototyping and MVP validation.

Qualifications

Experience

7+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, with at least 3 years managing engineering teams.
Proven track record in digital publishing, content management, or healthcare technology sectors.
Experience scaling platforms serving millions of users with high availability requirements.
Demonstrated success in AI/ML implementation and rapid prototyping initiatives.
Background in building experimentation frameworks and data-driven product development.
Track record in community platform development and user-generated content systems.

Technical Expertise

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
Executive Vice President of Information Technology
jobs.description:
Executive Vice President of Information Technology (EVP IT)
I. Position Overview

The Executive Vice President of Information Technology is responsible for formulating and executing the enterprise's overall IT strategy, overseeing IT infrastructure, enterprise applications, information security, data and analytics, cloud computing, digital transformation, IT operations, and technical service systems.

This role provides technical support for business growth, operational efficiency, digital transformation, and strategic development by building a stable, secure, scalable, and efficient IT ecosystem. The EVP IT typically leads a global or group-level IT organization and collaborates with the CEO, CIO, CTO, and various business units to drive the implementation of the enterprise's technology strategy.

II. Key Responsibilities
1. Enterprise IT Strategy
Formulate medium- to long-term IT development strategies aligned with the company's overall business strategy.
Establish IT technical architecture, investment plans, and roadmaps for key technology development.
Continuously adjust IT strategy and technology resource allocation based on business growth and market changes.
Provide IT strategic recommendations to the CEO, the Board of Directors, and senior management.
2. IT Infrastructure and Technical Architecture
Oversee IT infrastructure systems, including data centers, networks, servers, storage, and endpoints.
Establish a stable, scalable, and highly available enterprise technical architecture.
Drive the adoption of cloud computing, hybrid cloud solutions, and infrastructure modernization.
Continuously improve the performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency of IT infrastructure.
3. Enterprise Applications and System Management
Oversee core enterprise application systems, including ERP, CRM, HR, finance, and supply chain management.
Drive the integration, upgrading, and lifecycle management of enterprise application systems.
Establish unified standards for system management, access control, and technical operations.
Ensure the stable operation of critical business systems and support business growth.
4. Information Security and IT Risk Management
Establish enterprise information security strategies, governance frameworks, and security management mechanisms.
Oversee cybersecurity, identity authentication, access control, data security, and endpoint security.
Establish systems for IT risk identification, assessment, monitoring, and emergency response.
Collaborate with legal, compliance, and risk management teams to meet relevant regulatory requirements.
5. Data and Information Management
Drive the development of enterprise data governance, data architecture, and data standard systems.
Enhance data quality, data availability, and cross-departmental data collaboration capabilities. Support business intelligence, data analytics, and data-driven decision-making.
Drive the continuous upgrading of enterprise data platforms and analytical capabilities.
6. Digital Transformation
Formulate the enterprise digital transformation roadmap and drive the implementation of key projects.
Drive the digitization, automation, and intelligentization of business processes.
Introduce new technologies—such as cloud computing, AI, and automation—to improve business efficiency.
Evaluate the business value and return on investment (ROI) of digital projects.
7. IT Operations and Service Management
Establish a global or group-level IT operations management system.
Oversee IT service desks, technical support, system maintenance, and infrastructure operations.
Establish Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and IT service performance management mechanisms.
Continuously optimize IT service quality, response times, and operational efficiency.
8. IT Project and Technology Investment Management
Coordinate major enterprise IT projects and technology investment portfolios.
Manage IT budgets, resources, vendors, and project priorities.
Manage costs, schedules, quality, and risks for large-scale technology projects.
Ensure IT investments align with corporate strategy and business value.
9. Technology Vendor and Partner Management
Manage key IT vendors, cloud service providers, software vendors, and technology partners.
Establish systems for vendor selection, evaluation, performance management, and contract management.
Drive cost optimization in technology procurement and the integration of vendor resources.
Manage major technology outsourcing and strategic technology partnership projects.
10. IT Organization and Talent Management
Establish an efficient global IT organizational structure and talent development system.
Oversee the recruitment, development, and succession planning for the IT senior management team and key technical talent.
Establish performance management and career development mechanisms for technical talent.
Cultivate core capabilities in areas such as security, data, cloud computing, digitization, and enterprise architecture.
11. Business-Technology Collaboration
Collaborate with business units to identify opportunities for technology-driven growth and efficiency improvements.
Foster collaboration across IT, product, operations, finance, supply chain, and sales departments.
Ensure technology solutions meet business requirements.
Establish coordination mechanisms between business requirements, technical development, and IT operations.
12. Technology Governance and Executive Strategic Support
Establish enterprise IT governance, technology standards, and decision-making mechanisms.
Report on IT operations and technology strategy to the CEO, the Board of Directors, and senior management. Periodically assess technical risks, IT investment returns, and digitalization outcomes.
Participate in decision-making regarding major corporate investments, M&A, business expansion, and strategic transformations.
III. Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Business Management, or a related field.
Extensive experience in IT management, information technology management, or digital transformation within large enterprises.
Experience in corporate IT strategy, technical architecture, and IT operations management.
Familiarity with cloud computing, enterprise applications, network infrastructure, information security, and data management frameworks.
Experience managing large-scale IT projects, technology investments, and digital transformation initiatives.
Competence in information security, IT risk management, data governance, and technology compliance.
Experience managing cross-departmental, cross-regional, or global IT organizations.
Experience managing IT budgets, vendors, and technology partners.
Strong capabilities in strategic planning, business analysis, and technical decision-making.
MBA, Master’s degree in Information Technology or Computer Science, or other relevant advanced degrees preferred.

jobs.title: Customer Experience, Program Manager | West Region
jobs.description:
**Career\-defining. Life\-changing.**


At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

**About This Role:**


The Customer Experience team is responsible for partnering both internally and externally, including the sales and commercial teams, as well as key stakeholders at large health systems, to design and execute solutions that improve efficiency and outcomes.

**What You Will Do**

* Ability to perform the role effectively for an average of 6 opportunities concurrently.
* Support customer clinical, operational, and financial goals via designing customer journeys to drive adoption of the Zio Service.
* Align with brand priorities to ensure the customer experience (CX) is streamlined, personalized, and optimized.
* Responsible for creating and leading end\-to\-end customer experience strategy and differentiated solutions informed by insights, analytics, and best practices.
* Differentiate iRhythm as a trusted partner in ambulatory cardiac monitoring through the creation of operational efficiencies and standardization of care for patients with cardiac arrhythmias.
* Partner with key stakeholders (Director \+ VP of Cardiovascular Service Line, Population Health, Chief of Cardiology \+ EP, etc.) within large health systems to align on goals and success metrics of cardiac programs, identify challenges with the current cardiac monitoring program, and recommend solutions that enable health systems to optimize their program
* Leverage career experience and iRhythm tools to create standardized, reproducible experiences for customer engagements
* Collaborate closely with CX Senior Manager peers, with iRhythm area sales leadership and cross\-functional team members such as EHR Integration Managers, Key Account Managers, Revenue Cycle Billing Managers, Clinical Operations and Customer Service to effectively meet the needs of our customers and drive adoption of the Zio service.
* Accountable to prioritizing work that meets the needs of iRhythm business goals
* Held accountable to performance metrics that demonstrate physician adoption across large health systems, contributing to the health of IRTCs business
* Strategically partner with the geographic sales team to understand their business plan, and how you can best support them, impacting deep \+ broad penetration of their large health systems

**What We Need To See**
-----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree required, Master’s degree preferred:
* Minimum of 6 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 4 years of experience in a similar role and a Master’s degree.
* Experience in device or clinical sales working with large health systems in a consultative capacity preferred, or experience working in healthcare in process improvement, cardiovascular leadership, or clinical degree preferred
* Key attributes: Ability to influence across teams with strong teamwork and collaboration; ability to quickly build trust with sales team, cross\-functional partners, and customers as a strategic partner. Willingness to be flexible to the needs of IRTCs business goals, ability to quickly onboard and execute within role within 3\-6 months
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Ability to quickly analyze data to glean insights impactful to making recommendations to both sales partners and customers
* Demonstrated ability to adapt quickly and deliver on strong performance during times of ambiguity and complexity
* Strong understanding of the healthcare landscape and experience in cardiology preferred
* Ability to multi\-task and prioritize in a fast\-paced environment
* Proficiency with tools commonly used in a business environment including customer relationship management (Salesforce), Microsoft Office (Visio)
* Must be able to travel up to 50%.

**Location:** Remote – National US

**Location:**


Remote \- US
Actual compensation may vary depending on job\-related factors including knowledge, skills, experience, and work location.

**Estimated Pay Range**


$115,000\.00 \- $149,000\.00

jobs.title: Payer Back Office Strategy / Technology / Operations Consultant, Senior Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As a Payer Back Office Strategy / Technology / Operations Consultant, Senior Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming health services operations within our Business & Supply Chain Operations network. You will engage directly with clients, offering strategic guidance and innovative solutions to modernize payer systems. Your work will focus on optimizing processes and driving operational improvements, leveraging your skills to deliver impactful results.

As a Senior Manager, you will lead large projects, applying sound judgment and strategic advising to navigate complex challenges. You will motivate and coach teams, fostering a diverse and inclusive environment that contributes to the firm's success. Your role involves crafting clear, impactful messages and validating outcomes with clients, confirming that their feedback is integrated into project strategies. You will deepen your professional skills, staying relevant in the ever-evolving landscape of health services operations.

In this role at PwC, you will be part of our Operations practice, where you will drive results and maintain operational excellence. Your ability to develop high-performing teams and your commitment to excellence will be crucial in delivering quality outcomes for our clients.

Responsibilities

Leading strategic initiatives in payer back office operations to drive modernization and efficiency
Guiding teams in the development and implementation of operations strategies tailored to health services clients
Utilizing analytical thinking and business data analytics to optimize operational processes and performance metrics
Building relationships with stakeholders to facilitate effective communication and engagement
Developing and executing change management plans to support business transformation efforts
Promoting operational excellence through process improvement and optimization techniques
Conducting market research and operating effectiveness reviews to identify opportunities for service delivery model enhancements
Coaching teams in logistics management and operations support to achieve service excellence
Applying strategic questioning and storytelling to convey impactful messages and drive decision-making
Validating quality standards implementation to maintain compliance and operational integrity

What You Must Have

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 8 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Actuarial Science, Analytics/Data Science, Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Government/Public Policy, Health Administration/Public Health, Mathematics/Statistics, Operations/Supply Chain, Organizational Management/Behavior, Risk Management/Insurance
Demonstrating advanced skills in operations strategy and management consulting
Utilizing business data analytics to drive operational excellence
Leading change management initiatives in health services sector
Innovating process improvement and optimization strategies
Engaging stakeholders through strategic questioning and storytelling
Applying logistics management to enhance service delivery models

The salary range for this position is: $124,000 - $280,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. To view our benefits at a glance, please visit the following link: https://pwc.to/benefits-at-a-glance

As PwC is an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment at PwC without regard to race; color; religion; national origin; sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity); age; disability; genetic information (including family medical history); veteran, marital, or citizenship status; or, any other status protected by law. 

PwC does not intend to hire experienced or entry level job seekers who will need, now or in the future, PwC sponsorship through the H-1B lottery, except as set forth within the following policy: https://pwc.to/H-1B-Lottery-Policy.

Learn more about how we work: https://pwc.to/how-we-work

For only those qualified applicants that are impacted by the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, San Diego County Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable, arrest or conviction records will be considered for Employment in accordance with these laws. At PwC, we recognize that conviction records may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship to responsibilities such as accessing sensitive company or customer information, handling proprietary assets, or collaborating closely with team members. We evaluate these factors thoughtfully to establish a secure and trusted workplace for all.

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled or the posting is removed, unless otherwise set forth on the following webpage. Please visit this link for information about anticipated application deadlines: https://pwc.to/us-application-deadlines

jobs.title: IT Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Recor Medical, we are pioneering Ultrasound Renal Denervation (uRDN) therapy to treat hypertension, the leading cardiovascular risk factor in the world. With our Paradise™ uRDN System, we’re on a mission to provide the millions of people who suffer from hypertension with a non-drug and minimally invasive option to lower their blood pressure. Join us on our journey and make a meaningful impact on the lives of people around the globe.

Position Summary

The IT Program Manager owns how IT connects with the rest of Recor Medical. The role holds strategic ownership of the company intranet and IT communication tools including the IT Department Newsletter. This role establishes measurable outcomes for IT communications and training, including reach, engagement, comprehension, completion, and adoption. This position provides project management leadership for cross-functional system implementations, internally organizing each project from initiation through go-live. The role is also accountable for ensuring user-facing and post-implementation training is created by the appropriate subject matter experts, embedded into every implementation as a required workstream.

Responsibilities

Holds strategic ownership of the company intranet — information architecture, governance, content strategy, and editorial standards across IT-published surfaces.
Owns the IT Department Newsletter end-to-end, including editorial calendar, contributor management, voice, and cadence.
Serves as the accountable owner for the wording, timing, and channel of IT-driven change and policy communications.
Establishes and tracks measurable outcomes for IT communications (reach, engagement, comprehension) and ties results to adoption outcomes and business impact.
Partners with Corporate Communications, HR, and Legal where IT messaging intersects with company-wide communications, policy, or compliance requirements.
Provides project management leadership for IT-led system implementations that span multiple business functions (HR, Clinical, Quality, Operations, Finance, etc.).
Runs each project across the full lifecycle: initiation (stakeholder map, success criteria, sponsor sign-off), planning (scope, milestones, RACI, communications and training plan), execution (cross-team cadence), and landing (go-live, post-implementation training, adoption tracking).
Embeds communications and training plans into every implementation as a non-negotiable workstream.
Maintains transparent project status, risk, and decision logs accessible to sponsors and stakeholders.
Conducts post-implementation reviews and applies lessons learned to subsequent projects.
Accountable for ensuring user-facing training is created by the appropriate subject matter expert — governing the process, not authoring the content.
Accountable for ensuring post-implementation training is created by subject matter experts following every system go-live, prior to project closeout.
Tracks training completion and effectiveness; feeds insights back into the next implementation cycle.

Requirements

5+ years of professional experience combining internal communications, SharePoint or intranet administration, training program management, or IT project management.
Demonstrated ownership of an enterprise intranet or internal communications platform; SharePoint Online strongly preferred.
Proven ability to manage cross-functional projects from initiation through go-live, with measurable adoption outcomes.
Strong written and verbal communication — able to translate technical concepts into clear, audience-appropriate language for non-technical end users and executive stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to hold subject matter experts accountable to deadlines and quality standards without authoring the content directly.
Working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including SharePoint, Teams, Power Automate, and OneDrive.
High degree of organization, self-direction, and discretion handling sensitive and confidential company information.
Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Experience in medical device, pharmaceutical, biotech, or other FDA-regulated industries preferred.

Salary Range: $147,000 - $165,000 (Annual Base Salary)

Compensation for this role is determined using market-based geographic pay ranges. The salary range offered to the selected candidate may vary based on their primary work location, relevant experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

The successful candidate's starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

Equal Employment Opportunity

At Recor Medical, we value bringing together individuals from diverse backgrounds to develop new and innovative solutions for patients. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy), physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Pre-Employment Requirements

At Recor Medical, patient safety, integrity, and regulatory compliance are foundational to everything we do. To support these standards, employment is contingent upon meeting the following requirements:

Background Screening & Drug Testing: Final candidates may be required to successfully complete a background check and/or drug screening, conducted in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
Washington Fair Chance Act Compliance (if applicable): For applicants who reside in or are applying for roles based in Washington State, Recor Medical adheres to the Washington Fair Chance Act. This means we do not inquire about or consider criminal history until after an initial determination has been made that the candidate is otherwise qualified for the role, and we do not automatically exclude individuals based on criminal records.
New Hire Training: All employees are required to successfully complete Recor training program within their first 90 days of employment as a condition of continued employment.

Radiation Safety Requirement

Certain field-based roles at Recor Medical require work in environments where radiation sources (e.g., x-ray equipment) are in use. Employees in these roles will be issued a personal dosimetry badge to monitor occupational exposure and are required to wear it in accordance with company policy and applicable regulatory standards. This program is designed to ensure compliance with federal and state regulations and to maintain radiation exposure at levels that are As Low As Reasonably Achievable (ALARA). Additional guidance and protective equipment, as necessary, will be provided as part of onboarding and ongoing safety training.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager - Prime Video, PV Personalization and Discovery
jobs.description:
Description

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

Prime Video is on a mission to reimagine how customers discover and engage with content across the entertainment landscape. As part of this vision, we’re investing heavily in building scalable, science-friendly infrastructure to accelerate the pace of innovation in machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI). We’re seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the technical direction of our next-generation Recommender Systems (RecSys) platforms — systems that sit at the core of how customers experience Prime Video.

About The Team

Prime Video Personalization and Discovery (PVPD) is dedicated to creating a highly personalized content discovery experience that not only delights our customers but also drives both short-and long-term business goals. Our scope includes personalized recommendations, search, marketing, and the advanced machine learning technology and infrastructure that underpins these experiences. Our mission is to automate and enhance customer engagement through personalization, using ML and Generative AI.

Key Job Responsibilities

In this role, you will partner closely with applied scientists, product teams, and platform engineers to define and deliver highly extensible systems that fuel personalized discovery at scale. you will lead the technical strategy and architecture of Prime Video’s end-to-end personalization stack — spanning data ingestion, feature engineering, training and serving platform, candidate retrieval, multi-stage ranking, dynamic content grouping, whole page optimization, and orchestration. Your work will shape how millions of customers discover content they love, optimizing for engagement, retention, and long-term customer value.

You will bring clarity to ambiguity, complexity, ROI, planning, and trade-off etc that dramatically improves the agility, usability, and extensibility of our ML solutions. Your technical leadership will shape the future of AI/ML across Prime Video, unlocking generative and ML models that personalize content for hundreds of millions of viewers worldwide.

Key job responsibilities

Consistently meet challenging deadlines and deliver high-quality solutions that enable the Prime Video platform to scale to meet growing customer demand.
Overcome obstacles and persist in the face of setbacks to ensure critical initiatives are successfully completed.
Proactively identify and mitigate risks, communicating regularly with stakeholders on project status and issues.
Demonstrate deep technical expertise in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, ML/AI fluency and large-scale data processing.
Understand the architecture and design limitations of the existing Prime Video systems, ML models, and drive technical decisions that address deficiencies and optimize performance.
Use data-driven analysis to make a compelling case for project priorities and resource allocation.
Accountable for the overall strategy and successful execution of large, complex infrastructure optimization and scaling programs.
Partner closely with engineering, product, and business leaders to align initiatives with high-level objectives and achieve measurable improvements in efficiency or customer experience.
Communicate ideas effectively to a wide range of audiences, foster constructive dialogue, and lead the resolution of contentious technical issues.
Set a best-in-class example for project/program management practices, driving crisp decision-making and proactive risk mitigation.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
7+ years of technical product or program management experience
5+ years of software development experience
Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The Director of Information Technology
will oversee the internal technology estate end to end and lead the team responsible for running it. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Officer, this full-time role based in the United States covers identity, endpoints, networking, collaboration, service management, and the internal artificial intelligence platform across a distributed, remote-first organization.

This position is designed for a leader experienced in building and scaling internal technology through periods of rapid growth, possessing the capability to construct a multi-year roadmap while maintaining the ability to resolve operational issues directly. The role collaborates closely with Security, Engineering, Finance, and Human Resources leadership while managing vendor and managed service provider relationships.

Key Responsibilities

Build and execute a multi-year internal technology roadmap across identity, endpoints, networking, collaboration, and service management.
Tie technology investments directly to business outcomes with defined success measures.
Define internal delivery models versus services managed through partners and managed service providers.
Establish IT governance, operating standards, architecture reviews, and change management.
Design the internal IT function, build business cases for headcount, and hire and develop team members.
Mentor the team and establish clear ownership, on-call schedules, and escalation models.
Build and maintain the internal service catalog and associated service level agreements.
Own internal AI tool use case development, rollout, training, and adoption measurement.
Partner with the organization's AI practice so internal usage directly informs client-facing delivery.
Apply financial engineering to the internal AI estate by developing unit-cost models, forecasting consumption, negotiating commitments and reserved capacity, and holding AI expenditures accountable to measured productivity gains.
Own endpoint management, configuration baselines, patching, and hardware lifecycles using Intune or equivalent systems.
Manage the Microsoft 365 collaboration environment, including Teams, SharePoint, and Exchange governance.
Define and enforce device posture requirements for a remote-first workforce.
Direct internal network architecture, remote access, and secure connectivity models.
Manage the internal cloud and hosting footprint, including capacity, cost, and resilience.
Direct backup, recovery, and business continuity for internal systems with tested recovery objectives.
Establish and mature IT service management across intake, incident, problem, request, and change processes.
Publish operational metrics and systematically eliminate key sources of employee workflow friction.
Oversee the onboarding and offboarding technology experience in partnership with Human Resources.
Manage the internal IT budget, financial forecasts, and software licensing positions.
Rationalize the SaaS estate and direct renewals, contract negotiations, and vendor terms.
Hold external partners and managed service providers accountable to defined service levels.
Partner with security leadership to execute the IT components of the broader security program.
Support SOC 2 and ISO audit readiness, including control operation and evidence collection.
Own vulnerability management and remediation across internal systems and endpoints.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of information technology experience, including proven experience leading teams or owning a technology function.
Demonstrated experience building and scaling internal IT within a distributed or remote-first company during periods of rapid growth.
Experience presenting technology strategy, investment recommendations, operational risks, and performance metrics to executive leadership.
Deep hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, endpoint management (Intune or equivalent), and SaaS administration at scale.
Demonstrated ownership of internal AI adoption and governance, including policy creation, data handling, and change management.
Strong security fluency, with the ability to partner credibly with executive security leadership and translate technical risk into business terms.
Proven experience supporting SOC 2, ISO, or related regulated compliance and audit requirements.
Experience managing IT budgets and negotiating contracts with vendors and managed service providers.
Ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly to both executive and technical audiences, in writing and in person.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience operating within a solutions provider, managed service provider (MSP), or technology consulting environment.
Relevant industry certifications, such as ITIL, Microsoft certifications, CISSP, CISM, PMP, or equivalent credentials.

Discretionary incentive compensation and bonus opportunities based on individual and organizational performance.
Comprehensive health coverage, including medical, dental, and vision insurance.
401(k) retirement plan with an employer match.

About the Opportunity

The hiring organization is seeking a strategic and hands-on Director, Infrastructure & IT Operations
to lead the technology capabilities that keep digital products, cloud platforms, and internal teams secure, reliable, and productive.

This role oversees cloud infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), production operations, bot mitigation, corporate IT, and helpdesk support, while providing architectural leadership across cloud platforms, networking, identity, observability, and operational tooling. This position spans both internal employee technology and the production infrastructure supporting high-traffic, customer-facing applications.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Lead teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, SRE, production operations, corporate IT, helpdesk, and bot mitigation, establishing ownership, operational standards, service-level objectives (SLOs), escalation procedures, and performance metrics.
Develop managers, technical leads, and IT staff through coaching, career development, and building a culture of accountability, documentation, automation, and continuous improvement.
Build quarterly and annual infrastructure roadmaps aligned with business priorities, growth, security, reliability, and cost, partnering with engineering, product, data, marketing, finance, HR, legal, and executive leadership.
Own the reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost-effectiveness of cloud infrastructure, primarily within AWS.
Provide architectural leadership across cloud services, applications, APIs, networking, identity, databases, storage, observability, and integrations while establishing architecture standards, reference patterns, governance, and technical review processes.
Partner with engineering to improve deployment safety, performance, and readiness, driving automation, configuration management, and infrastructure as code.
Lead capacity planning for growth and demand spikes, eliminating single points of failure, undocumented systems, manual processes, and single-source dependencies.
Ensure production and nonproduction environments are properly separated, secured, and monitored, reviewing new systems for architectural fit, supportability, security, and total cost of ownership.
Establish and maintain service-level indicators (SLIs), SLOs, availability targets, and error-budget practices for critical systems.

Support vulnerability remediation, security assessments, audits, vendor reviews, incident readiness, and applicable privacy requirements in partnership with legal and security teams.
Manage infrastructure, security, IT, telecom, monitoring, and support vendors, handling evaluations, contract reviews, renewals, licensing, service level agreements (SLAs), and budget management.

10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, SRE, platform engineering, DevOps, IT operations, or related disciplines.
5+ years of experience leading engineering or technology teams, including managing managers or technical leads.
Demonstrated experience operating high-traffic, customer-facing platforms in AWS or a comparable cloud environment.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, identity, security, observability, databases, APIs, storage, and distributed systems.
Experience managing production availability, incident response, root-cause analysis, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Experience managing corporate IT, employee support, endpoint management, software licensing, and access provisioning.
Experience establishing operational metrics, SLOs, and support standards.
Demonstrated ability to manage vendors, contracts, departmental budgets, and cloud costs.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, architecture, and tradeoffs to executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Cloudflare, DataDome, or comparable bot-management and web application protection platforms, including leading bot mitigation or traffic-quality programs.
Experience with AWS services, containerized environments, infrastructure as code, centralized logging, and APM tools (such as AppDynamics).
Experience supporting large-scale consumer subscription, public-record, data-as-a-service, advertising, or ecommerce platforms.
Experience modernizing legacy infrastructure, transitioning systems from external vendors, and consolidating cloud accounts or IT services.

jobs.title: Director of IT Delivery
jobs.description:
Description
**About the Role**


The Director of IT Delivery is the primary business\-facing leadership role within IT — responsible for translating the priorities of Agronomy, Grain, and Back Office Operations into a funded, sequenced, and realistic IT delivery portfolio. This role owns what gets prioritized, while Director of Technology owns how well the organization can deliver it — the two roles are intentionally separated so neither business urgency nor technical capacity gets steamrolled by the other.

  

  

**What will you do?**


* Own the IT delivery portfolio and roadmap across all business units, ensuring priorities reflect actual business need rather than whoever escalated loudest.


* Serve as the primary point of business engagement for IT — the person each business unit goes to when they need something funded, sequenced, or clarified.


* Translate level of effort into business terms and vice versa — able to look at a piece of IT work and communicate realistic timeline, cost, and tradeoffs to a non\-technical business stakeholder, and translate a business ask back into scoped, sequenced technical work.


* Own delivery tracking and portfolio visibility in Wrike — maintaining the roadmap, project status, and resourcing views that both business stakeholders and IT leadership rely on for decision\-making.


* Act as Scrum Master for IT delivery initiatives — running sprint ceremonies (planning, stand\-ups, retros) where applicable, removing blockers, and keeping delivery teams and Delivery Leads working against a shared, visible cadence rather than ad hoc requests.


* Own change management and UAT coordination for delivery initiatives — ensuring changes hitting production are reviewed, tested, and signed off with clear acceptance criteria before go\-live.


* Manage risk across the delivery portfolio — identifying, tracking, and mitigating risk on in\-flight initiatives, and escalating proactively rather than letting risk surface at delivery.


* Own budget and resourcing for the delivery function — including any third\-party vendors or consultants engaged to support delivery work.


* Lead and coach the Delivery Leads (Agronomy, Grain, Back Office Ops), holding them accountable for business outcomes, not just completed tickets — even though they don't own technical staff directly. Build delivery\-team skill and capacity over time, not just manage day\-to\-day output.


* Partner directly with Director of Technology on a standing, recurring basis to weigh capacity and feasibility before committing work to the roadmap — prioritization decisions are made with technical reality in view, not in isolation.


* Coordinate with Lead Automation Engineer on location\-level and automation\-related priorities specifically, given that role's dual scope as both a working manager and a prioritization partner.


* Work with Manager, Business Systems \& AI / Business Systems Analyst to ensure delivery priorities reflect what AGRIS and other core systems can actually support — preventing commitments that outpace system capability.


* Escalate and resolve prioritization conflicts between business units competing for the same shared technical resources.


* Report portfolio health and delivery risk to the VP of IT as part of overall IT governance.


Publish an organization\-wide monthly update summarizing what IT is working on and has accomplished — giving business stakeholders outside IT regular, digestible visibility into delivery progress without requiring them to track the roadmap directly.


Requirements
**Requirements of Role:**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field; Master's or MBA a plus.


* 5\+ years of experience leading IT delivery, PMO, or business\-relationship\-management functions, ideally in a mid\-size organization (ag, co\-op, manufacturing, or similarly operationally complex industries are a strong fit).


* Working proficiency with Wrike or a comparable project/portfolio management tool, with real experience using it to drive prioritization conversations, not just log status.


* Scrum Master experience or certification (CSM or equivalent) required; PMP or ITIL certification preferred.


* Demonstrated ability to translate technical level\-of\-effort into business\-understandable terms, and business urgency into realistically scoped technical asks — this is arguably the single most important skill for the role.


* Experience managing vendor and third\-party relationships in a delivery context.


* Comfortable operating as a translator between business stakeholders and technical teams without owning the technical work itself.


* ERP\-driven environment experience is a strong plus — familiarity with how a core system like AGRIS shapes what's actually deliverable.


* Track record of holding indirect reports (people who don't report to you on paper) accountable through influence rather than authority.

  

  

**Core Value expectations:**


* Thrive Together


* Integrity in Action


* Grow Forward

  

  

**Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  



  

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to talk or listen. The employee is frequently required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms when using equipment. The employee is occasionally required to walk; sit; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and taste or smell. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, and depth perception.

jobs.description:
**Introduction**
----------------


**OUR MISSION**


The Maryland Workers' Compensation Commission seeks to secure the equitable and timely administration of the provisions of the Maryland Workers' Compensation law on behalf of its customer, the injured workers, and their employers, by providing an efficient forum for the resolution of individual claims.


**OUR VISION**


The Workers' Compensation Commission envisions a state wherein injured workers and employers are empowered to create an equitable partnership to facilitate prompt and fair resolution of workers' compensation matters.


**ABOUT US**


Together we profoundly touch the lives of so many people and have enormous responsibility to the community by fulfilling our mission of securing equitable and timely administration of the law. The Commission continues to provide services to our constituent partners at a level rarely met throughout the United States. The professionalism, work ethic, and technological acumen manifest in our operations allows us to smoothly and effectively manage the challenges which invariably arise. -----------------------


The Deputy Director serves as the chief operating, supervisory, and financial risk\-management official for the Insurance, Compliance and Reporting Division. A principal responsibility of the position is the administration and financial oversight of Maryland’s workers’ compensation self\-insurance program. Employers authorized to self\-insure assume direct responsibility for potentially significant and long\-term workers’ compensation liabilities. A deterioration in the financial condition of a self\-insured employer, an inadequately funded claims program, insufficient collateral, or a failure of an employer, surety, financial institution, excess insurance carrier, or third\-party administrator may expose injured workers and the State’s workers’ compensation system to substantial financial and operational risk.  

  

The Deputy Director directs the comprehensive financial, actuarial, claims, insurance, legal\-document, and compliance review of active, financially distressed, terminated, and prospective self\-insured employers. The position evaluates corporate financial condition, liquidity, leverage, profitability, cash flow, debt obligations, creditworthiness, claims reserves, loss development, actuarial projections, excess insurance coverage, security instruments, parental guarantees, organizational changes, and industry\-specific economic conditions. Based on these evaluations, the Deputy Director develops recommendations concerning approval or continuation of self\-insurance authority, security requirements, retention levels, additional financial reporting, corrective actions, and other conditions necessary to protect injured workers and the Commission.  

  

The Deputy Director also manages the operational execution of the Commission’s Employer Compliance Program. This responsibility includes overseeing the identification and investigation of employers that may be operating without required workers’ compensation coverage; coordinating compliance efforts with other governmental agencies; directing notices, referrals, hearing preparation, and follow\-up activity; and ensuring that employers obtain and maintain legally required coverage.  

  

The position exercises substantial independent judgment and delegated authority in resolving complex operational, financial, regulatory, and personnel matters. The Deputy Director develops completed staff work and recommendations for review by the Division Director and presentation to the Commissioners. The Deputy Director reports to the Director of the Insurance, Compliance and Reporting Division. The Director establishes Division policy, strategic direction, risk\-governance standards, and final recommendations to the Commission. The Opportunity

Reporting directly to the CEO and serving on the Veralto Leadership Team, the CDIO will operate as both a strategic enterprise architect and pragmatic transformation leader, driving enterprise-wide change across a decentralized, global operating model. The Chief Digital & Information Officer will partner closely with the CEO and leadership team to shape and execute this agenda—bringing cohesion, standardization, and scalability to a fragmented enterprise technology landscape while unlocking new sources of value through data, AI, and digital-enabled business innovation to further differentiate Veralto in the market.

The CDIO will play a central role in shaping how the company scales, competes, and creates value—positioning technology, data, and AI as core strategic pillars of the business. This leader will elevate digital, data, and AI from functional capabilities to enterprise-wide drivers of growth, margin expansion, and competitive differentiation, partnering closely with OpCo Presidents and functional leaders to embed digital innovation into commercial strategy, product development, operations, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities include:

Enterprise Digital, Data & AI Strategy:

Define and execute a bold, enterprise-wide digital, data, and AI strategy aligned to Veralto’s growth agenda
Position data and AI as core drivers of business performance, customer value, and competitive advantage
Establish governance and prioritization frameworks to align investments with enterprise strategy

AI & Advanced Analytics Transformation:

Defining and lead a clear enterprise AI vision, including use cases across: Productivity and efficiency, End-to-end process transformation, Commercial and customer value creation, Product and service innovation
Drive deployment of AI/LLMs and advanced analytics across the enterprise
Ensure responsible AI governance, ethical standards, and scalable implementation

Digital Transformation & Business Integration

Lead the simplification and modernization of a complex, multi-ERP Oracle ecosystem
Drive platform standardization to enable scalability, operational efficiency, and M&A integration
Establish a clear roadmap for enterprise systems and architecture
Partner with OpCo Presidents and leadership teams to embed digital into:
Commercial strategy, Product development, Customer experience and Operations
Act as a thought partner and challenger to transform business models and ways of working
Drive enterprise-wide adoption of digital capabilities

M&A Enablement & Integration

Lead digital and IT integration for acquisitions
Establish scalable platforms and processes to support rapid integration
Enable value capture through technology-enabled synergies

Cybersecurity, Infrastructure & IT Operations:

Ensure secure, resilient, and scalable global technology infrastructure
Lead cybersecurity strategy, governance, and risk management
Optimize IT operations, vendor partnerships, and outsourced services

Culture & Talent Leadership

Leaders at Veralto are expected to drive impact, challenge the status quo, and deliver results while building strong, collaborative relationships across the enterprise
The CDIO will build and lead a high-performing, globally distributed team, develop next-generation capabilities across digital, data, and AI, and foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement

Board & Executive Engagement:

Serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO and Board
Provide clear, actionable insights or digital strategy, cybersecurity, and technology performance
Drive accountability and measurable ROI from digital investments

Qualifications

15+ years of progressive leadership across digital, data, AI, and enterprise technology transformation
Proven experience leading enterprise transformation within decentralized, multi-entity global organizations
Demonstrated ability to reposition digital and IT from a support function to a driver of business value and growth
Strong, demonstrable track record of: Enterprise transformation, AI and data strategy execution, Oracle ERP implementations and platform modernization, M&A integration and technology-enabled value capture
Ability to influence at the CEO, Board, and executive leadership level
Strong commercial acumen and clear understanding of how technology drives growth, margin expansion, and

customer value

Proven talent leader with experience building and scaling high-performing teams
Track record of influencing and driving alignment across diverse, autonomous business units

Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will be an enterprise-scale digital and technology leader who combines strategic vision with pragmatic execution, with a proven ability to drive transformation across complex, decentralized organizations. This individual will translate digital, data, and AI capabilities into measurable business outcomes and sustained enterprise

value creation.

Importantly, this leader will balance enterprise standardization with respect for Veralto’s operator-led culture—bringing discipline to platforms, data, and governance while preserving speed, innovation, and accountability at the OpCo level. The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable shaping long-term strategy and delivering near-term impact, with a strong bias toward value creation, operational excellence, and scalable growth.
